	public abstract class AbstractProcessQuantity<T, TU> : ProcessStoredDouble<T>, IProcessVar<IQuantity>, IProcessVariable, INotifyPropertyChanged, IVariableSpecifier where T : FloatingQuantity<T, TU>, IQuantity where TU : UnitOfMeasure, IUnitOfMeasure
	{
		private IUnitType _unitType;

		IQuantity IProcessVar<IQuantity>.Value => base.Value;

		protected abstract int EnumValue { get; }

		protected AcsSeProcessQuantity QDataModel => (AcsSeProcessQuantity)DataModel;

		public IUnitType UnitType
		{
			get
			{
				return _unitType;
			}
			protected set
			{
				_unitType = value;
				QDataModel.PhysicalType = EnumValue;
			}
		}

		protected AbstractProcessQuantity(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessQuantity dataModel, IUnitType unitType, Guid fieldIdent, IProcessVar<T> defaultValueVar)
			: base(model, (AcsSeProcessDouble)(object)dataModel, fieldIdent, defaultValueVar)
		{
			UnitType = unitType;
		}

		bool IProcessVar<IQuantity>.Specify(IQuantity value, IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			return Specify(ToDerivedType(value), specifier);
		}

		bool IProcessVar<IQuantity>.WouldBeValid(IQuantity value)
		{
			return value.UnitType == UnitType && value.IsValid;
		}

		bool IProcessVar<IQuantity>.WouldBeEmpty(IQuantity value)
		{
			return double.IsNaN(value.ValueIn(value.UnitType.InnateUnit));
		}

		public override bool WouldBeValid(T value)
		{
			return value != null && value.UnitType == UnitType && value.IsValid;
		}

		public virtual double ValueIn(TU uom)
		{
			return base.Value.ValueIn(uom);
		}

		public abstract bool Specify(double value, TU uom, IVariableSpecifier specifier);

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			object value = processVariable.GetValue();
			T val = value as T;
			if (val == null)
			{
				if (value == null || processVariable.IsEmpty)
				{
					Clear(processVariable);
					return true;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(double))
				{
					Specify((double)value, (TU)UnitType.InnateUnit, processVariable);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			Specify(val, processVariable);
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract T ToDerivedType(IQuantity value);

		protected override double? ConvertToUnderlying(T value)
		{
			double num = value.ValueIn(UnitType.InnateUnit);
			return double.IsNaN(num) ? ((double?)null) : new double?(num);
		}

		protected override bool ValueWillChange(T newValue)
		{
			return base.Value != newValue;
		}
	}
	internal static class AdsHelpers
	{
		public static IEnumerable<TValue> AsEnumerable<TKey, TValue>(this ReferenceArray<TKey, TValue> array) where TValue : AcsBaseRecord, new()
		{
			int i = 0;
			while (i < ((AcsArrayBase)array).Length)
			{
				yield return array.ValueAtLocation(i);
				int num = i + 1;
				i = num;
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable<TValue> Values<TKey, TValue>(this ValueArray<TKey, TValue> array)
		{
			int i = 0;
			while (i < ((AcsArrayBase)array).Length)
			{
				yield return array.ValueAtLocation(i);
				int num = i + 1;
				i = num;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ApiTableUpdater : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		private static Lazy<ApiTableUpdater> _updater = new Lazy<ApiTableUpdater>();

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			if (SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.UpdateApiTables(SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.Api526Edition.Value.Value);
			}
		}

		internal static ApiTableUpdater GetSingleton()
		{
			return _updater.Value;
		}
	}

		private void CreateApiStandardReliefOrifice(AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ApiDesignation designation, Area orificeArea)
		{
			PsvOrifice psvOrifice = PsvOrifice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			psvOrifice.Name.Specify(designation.ToString(), new CalculationSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.Designation.Specify(designation, new CalculationSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.OrificeArea.Specify(orificeArea, new CalculationSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.Source.Specify(ReliefOrificeSource.BuiltIn, new CalculationSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.IsBuiltInOrifice.Specify(true, new CalculationSpecifier());
			_reliefOrifices.Add(psvOrifice);
		}

		private void CreateRdBuiltInReliefOrifice(Distance diameter)
		{
			RuptureDiskOrifice ruptureDiskOrifice = RuptureDiskOrifice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			ruptureDiskOrifice.Name.Specify(diameter.ValueIn(Units.inch).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), new CalculationSpecifier());
			ruptureDiskOrifice.Designation.Specify(null, new CalculationSpecifier());
			ruptureDiskOrifice.Diameter.Specify(diameter, new CalculationSpecifier());
			ruptureDiskOrifice.OrificeArea.Specify(ruptureDiskOrifice.CalculateAreaFromDiameter(diameter), new CalculationSpecifier());
			ruptureDiskOrifice.Source.Specify(ReliefOrificeSource.BuiltIn, new CalculationSpecifier());
			ruptureDiskOrifice.IsBuiltInOrifice.Specify(true, new CalculationSpecifier());
			_reliefOrifices.Add(ruptureDiskOrifice);
		}

		public RuptureDiskOrifice GetRdBuiltInReliefOrifice(Distance diameter)
		{
			string key = diameter.ValueIn(Units.inch).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			ReliefOrifice value;
			bool flag = _reliefOrifices.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			return value as RuptureDiskOrifice;
		}

		public DetailedReliefDevice CreatePsvOrifice(string name, AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ApiDesignation? designation, Area orificeArea, string manufacturer = null, double vaporKd = double.NaN, double liquidKd = double.NaN, double mixedKd = double.NaN)
		{
			if (manufacturer == null)
			{
				manufacturer = string.Empty;
			}
			if (!IsUniqueReliefOrificeName(name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			PsvOrifice psvOrifice = PsvOrifice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			psvOrifice.Source.Specify(ReliefOrificeSource.User, new CalculationSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.Name.Specify(name, new UserSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.Designation.Specify(designation, new UserSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.OrificeArea.Specify(orificeArea, new UserSpecifier());
			psvOrifice.Manufacturer.Specify(manufacturer, new UserSpecifier());
			if (!double.IsNaN(vaporKd))
			{
				psvOrifice.VaporKd.Specify(vaporKd, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(liquidKd))
			{
				psvOrifice.LiquidKd.Specify(liquidKd, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(mixedKd))
			{
				psvOrifice.MixedKd.Specify(mixedKd, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			psvOrifice.IsBuiltInOrifice.Specify(false, new CalculationSpecifier());
			_reliefOrifices.Add(psvOrifice);
			DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice = DetailedReliefDevice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			detailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice = psvOrifice;
			_customDetailedReliefDevices.Add(detailedReliefDevice);
			return detailedReliefDevice;
		}

		public string GetUniqueOrificeName()
		{
			int num = 0;
			string format = "New_{0}";
			string text = null;
			do
			{
				text = string.Format(format, num);
				num++;
			}
			while (!IsUniqueReliefOrificeName(text));
			return text;
		}

		public string GetUniqueOrificeNameFor(string existingName)
		{
			string text = existingName;
			int num = 1;
			while (!IsUniqueReliefOrificeName(text))
			{
				text = existingName + $" ({num})";
				num++;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public bool RemoveReliefOrifice(ReliefOrifice reliefOrifice)
		{
			List<DetailedReliefDevice> list = _customDetailedReliefDevices.Where((DetailedReliefDevice drd) => drd.ReliefOrifice == reliefOrifice).ToList();
			foreach (DetailedReliefDevice item in list)
			{
				_customDetailedReliefDevices.Remove(item);
			}
			return _reliefOrifices.Remove(reliefOrifice.Name.Value);
		}

		internal void ClearCustomOrifices()
		{
			List<ReliefOrifice> list = (from rokvp in _reliefOrifices
				where !(rokvp.Value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value ?? true)
				select rokvp.Value).ToList();
			foreach (ReliefOrifice item in list)
			{
				RemoveReliefOrifice(item);
			}
		}

		public bool IsUniqueReliefOrificeName(string name)
		{
			return !ReliefOrifices.ContainsKey(name);
		}

		internal bool ReliefOrificeRenamed(ReliefOrifice orifice)
		{
			if (orifice == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				_reliefOrifices.KeyUpdated(orifice);
			}
			catch (MockedKeyUpdateException ex)
			{
				orifice.Name.Specify(ex.OldKey as string, new UserSpecifier());
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 1)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ReliefOrifice> reliefOrifice in _reliefOrifices)
				{
					string key = reliefOrifice.Key;
					ReliefOrifice value = reliefOrifice.Value;
					if (Enum.TryParse<AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ApiDesignation>(key, out var result))
					{
						if (value.Designation.IsEmpty)
						{
							value.Designation.Specify(result, new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Specify(true, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					else
					{
						value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Specify(false, new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
				}
			}
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 2)
			{
				Api526Edition.Specify(Api526Ed.e5, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 5)
			{
				List<(string, RuptureDiskOrifice)> list = new List<(string, RuptureDiskOrifice)>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ReliefOrifice> reliefOrifice2 in _reliefOrifices)
				{
					if (reliefOrifice2.Value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value == true && reliefOrifice2.Value is RuptureDiskOrifice item && reliefOrifice2.Key.Contains(','))
					{
						list.Add((reliefOrifice2.Key, item));
					}
				}
				foreach (var (text, ruptureDiskOrifice) in list)
				{
					ruptureDiskOrifice.Name.Specify(text.Replace(',', '.'), new CalculationSpecifier());
					_reliefOrifices.KeyUpdated(ruptureDiskOrifice);
				}
			}
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 6)
			{
				Api520Part1Edition.Specify(PSVSizingEngine.Api520Part1Edition.Edition9, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 7)
			{
				CreateBuiltInEntranceFittings();
			}
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 8)
			{
				LastSavedLocale.Specify("en-US", new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
			if (StoredCaseConfigurationRevision < 10)
			{
				SelectedUnitSet.Specify((Common.eUnitSet)(-1), new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
			ForceLocaleCheck();
		}

		public void ForceLocaleCheck()
		{
			if (CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.Name != LastSavedLocale.Value)
			{
				LocaleChanged = true;
				LastSavedLocale.Specify(CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.Name, new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public void MergeConfigurationData(AcsSeCaseConfiguration otherConfig)
		{
			_MergeCustomOrificeData(otherConfig);
			_MergeFittingData(otherConfig);
			_MergeMaterialData(otherConfig);
		}

		private void _MergeCustomOrificeData(AcsSeCaseConfiguration otherConfig)
		{
			HashSet<AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice> hashSet = new HashSet<AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice>();
			foreach (AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice item in otherConfig.CustomDetailedReliefDevices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice>())
			{
				DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice = _FindMatchingDrdFor(item);
				if (detailedReliefDevice != null)
				{
					MergedDrdMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item).Record.RecordGuid(), detailedReliefDevice);
					MergedOrificeMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item.ReliefOrifice).Record.RecordGuid(), detailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice);
				}
				else
				{
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (AcsSeReliefOrifice item2 in otherConfig.ReliefOrifices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefOrifice>())
			{
				if (MergedOrificeMap.ContainsKey(((AcsBaseRecord)item2).Record.RecordGuid()))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (ReliefOrifices.TryGetValue(item2.Name.VarValue, out var value))
				{
					if (item2.IsBuiltInOrifice.VarValue.HasValue && value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value.HasValue && ((item2.IsBuiltInOrifice.VarValue == true) ^ (value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value == true)))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					if (item2.IsBuiltInOrifice.VarValue == true || value.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value == true)
					{
						MergedOrificeMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item2).Record.RecordGuid(), value);
						continue;
					}
					AcsSeReliefOrifice val = ((AcsBase)value.DataModel).CastTo<AcsSeReliefOrifice>();
					bool flag = true;
					if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(((AcsSeProcessDouble)item2.OrificeArea).VarValue ?? double.NaN, ((AcsSeProcessDouble)val.OrificeArea).VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else if (item2.Designation.VarValue != val.Designation.VarValue)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(item2.VaporKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.VaporKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(item2.LiquidKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.LiquidKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(item2.MixedKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.MixedKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				string uniqueOrificeNameFor = GetUniqueOrificeNameFor(item2.Name.VarValue);
				PsvOrifice psvOrifice = PsvOrifice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
				psvOrifice.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item2);
				psvOrifice.Name.Specify(uniqueOrificeNameFor, new UserSpecifier());
				_reliefOrifices.Add(psvOrifice);
				MergedOrificeMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item2).Record.RecordGuid(), psvOrifice);
			}
			foreach (AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice item3 in hashSet)
			{
				ReliefOrifice reliefOrifice = MergedOrificeMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item3.ReliefOrifice).Record.RecordGuid()];
				DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice2 = DetailedReliefDevice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
				detailedReliefDevice2.ReliefOrifice = reliefOrifice;
				detailedReliefDevice2.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item3);
				_customDetailedReliefDevices.Add(detailedReliefDevice2);
			}
		}

		private DetailedReliefDevice _FindMatchingDrdFor(AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice source)
		{
			foreach (DetailedReliefDevice customDetailedReliefDevice in CustomDetailedReliefDevices)
			{
				if (!(customDetailedReliefDevice.Name.Value != source.ReliefOrifice.Name.VarValue) && customDetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice.IsEquivalentTo(source.ReliefOrifice))
				{
					AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice val = ((AcsBase)customDetailedReliefDevice.DataModel).CastTo<AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice>();
					if (!MyMath.ValuesDiffer(((AcsSeProcessDouble)source.InletFlangeNominalDiameter).VarValue ?? double.NaN, ((AcsSeProcessDouble)val.InletFlangeNominalDiameter).VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10) && !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(source.InletRating.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.InletRating.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10) && !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(((AcsSeProcessDouble)source.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter).VarValue ?? double.NaN, ((AcsSeProcessDouble)val.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter).VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10) && !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(source.OutletRating.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.OutletRating.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
					{
						return customDetailedReliefDevice;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void _MergeFittingData(AcsSeCaseConfiguration otherConfig)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)otherConfig.PipeFittingTemplates).Length; i++)
			{
				if (i >= PipeFittingTemplates.Count)
				{
					flag2 = true;
					num = i;
					break;
				}
				AcsSePipeFittingTemplate val = otherConfig.PipeFittingTemplates.ValueAtLocation(i);
				PipeFittingTemplate pipeFittingTemplate = PipeFittingTemplates[i];
				if (val.Name.VarValue == pipeFittingTemplate.Name.Value)
				{
					MergedFittingMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val).Record.RecordGuid(), pipeFittingTemplate);
					continue;
				}
				flag = true;
				num = i;
				break;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				for (int j = num; j < ((AcsArrayBase)otherConfig.PipeFittingTemplates).Length; j++)
				{
					AcsSePipeFittingTemplate val2 = otherConfig.PipeFittingTemplates.ValueAtLocation(j);
					CreateBuiltInFitting((FittingName?)val2.NameId.VarValue, val2.LOverD.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val2.K.VarValue ?? double.NaN, (PressureDropCalculationType?)val2.DefaultPressureDropCalculationType.VarValue, val2.Notes.VarValue);
					PipeFittingTemplate value = PipeFittingTemplates.Last();
					MergedFittingMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val2).Record.RecordGuid(), value);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = num;
			IEnumerable<PipeFittingTemplate> source = PipeFittingTemplates.Skip(count);
			for (int k = num; k < ((AcsArrayBase)otherConfig.PipeFittingTemplates).Length; k++)
			{
				AcsSePipeFittingTemplate sourceTemplate = otherConfig.PipeFittingTemplates.ValueAtLocation(k);
				PipeFittingTemplate pipeFittingTemplate2 = source.LastOrDefault((PipeFittingTemplate ft) => ft.Name.Value == sourceTemplate.Name.VarValue);
				if (pipeFittingTemplate2 == null)
				{
					CreateBuiltInFitting((FittingName?)sourceTemplate.NameId.VarValue, sourceTemplate.LOverD.VarValue ?? double.NaN, sourceTemplate.K.VarValue ?? double.NaN, (PressureDropCalculationType?)sourceTemplate.DefaultPressureDropCalculationType.VarValue, sourceTemplate.Notes.VarValue);
					pipeFittingTemplate2 = PipeFittingTemplates.Last();
					source = PipeFittingTemplates.Skip(count);
				}
				MergedFittingMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)sourceTemplate).Record.RecordGuid(), pipeFittingTemplate2);
			}
		}

		private void _MergeMaterialData(AcsSeCaseConfiguration otherConfig)
		{
			if (PipeMaterials.Count != ((AcsArrayBase)otherConfig.PipeMaterials).Length)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)otherConfig.PipeMaterials).Length; i++)
			{
				AcsSePipeMaterial val = otherConfig.PipeMaterials.ValueAtLocation(i);
				PipeMaterial pipeMaterial = PipeMaterials[i];
				if (val.Name.VarValue != pipeMaterial.Name.Value)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				MergedMaterialMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val).Record.RecordGuid(), pipeMaterial);
			}
		}

	internal static class ConfigHelpers
	{
		public static void PropertyTransferFromModel(object modelObject, object configObject, PropertyInfo propInfo)
		{
			UnitOfMeasure unitOfMeasure = null;
			PrefsUnitsAttribute prefsUnitsAttribute = (PrefsUnitsAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsUnitsAttribute));
			if (prefsUnitsAttribute != null)
			{
				string value = prefsUnitsAttribute.Value;
				FieldInfo field = typeof(Units).GetField(value);
				unitOfMeasure = (UnitOfMeasure)field.GetValue(null);
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (modelObject is ProcessFraction processFraction)
			{
				PrefsPercentAttribute prefsPercentAttribute = (PrefsPercentAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsPercentAttribute));
				obj = ((prefsPercentAttribute == null) ? ((object)processFraction.Number) : ((object)processFraction.Percent));
			}
			else if (modelObject is IProcessVar<IQuantity> processVar)
			{
				if (unitOfMeasure == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: Attempted to write a preference value that is a dimensioned type without a specified unit value.");
				}
				obj = processVar.Value.ValueIn(unitOfMeasure);
			}
			else if (modelObject is ProcessPressure processPressure)
			{
				if (unitOfMeasure == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: Attempted to write a preference value that is a dimensioned type without a specified unit value.");
				}
				if (!(unitOfMeasure is PressureUnit))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: Attempted to write a preference value that is a pressure with non-pressure units specified.");
				}
				PressureReference pressureReference = PressureReference.Absolute;
				if (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsGaugePressure)) != null)
				{
					pressureReference = PressureReference.Gauge;
				}
				obj = processPressure.ValueIn((PressureUnit)unitOfMeasure, pressureReference);
			}
			else
			{
				PropertyInfo property = modelObject.GetType().GetProperty("Value");
				obj = property.GetMethod.Invoke(modelObject, new object[0]);
				if (_IsNullableType(propInfo.PropertyType))
				{
					obj = Convert.ChangeType(obj, Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propInfo.PropertyType));
				}
				else if (propInfo.PropertyType == typeof(string))
				{
					obj = ((obj == null) ? string.Empty : obj.ToString());
				}
			}
			propInfo.SetMethod.Invoke(configObject, new object[1] { obj });
		}

		public static void PropertyTransferToModel(object modelObject, object configObject, PropertyInfo propInfo)
		{
			UnitOfMeasure unitOfMeasure = null;
			PrefsUnitsAttribute prefsUnitsAttribute = (PrefsUnitsAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsUnitsAttribute));
			if (prefsUnitsAttribute != null)
			{
				string value = prefsUnitsAttribute.Value;
				FieldInfo field = typeof(Units).GetField(value);
				unitOfMeasure = (UnitOfMeasure)field.GetValue(null);
			}
			object obj = propInfo.GetMethod.Invoke(configObject, new object[0]);
			if (modelObject is ProcessFraction processFraction)
			{
				PrefsPercentAttribute prefsPercentAttribute = (PrefsPercentAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsPercentAttribute));
				if (prefsPercentAttribute != null)
				{
					processFraction.Specify((double)obj, Units.Percent, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				else
				{
					processFraction.Specify((double)obj, Units.One, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				return;
			}
			if (modelObject is IProcessVar<IQuantity>)
			{
				if (unitOfMeasure == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: Attempted to write a preference value that is a dimensioned type without a specified unit value.");
				}
				MethodInfo method = modelObject.GetType().GetMethod("Specify", new Type[3]
				{
					typeof(double),
					unitOfMeasure.GetType(),
					typeof(IVariableSpecifier)
				});
				method.Invoke(modelObject, new object[3]
				{
					obj,
					unitOfMeasure,
					new UserSpecifier()
				});
				return;
			}
			if (modelObject is ProcessPressure)
			{
				if (unitOfMeasure == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: Attempted to write a preference value that is a dimensioned type without a specified unit value.");
				}
				PressureReference pressureReference = PressureReference.Absolute;
				if (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsGaugePressure)) != null)
				{
					pressureReference = PressureReference.Gauge;
				}
				MethodInfo method2 = modelObject.GetType().GetMethod("Specify", new Type[4]
				{
					typeof(double),
					unitOfMeasure.GetType(),
					typeof(PressureReference),
					typeof(IVariableSpecifier)
				});
				method2.Invoke(modelObject, new object[4]
				{
					obj,
					unitOfMeasure,
					pressureReference,
					new UserSpecifier()
				});
				return;
			}
			MethodInfo method3 = modelObject.GetType().GetMethod("Specify");
			ParameterInfo parameterInfo = method3.GetParameters()[0];
			if (_IsNullableType(parameterInfo.ParameterType))
			{
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(parameterInfo.ParameterType);
				if (underlyingType.IsEnum)
				{
					if (propInfo.PropertyType == typeof(string))
					{
						try
						{
							obj = Enum.Parse(underlyingType, (string)obj);
						}
						catch (ArgumentException)
						{
							PrefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute prefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute = (PrefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propInfo, typeof(PrefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute));
							if (prefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute == null)
							{
								throw;
							}
							object value2 = typeof(EnumTranslators).GetField(prefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute.Value).GetValue(null);
							MethodInfo method4 = value2.GetType().GetMethod("Enum");
							obj = method4.Invoke(value2, new object[1] { obj });
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = Enum.ToObject(underlyingType, obj);
					}
				}
			}
			method3.Invoke(modelObject, new object[2]
			{
				obj,
				new UserSpecifier()
			});
		}

		private static bool _IsNullableType(Type type)
		{
			return type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition().Equals(typeof(Nullable<>));
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AttributedSectionBase : ConfigurationSection
	{
		private readonly ConfigurationPropertyCollection _Properties;

		protected override ConfigurationPropertyCollection Properties => _Properties;

		protected new ValueElement this[string Name]
		{
			get
			{
				return (ValueElement)base[Name];
			}
			set
			{
				base[Name] = value;
			}
		}

		public AttributedSectionBase()
		{
			base.SectionInformation.AllowExeDefinition = ConfigurationAllowExeDefinition.MachineToLocalUser;
			_Properties = new ConfigurationPropertyCollection();
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			foreach (PropertyInfo element in properties)
			{
				ConfigurationPropertyAttribute configurationPropertyAttribute = (ConfigurationPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(element, typeof(ConfigurationPropertyAttribute));
				if (configurationPropertyAttribute != null)
				{
					DefaultSettingValueAttribute defaultSettingValueAttribute = (DefaultSettingValueAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(element, typeof(DefaultSettingValueAttribute));
					if (defaultSettingValueAttribute == null)
					{
						ConfigurationProperty property = new ConfigurationProperty(configurationPropertyAttribute.Name, typeof(ValueElement));
						_Properties.Add(property);
						continue;
					}
					ConfigurationProperty property2 = new ConfigurationProperty(configurationPropertyAttribute.Name, typeof(ValueElement), new ValueElement
					{
						Value = defaultSettingValueAttribute.Value
					});
					_Properties.Add(property2);
					this[configurationPropertyAttribute.Name].Value = defaultSettingValueAttribute.Value;
				}
			}
			base.Init();
		}

		public void TransferFromModel(SafetyAnalysisCase theCase)
		{
			if (theCase == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theCase");
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				ConfigurationPropertyAttribute configurationPropertyAttribute = (ConfigurationPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(ConfigurationPropertyAttribute));
				if (configurationPropertyAttribute == null)
				{
					continue;
				}

					BaseRemoveAt(index);

			}
		}

		protected override ConfigurationElement CreateNewElement()
		{

		}

		}

	internal abstract class AttributedCollectionSection<TCollection, TElement> : ConfigurationSection where TCollection : AttributedCollection<TElement> where TElement : ConfigurationElement, new()
	{
		private readonly ConfigurationPropertyCollection _Properties;

		protected override ConfigurationPropertyCollection Properties => _Properties;

		protected new TCollection this[string Name]
		{

		public AttributedCollectionSection()
		{

				if (configurationPropertyAttribute != null)

					_Properties.Add(property);
				}
			}
			base.Init();
		}

		protected void DoReflectionLookup(PropertyInfo iPropInfo, List<(PropertyInfo propInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute memAttr, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute argPosAttr)> props, out PropertyInfo index, out PropertyInfo marker)
		{
			index = null;
			marker = null;
			PropertyInfo[] properties = typeof(TElement).GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				ConfigurationPropertyAttribute configurationPropertyAttribute = (ConfigurationPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(ConfigurationPropertyAttribute));
				if (configurationPropertyAttribute == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				RefIndexPropertyAttribute refIndexPropertyAttribute = (RefIndexPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(RefIndexPropertyAttribute));
				PrefsMarkerPropertyAttribute prefsMarkerPropertyAttribute = (PrefsMarkerPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(PrefsMarkerPropertyAttribute));
				if (refIndexPropertyAttribute != null)
				{
					index = propertyInfo;
					continue;
				}
				if (prefsMarkerPropertyAttribute != null)
				{
					marker = propertyInfo;
					continue;
				}
				PrefsMemberNameAttribute prefsMemberNameAttribute = (PrefsMemberNameAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(PrefsMemberNameAttribute));
				if (prefsMemberNameAttribute != null)
				{
					PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute item = (PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute));
					props.Add((propertyInfo, prefsMemberNameAttribute, item));
				}
			}
			if (index == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Type {typeof(TElement).Name} failed to provide a property with the RefIndexProperty attribute.");
			}
			if (index.PropertyType != typeof(int))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException($"Property {index.Name} in type {typeof(TElement).Name} is marked as the index property, but is not of type int (type is {index.PropertyType.Name}).");
			}
		}

		public void TransferFromModel(SafetyAnalysisCase theCase)
		{
			if (theCase == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theCase");
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				ConfigurationPropertyAttribute configurationPropertyAttribute = (ConfigurationPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(ConfigurationPropertyAttribute));
				if (configurationPropertyAttribute == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PrefsCollectionNameAttribute prefsCollectionNameAttribute = (PrefsCollectionNameAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(PrefsCollectionNameAttribute));
				if (prefsCollectionNameAttribute == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"Type {typeof(TCollection).Name} failed to provide a property with the PrefsCollectionName attribute.");
				}
				List<(PropertyInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute)> list = new List<(PropertyInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute)>();
				PropertyInfo index = null;
				PropertyInfo marker = null;
				DoReflectionLookup(propertyInfo, list, out index, out marker);
				TCollection val = (TCollection)propertyInfo.GetMethod.Invoke(this, new object[0]);
				val.Clear();
				PropertyInfo property = theCase.Configuration.GetType().GetProperty(prefsCollectionNameAttribute.Value);
				object obj = property.GetMethod.Invoke(theCase.Configuration, new object[0]);
				IEnumerable enumerable = (IEnumerable)obj;
				Type type = property.PropertyType.GetGenericArguments()[0];
				int num = -1;
				foreach (object item2 in enumerable)
				{
					num++;
					TElement val2 = new TElement();
					index.SetMethod.Invoke(val2, new object[1] { num });
					marker.SetMethod.Invoke(val2, new object[1] { true });
					foreach (var item3 in list)
					{
						PropertyInfo item = item3.Item1;
						PropertyInfo property2 = type.GetProperty(item3.Item2.Value, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
						object modelObject = property2.GetMethod.Invoke(item2, new object[0]);
						ConfigHelpers.PropertyTransferFromModel(modelObject, val2, item);
					}
					val.Add(val2);
				}
			}
		}

		public void TransferToModel(SafetyAnalysisCase theCase)
		{
			if (theCase == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("theCase");
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				ConfigurationPropertyAttribute configurationPropertyAttribute = (ConfigurationPropertyAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(ConfigurationPropertyAttribute));
				if (configurationPropertyAttribute == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PrefsClearCollectionMethodNameAttribute prefsClearCollectionMethodNameAttribute = (PrefsClearCollectionMethodNameAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(PrefsClearCollectionMethodNameAttribute));
				if (prefsClearCollectionMethodNameAttribute != null)
				{
					MethodInfo method = theCase.Configuration.GetType().GetMethod(prefsClearCollectionMethodNameAttribute.Value, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					method.Invoke(theCase.Configuration, new object[0]);
				}
				PrefsMemberNameAttribute prefsMemberNameAttribute = (PrefsMemberNameAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo, typeof(PrefsMemberNameAttribute));
				if (prefsMemberNameAttribute == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"Type {typeof(TCollection).Name} failed to provide a property with the PrefsMemberName attribute.");
				}
				MethodInfo method2 = theCase.Configuration.GetType().GetMethod(prefsMemberNameAttribute.Value);
				List<(PropertyInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute)> list = new List<(PropertyInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute)>();
				PropertyInfo index = null;
				PropertyInfo marker = null;
				DoReflectionLookup(propertyInfo, list, out index, out marker);
				MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetMethod;
				TCollection val = (TCollection)getMethod.Invoke(this, new object[0]);
				foreach (object item6 in val)
				{
					object obj = marker.GetMethod.Invoke(item6, new object[0]);
					if (!(bool)obj)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Dictionary<int, PropertyInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, PropertyInfo>();
					foreach (var item7 in list)
					{
						if (item7.Item3 != null)
						{
							dictionary.Add(int.Parse(item7.Item3.Value), item7.Item1);
						}
					}
					ParameterInfo[] parameters = method2.GetParameters();
					List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
					for (int j = 0; j < parameters.Length; j++)
					{
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(j))
						{
							if (parameters[j].IsOptional)
							{
								list2.Add(Type.Missing);
								continue;
							}
							throw new InvalidOperationException($"Type {typeof(TElement).Name} failed to provide an argument in position {j}.");
						}
						PropertyInfo propertyInfo2 = dictionary[j];
						Type parameterType = parameters[j].ParameterType;
						UnitOfMeasure unitOfMeasure = null;
						PrefsUnitsAttribute prefsUnitsAttribute = (PrefsUnitsAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo2, typeof(PrefsUnitsAttribute));
						if (prefsUnitsAttribute != null)
						{
							string value = prefsUnitsAttribute.Value;
							FieldInfo field = typeof(Units).GetField(value);
							unitOfMeasure = (UnitOfMeasure)field.GetValue(null);
						}
						object obj2 = propertyInfo2.GetMethod.Invoke(item6, new object[0]);
						PrefsUniqueValueMemberAttribute prefsUniqueValueMemberAttribute = (PrefsUniqueValueMemberAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo2, typeof(PrefsUniqueValueMemberAttribute));
						if (prefsUniqueValueMemberAttribute != null)
						{
							MethodInfo method3 = theCase.Configuration.GetType().GetMethod(prefsUniqueValueMemberAttribute.Value);
							string text = (string)obj2;
							if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
							{
								PrefsAlternateNameAttribute altAttr = (PrefsAlternateNameAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo2, typeof(PrefsAlternateNameAttribute));
								if (altAttr != null)
								{
									(PropertyInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute) tuple = list.SingleOrDefault<(PropertyInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute)>(((PropertyInfo propInfo, PrefsMemberNameAttribute memAttr, PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute argPosAttr) x) => x.memAttr.Value == altAttr.Value);
									PropertyInfo item = tuple.Item1;
									PrefsMemberNameAttribute item2 = tuple.Item2;
									PrefsArgumentPositionAttribute item3 = tuple.Item3;
									object obj3 = item?.GetMethod?.Invoke(item6, new object[0]);
									text = (string)obj3;
								}
							}
							if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
							{
								text = "New";
							}
							while (!(bool)method3.Invoke(theCase.Configuration, new object[1] { text }))
							{
								text += "*";
							}
							obj2 = text;
						}
						if (parameterType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(string)))
						{
							list2.Add((string)obj2);
							continue;
						}
						if (parameterType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(double)))
						{
							list2.Add((double)obj2);
							continue;
						}
						if (_IsNullableType(parameterType))
						{
							Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(parameterType);
							if (!underlyingType.IsEnum)
							{
								continue;
							}
							try
							{
								obj2 = Enum.Parse(underlyingType, (string)obj2);
							}
							catch (ArgumentException)
							{
								PrefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute prefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute = (PrefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(propertyInfo2, typeof(PrefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute));
								if (prefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute == null)
								{
									obj2 = null;
								}
								else
								{
									object value2 = typeof(EnumTranslators).GetField(prefsUseEnumTranslatorAttribute.Value).GetValue(null);
									MethodInfo method4 = value2.GetType().GetMethod("Enum");
									obj2 = method4.Invoke(value2, new object[1] { obj2 });
								}
							}
							list2.Add(obj2);
							continue;
						}
						ConstructorInfo[] constructors = parameterType.GetConstructors();
						ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = null;
						ConstructorInfo[] array = constructors;
						foreach (ConstructorInfo constructorInfo2 in array)
						{
							if (constructorInfo2.GetParameters().Length == 2 && constructorInfo2.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType == typeof(double))
							{
								constructorInfo = constructorInfo2;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (constructorInfo == null)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException($"Parameter in position {j} is not a string or enum and does not have a ctor with (double, object) signature.");
						}
						object item4 = constructorInfo.Invoke(new object[2] { obj2, unitOfMeasure });
						list2.Add(item4);
					}
					object obj4 = method2.Invoke(theCase.Configuration, list2.ToArray());
					foreach (var item8 in list)
					{
						if (item8.Item3 == null)
						{
							PropertyInfo item5 = item8.Item1;
							PropertyInfo property = obj4.GetType().GetProperty(item8.Item2.Value);
							object modelObject = property.GetMethod.Invoke(obj4, new object[0]);
							ConfigHelpers.PropertyTransferToModel(modelObject, item6, item5);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool _IsNullableType(Type type)
		{
			return type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition().Equals(typeof(Nullable<>));
		}

	public sealed class ImportExportException : Exception
	{
		public enum ErrorClassification
		{
			Unknown,
			MissingSectionGroup,
			MissingSection
		}

		public ErrorClassification ErrorType { get; private set; }

		public string Filename { get; private set; }

		public string Reference { get; private set; }

		public ImportExportException(ErrorClassification errorType, string filename, string reference = null)
		{
			ErrorType = errorType;
			Filename = filename;
			Reference = reference ?? string.Empty;
		}
	}
	internal static class DefaultValuesImportExport
	{
		private static IEnumerable<XElement> _DepthFirstEnumWhere(IEnumerable<XElement> parent, Func<XElement, bool> match)
		{
			Stack<IEnumerator<XElement>> prev = new Stack<IEnumerator<XElement>>();
			IEnumerator<XElement> current = parent.GetEnumerator();
			while (true)
			{
				bool canAdvance = current.MoveNext();
				while (!canAdvance && prev.Count > 0)
				{
					current = prev.Pop();
					canAdvance = current.MoveNext();
				}
				if (!canAdvance)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (match(current.Current))
				{
					yield return current.Current;
				}
				if (current.Current.HasElements)
				{
					prev.Push(current);
					current = current.Current.Elements().GetEnumerator();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ExportDefaultsToFile(string path, SafetyAnalysisCase theCase)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("path");
			}
			if (theCase == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theCase");
			}
			Configuration configuration = ConfigurationManager.OpenExeConfiguration(ConfigurationUserLevel.PerUserRoamingAndLocal);
			configuration.SectionGroups.Clear();
			ConfigurationSectionGroup configurationSectionGroup = new ConfigurationSectionGroup();
			ConfigurationSectionGroup configurationSectionGroup2 = new ConfigurationSectionGroup();
			configuration.SectionGroups.Add("PSV.Defaults", configurationSectionGroup);
			configurationSectionGroup.SectionGroups.Add("ScenarioDefaults", configurationSectionGroup2);
			VersionInfoSection versionInfoSection = new VersionInfoSection();
			versionInfoSection.Version = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(DefaultValuesImportExport)).GetName().Version;
			configurationSectionGroup.Sections.Add("VersionInfo", versionInfoSection);
			GeneralSettingsSection generalSettingsSection = new GeneralSettingsSection();
			generalSettingsSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup.Sections.Add("GeneralSettings", generalSettingsSection);
			GeneralDefaultSection generalDefaultSection = new GeneralDefaultSection();
			generalDefaultSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup.Sections.Add("GeneralDefaults", generalDefaultSection);
			LineSizingDefaultSection lineSizingDefaultSection = new LineSizingDefaultSection();
			lineSizingDefaultSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup.Sections.Add("LineSizing", lineSizingDefaultSection);
			TankDefaultSection tankDefaultSection = new TankDefaultSection();
			tankDefaultSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup.Sections.Add("Tanks", tankDefaultSection);
			ControlValveDefaultSection controlValveDefaultSection = new ControlValveDefaultSection();
			controlValveDefaultSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup2.Sections.Add("ControlValveFailure", controlValveDefaultSection);
			FireDefaultSection fireDefaultSection = new FireDefaultSection();
			fireDefaultSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup2.Sections.Add("Fire", fireDefaultSection);
			ExchangerTubeRuptureDefaultSection exchangerTubeRuptureDefaultSection = new ExchangerTubeRuptureDefaultSection();
			exchangerTubeRuptureDefaultSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup2.Sections.Add("ExchangerTubeRupture", exchangerTubeRuptureDefaultSection);
			OrificeSettingsSection orificeSettingsSection = new OrificeSettingsSection();
			orificeSettingsSection.TransferFromModel(theCase);
			configurationSectionGroup.Sections.Add("OrificeSettings", orificeSettingsSection);
			configuration.SaveAs(path, ConfigurationSaveMode.Full);
		}

		internal static void ImportDefaultsFromFile(string path, SafetyAnalysisCase theCase, ref string loadVersion, out IEnumerable<string> warningSections, out IEnumerable<string> warningMessages)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("path");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			warningSections = list;
			warningMessages = list2;
			XElement xElement = XElement.Load(path);
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = _DepthFirstEnumWhere(xElement.Elements("configSections"), (XElement el) => el.Attribute("type") != null && ((string)el.Attribute("type")).StartsWith("AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.PSVDatabase"));
			try
			{
				if (enumerable.Any())
				{
					Assembly executingAssembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
					string fullName = executingAssembly.FullName;
					foreach (XElement item8 in enumerable)
					{
						string text = (string)item8.Attribute("type");
						string text2 = text.Split(new char[1] { ',' }, 2)[0];
						string value = text2.Replace("PSVDatabase", "Models") + ", " + fullName;
						item8.SetAttributeValue("type", value);
					}
					path = Path.GetTempFileName();
					xElement.Save(path);
					flag = true;
				}
				ExeConfigurationFileMap fileMap = new ExeConfigurationFileMap
				{
					ExeConfigFilename = path
				};
				Configuration configuration = ConfigurationManager.OpenMappedExeConfiguration(fileMap, ConfigurationUserLevel.None);
				ConfigurationSectionGroup configurationSectionGroup = null;
				try
				{
					configurationSectionGroup = configuration.GetSectionGroup("PSV.Defaults");
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
					string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
					throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSectionGroup, fileName, "PSV.Defaults");
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					string fileName2 = Path.GetFileName(path);
					throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.Unknown, fileName2, ex2.Message);
				}
				Version version = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(DefaultValuesImportExport)).GetName().Version;
				VersionInfoSection versionInfoSection = configurationSectionGroup.Sections["VersionInfo"] as VersionInfoSection;
				Version version2 = versionInfoSection.Version;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (version != version2 && version2.Major > version.Major)
				{
					loadVersion = version2.ToString();
					flag2 = true;
				}
				List<AttributedSectionBase> list3 = new List<AttributedSectionBase>();
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup.Sections["GeneralSettings"] is GeneralSettingsSection item))
					{
						string fileName3 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName3, "GeneralSettings");
					}
					list3.Add(item);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex3)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("GeneralSettings");
					list2.Add(ex3.Message);
				}
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup.Sections["GeneralDefaults"] is GeneralDefaultSection item2))
					{
						string fileName4 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName4, "GeneralDefaults");
					}
					list3.Add(item2);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex4)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("GeneralDefaults");
					list2.Add(ex4.Message);
				}
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup.Sections["LineSizing"] is LineSizingDefaultSection item3))
					{
						string fileName5 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName5, "LineSizing");
					}
					list3.Add(item3);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex5)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("LineSizing");
					list2.Add(ex5.Message);
				}
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup.Sections["Tanks"] is TankDefaultSection item4))
					{
						string fileName6 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName6, "Tanks");
					}
					list3.Add(item4);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex6)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("Tanks");
					list2.Add(ex6.Message);
				}
				ConfigurationSectionGroup configurationSectionGroup2 = configurationSectionGroup.SectionGroups["ScenarioDefaults"];
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup2.Sections["ControlValveFailure"] is ControlValveDefaultSection item5))
					{
						string fileName7 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName7, "ControlValveFailure");
					}
					list3.Add(item5);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex7)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("ControlValveFailure");
					list2.Add(ex7.Message);
				}
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup2.Sections["Fire"] is FireDefaultSection item6))
					{
						string fileName8 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName8, "Fire");
					}
					list3.Add(item6);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex8)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("Fire");
					list2.Add(ex8.Message);
				}
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup2.Sections["ExchangerTubeRupture"] is ExchangerTubeRuptureDefaultSection item7))
					{
						string fileName9 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName9, "ExchangerTubeRupture");
					}
					list3.Add(item7);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex9)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw;
					}
					list.Add("ExchangerTubeRupture");
					list2.Add(ex9.Message);
				}
				foreach (AttributedSectionBase item9 in list3)
				{
					try
					{
						item9.TransferToModel(theCase);
					}
					catch (TargetInvocationException ex10) when (ex10.InnerException is FormatException)
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							list.Add(item9.SectionInformation.Name);
							list2.Add(ex10.InnerException.Message);
							continue;
						}
						throw;
					}
				}
				try
				{
					if (!(configurationSectionGroup.Sections["OrificeSettings"] is OrificeSettingsSection orificeSettingsSection))
					{
						string fileName10 = Path.GetFileName(path);
						throw new ImportExportException(ImportExportException.ErrorClassification.MissingSection, fileName10, "OrificeSettings");
					}
					orificeSettingsSection.TransferToModel(theCase);
				}
				catch (ConfigurationErrorsException ex11)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						list.Add("OrificeSettings");
						list2.Add(ex11.Message);
						return;
					}
					throw;
				}
				catch (TargetInvocationException ex12) when (ex12.InnerException is FormatException)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						list.Add("OrificeSettings");
						list2.Add(ex12.InnerException.Message);
						return;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				try
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						File.Delete(path);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public static DischargeLocation CreateNew(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSeDischargeLocation val = new AcsSeDischargeLocation(adbTop);
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = ModelRegistry.GetModelRegistry(adbTop);
			DischargeLocation dischargeLocation = new DischargeLocation(modelRegistry, val);
			dischargeLocation.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			((AcsSeBaseModel)val).ModelTypeGuid = ModelBuilder.DischargeLocationGuid.ToString("D");
			dischargeLocation.Initialize();
			dischargeLocation.UpdateVersionNumber();
			dischargeLocation.ResetProcessVars();
			dischargeLocation.CustomCreateNew();
			modelRegistry.RegisterNewModel(dischargeLocation);
			return dischargeLocation;
		}

	public class MockedKeyUpdateException : ArgumentException
	{
		public readonly object OldKey;

		public readonly IReferenceable Value;

		public MockedKeyUpdateException(object oldKey, IReferenceable value, Exception innerException = null)
			: base("Cannot re-key a value because new key is not unique", "value", innerException)
		{
			OldKey = oldKey;
			Value = value;
		}
	}
	internal class OverpressureUpdater : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		private static OverpressureUpdater _overpressureUpdater;

		private OverpressureUpdater()
		{
		}

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			if (variable.Model is PrdConstraintsDefinition)
			{
				UpdateOverpressure((PrdConstraintsDefinition)variable.Model);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(variable.Model is ReliefDescription))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (PrdConstraintsDefinition item in ((ReliefDescription)variable.Model).GetReliefScenarios().SelectMany((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.PrdConstraints.Values))
				{
					UpdateOverpressure(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ReliefDeviceConfigurationChanged(ReliefDeviceConfiguration rdc)
		{
			foreach (PrdConstraintsDefinition item in rdc.PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefScenarios.Where((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.ReliefDeviceConfiguration == rdc).SelectMany((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.PrdConstraints.Values))
			{
				UpdateOverpressure(item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOverpressure(PrdConstraintsDefinition pcd)
		{
			if (pcd != null && !(pcd.UseCustomOverpressure.Value ?? true) && pcd.ReliefScenario != null && pcd.ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Count != 0)
			{
				if (pcd.IsForControllingDevice())
				{
					pcd.AllowableOverpressure.Specify(OverpressureDefaultCalculator.GetDefaultOverpressure(pcd), Units.One, this);
				}
				else if (pcd.ReliefScenario.ReliefPressure.Value.IsValid && pcd.ReliefDevice != null && pcd.ReliefDevice.SetPressure.Value.IsValid)
				{
					double num = pcd.ReliefScenario.ReliefPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
					double num2 = pcd.ReliefDevice.SetPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Gauge);
					double value = num / num2 - 1.0;
					pcd.AllowableOverpressure.Specify(new Fraction(value, Units.One), this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static OverpressureUpdater GetSingleton()
		{
			if (_overpressureUpdater == null)
			{
				_overpressureUpdater = new OverpressureUpdater();
			}
			return _overpressureUpdater;
		}
	}
	public static class OverpressureDefaultCalculator
	{
		public static double GetDefaultOverpressure(PrdConstraintsDefinition pcd, CaseConfiguration caseConfig = null, bool forceSingleDevice = false)
		{
			if (caseConfig == null)
			{
				caseConfig = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration;
			}
			if (pcd.ReliefScenario.ReliefDescription.EmergencyType.Value == EmergScenarioType.Fire)
			{
				return caseConfig.FireOverpressureFraction.Number;
			}
			if (pcd.ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Count == 1 || forceSingleDevice)
			{
				return caseConfig.SingleValveOverpressureFraction.Number;
			}
			return caseConfig.MultiValveOverpressureFraction.Number;
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown

			//IL_007c: Expected O, but got Unknown

			//IL_0098: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				PftDataModel.Name = new AcsSeProcessString(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				PftDataModel.LOverD = new AcsSeProcessDouble(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				PftDataModel.K = new AcsSeProcessDouble(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				PftDataModel.DefaultPressureDropCalculationType = new AcsSeProcessInt(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				PftDataModel.Notes = new AcsSeProcessString(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);

			K = new ProcessDouble(this, PftDataModel.K, Guid.ParseExact("F4B2EF05-14A5-457B-BAB6-1ECB6AC24F53", "D"));

	public class ProcessDoubleArray : ProcessVariable, IEnumerable<double>, IEnumerable
	{
		private AcsSeProcessDoubleArray DaDataModel
		{
			get
			{
				AcsSeProcessVar dataModel = DataModel;
				return (AcsSeProcessDoubleArray)(object)((dataModel is AcsSeProcessDoubleArray) ? dataModel : null);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsValid => !IsEmpty;

		public override bool IsEmpty => ((AcsArrayBase)DaDataModel.Values).Length == 0;

		public int Length => ((AcsArrayBase)DaDataModel.Values).Length;

		public double[] Values
		{
			get
			{
				double[] array = new double[((AcsArrayBase)DaDataModel.Values).Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = DaDataModel.Values.ValueAtLocation(i);
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public double this[int i] => DaDataModel.Values.ValueAtLocation(i);

		public ProcessDoubleArray(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessDoubleArray dataModel, Guid fieldIdent)
			: base(model, (AcsSeProcessVar)(object)dataModel, fieldIdent)
		{
		}

		public bool Specify(double[] values, IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			_source = specifier;
			base.SpecifierType = ((Source != null) ? Source.SpecifierType : SpecifierType.Unspecified);
			if (base.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
			{
			}
			DaDataModel.Values.Clear(false);
			foreach (double num in values)
			{
				DaDataModel.Values.Append((AcsNoId)null, num);
			}
			BroadcastChange();
			return true;
		}

		public override void Reset(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			Clear(specifier);
		}

		public override void Clear(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			Specify(new double[0], specifier);
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			try
			{
				Specify((double[])processVariable.GetValue(), processVariable);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return Values;
		}

		public IEnumerator<double> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<double>)Values).GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class ProcessEnum<T> : ProcessStoredInt<T?> where T : struct, IConvertible
	{
		public IReadOnlyCollection<T?> AvailableValues { get; set; }

		public ProcessEnum(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessInt dataModel, Guid fieldIdent, IProcessVar<T?> defaultValueVar = null, IEnumerable<T> availableValues = null)
			: base(model, dataModel, fieldIdent, defaultValueVar)
		{
			if (availableValues == null)
			{
				availableValues = Enum.GetValues(typeof(T)).Cast<T>();
			}
			AvailableValues = availableValues.Cast<T?>().ToList();
		}

		public override bool WouldBeValid(T? value)
		{
			return AvailableValues.Contains(value);
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			object value = processVariable.GetValue();
			if (value != null && value.GetType().IsEnum && !typeof(T).IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				Clear(processVariable);
			}
			else
			{
				T value2 = (T)value;
				Specify(value2, processVariable);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override T? ConvertFromUnderlying(int? value)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				try
				{
					return (T)Enum.ToObject(typeof(T), value.Value);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
					StoredValue = null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override int? ConvertToUnderlying(T? value)
		{
			return value.HasValue ? new int?(value.Value.ToInt32(null)) : ((int?)null);
		}
	}

		public void InitializeFrom(BaseModel model)
		{
			Initialize();
			CustomInitialize();
			foreach (PropertyInfo item in from p in GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public)
				where p.PropertyType.IsInstanceOfType(typeof(IProcessVariable))
				select p)
			{
				IProcessVariable processVariable = (IProcessVariable)item.GetValue(model);
				if (processVariable.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
				{
					bool flag = ((IProcessVariable)item.GetValue(this)).TrySpecifyFrom(processVariable);
				}
			}
			throw new NotImplementedException("2 TODOs remaining");
		}

		public virtual void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties();
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				if (propertyInfo.GetValue(model) is IProcessVariable processVariable && (!onlyUserSpecified || processVariable.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User))
				{
					bool flag = ((IProcessVariable)propertyInfo.GetValue(this)).TrySpecifyFrom(processVariable);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			if (!sourceRecord.CanCastTo(((AcsBase)DataModel).ClassGuid))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Trying to copy from a record that is a different type than myself!");
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties();
			string text = default(string);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				if (propertyInfo.GetValue(this) is AbstractProcessVariable abstractProcessVariable)
				{
					IAdbRecord val = ((AcsBaseRecord)sourceRecord).Record.ScalarReference(abstractProcessVariable.FieldIdent.ToString("D"));
					if (val == null)
					{
						abstractProcessVariable.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					else if (propertyInfo.GetValue(this) is ProcessPressure processPressure)
					{
						_ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper readOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper = new _ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper(val);
						object value = readOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper.GetValue();
						object obj = val.ScalarValue("251CECB9-9154-46DD-A3B5-F2CD5213A861", ref text);
						processPressure.Specify(((double?)value) ?? double.NaN, UnitTypes.Pressure.InnateUnit, (PressureReference)obj, readOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper);
					}
					else
					{
						abstractProcessVariable.TrySpecifyFrom(new _ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper(val));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopyFromOtherDatabase(BaseModel sourceModel)
		{
			CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)sourceModel.DataModel);
		}

		[NotifyPropertyChangedInvocator]
		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected bool IsSameMessage(Message testMessage, MessageLevel level, MessageLocation location, string message, IBaseModel refObject)
		{
			if (testMessage.IsBeingDeleted)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (testMessage.Level.Value.GetValueOrDefault() != level)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (location != MessageLocation.Anywhere)
			{
				MessageLocation valueOrDefault = testMessage.Location.Value.GetValueOrDefault();
				if (valueOrDefault != MessageLocation.Anywhere && valueOrDefault != location)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (testMessage.MessageText.Value != message)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (testMessage.RefObject != refObject)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsMatchingMessage(Message testMessage, MessageLevel? level = null, string message = null, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.Anywhere, IEnumerable<MessageLocation> exceptLocation = null, IBaseModel refObject = null)
		{
			if (testMessage.IsBeingDeleted)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (level.HasValue && testMessage.Level.Value != level)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (location != MessageLocation.Anywhere)
			{
				MessageLocation valueOrDefault = testMessage.Location.Value.GetValueOrDefault();
				if (valueOrDefault != MessageLocation.Anywhere && valueOrDefault != location)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (exceptLocation != null && exceptLocation.Contains(testMessage.Location.Value.GetValueOrDefault()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(message) && testMessage.MessageText.Value != message)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (refObject != null && testMessage.RefObject != refObject)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public struct CalculationMessage
	{
		public CalculationMessageType Type { get; private set; }

		public string Message { get; private set; }

		public CalculationMessage(CalculationMessageType messageType, string message)
		{
			this = default(CalculationMessage);
			Type = messageType;
			Message = message;
		}

		public bool Equals(CalculationMessage other)
		{
			return Type == other.Type && string.Equals(Message, other.Message);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return obj is CalculationMessage && Equals((CalculationMessage)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ((int)Type * 397) ^ ((Message != null) ? Message.GetHashCode() : 0);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CalculationMessage lhs, CalculationMessage rhs)
		{
			return lhs.Type == rhs.Type && lhs.Message == rhs.Message;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CalculationMessage lhs, CalculationMessage rhs)
		{
			return !(lhs == rhs);
		}
	}
	public class CalculationMessageList
	{
		internal class MessageTuple
		{
			public readonly CalculationMessage Message;

			public readonly string CalculationName;

			internal MessageTuple(CalculationMessage message, string calculationName)
			{
				Message = message;
				CalculationName = calculationName;
			}
		}

		private readonly List<MessageTuple> _messages = new List<MessageTuple>();

		public BaseModel Model { get; private set; }

		public int Count => _messages.Count;

		public CalculationMessage this[int index] => _messages[index].Message;

		public CalculationMessageList(BaseModel model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		public IEnumerator<CalculationMessage> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _messages.Select((MessageTuple t) => t.Message).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(CalculationRunner runner, CalculationMessage message)
		{
			_messages.Add(new MessageTuple(message, runner.Name));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(CalculationMessage item)
		{
			return _messages.Select((MessageTuple t) => t.Message).Contains(item);
		}

		public bool ContainsError()
		{
			return _messages.Any((MessageTuple t) => t.Message.Type == CalculationMessageType.Error);
		}

		public bool ContainsWarning()
		{
			return _messages.Any((MessageTuple t) => t.Message.Type == CalculationMessageType.Warning);
		}

		public bool Remove(CalculationMessage message)
		{
			MessageTuple messageTuple = _find(message);
			return messageTuple != null && _messages.Remove(messageTuple);
		}

		public int RemoveMessagesFrom(string calculationName)
		{
			return _messages.RemoveAll((MessageTuple t) => t.CalculationName == calculationName);
		}

		private MessageTuple _find(CalculationMessage message)
		{
			return _messages.SingleOrDefault((MessageTuple t) => t.Message == message);
		}

		public int IndexOf(CalculationMessage item)
		{
			return _messages.IndexOf(_find(item));
		}
	}
	public abstract class CalculationRunner : ICalculationRunner, IProcessAction, IVariableSpecifier
	{
		protected readonly List<IProcessVariable> _inputs = new List<IProcessVariable>();

		protected readonly List<IProcessVariable> _outputs = new List<IProcessVariable>();

		public abstract string Name { get; }

		public BaseModel Model { get; private set; }

		public virtual SpecifierType SpecifierType => SpecifierType.Calculation;

		public IReadOnlyList<IProcessVariable> Inputs => _inputs;

		public IReadOnlyList<IProcessVariable> Outputs => _outputs;

		public abstract int CurrentVersion { get; }

		protected CalculationRunner(BaseModel model)
		{
			Model = model;
		}

		public abstract void Execute();

		public bool Disconnect(IProcessVariable processVar)
		{
			bool flag = _inputs.Remove(processVar);
			return _outputs.Remove(processVar) || flag;
		}

		public void InputChanged(IProcessVariable processVar)
		{
			if (CanSetOutputs() && InputsComplete())
			{
				PushCalculationRunner();
			}
		}

		public bool CanSetOutputs()
		{
			return _outputs.All((IProcessVariable pVar) => pVar.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User && (pVar.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.Calculation || pVar.Source == this));
		}

		public void ClearOutputs()
		{
			foreach (IProcessVariable output in _outputs)
			{
				output.Clear(this);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool InputsComplete()
		{
			return _inputs.All((IProcessVariable pVar) => !pVar.IsEmpty);
		}

		protected void PushCalculationRunner()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class AmbientPressureUpdater : ProcessConfigUpdater

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			if (variable.Model is CaseConfiguration { AmbientPressure: var ambientPressure })

				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}

			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}

		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			ValveMaker.AddAffectedProcessAction(ControlValveDescriptionUpdater.GetSingleton());
			ValveTypeValue.AddAffectedProcessAction(ControlValveDescriptionUpdater.GetSingleton());
		}

		protected override void CustomCreateNew()
		{
			base.CustomCreateNew();
			UpstreamFluid = Fluid.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			ReliefFluid = Fluid.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredControlValveFailureRevision < 1 && !ValveTypeValue.IsEmpty && !ValveMaker.IsEmpty)
			{
				ControlValveMaker valueOrDefault = ValveMaker.Value.GetValueOrDefault();
				int valueOrDefault2 = ValveTypeValue.Value.GetValueOrDefault();
				ValveTypeDescription.Specify(ValveTypeRepository.GetValveType(valueOrDefault, valueOrDefault2).Name, new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
			if (StoredControlValveFailureRevision < 2)
			{
				if (!ReliefFluid.VaporPressure.IsEmpty)
				{
					double value = ReliefFluid.VaporPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute);
					ReliefFluid.VaporPressure.Specify(value, Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				if (!ReliefFluid.CriticalPressure.IsEmpty)
				{
					double value2 = ReliefFluid.CriticalPressure.ValueIn(Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute);
					ReliefFluid.CriticalPressure.Specify(value2, Units.bar, PressureReference.Absolute, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

			ReliefFluid.CopyFrom(controlValveFailure.ReliefFluid, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		}

	internal class ControlValveDescriptionUpdater : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		private static Lazy<ControlValveDescriptionUpdater> _controlValveDescriptionUpdater = new Lazy<ControlValveDescriptionUpdater>(() => new ControlValveDescriptionUpdater());

		private ControlValveDescriptionUpdater()
		{
		}

		internal static ControlValveDescriptionUpdater GetSingleton()
		{
			return _controlValveDescriptionUpdater.Value;
		}

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			if (variable.Model is ControlValveFailure controlValveFailure)
			{
				ControlValveMaker? value = controlValveFailure.ValveMaker.Value;
				int? value2 = controlValveFailure.ValveTypeValue.Value;
				if (value.HasValue && value2.HasValue)
				{
					controlValveFailure.ValveTypeDescription.Specify(ControlValveFailure.ValveTypeRepository.GetValveType(value.GetValueOrDefault(), value2.GetValueOrDefault()).Name, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				else
				{
					controlValveFailure.ValveTypeDescription.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}

		public IEnumerable<ControlValveType> GetValveTypes(ControlValveMaker maker)
		{
			return _types.Where((ControlValveType t) => t.Maker == maker);
		}

		public ControlValveType GetValveType(ControlValveMaker maker, string name)
		{
			return _types.SingleOrDefault((ControlValveType t) => t.Maker == maker && t.Name == name);
		}

		public ControlValveType GetValveType(Guid id)
		{
			return _types.SingleOrDefault((ControlValveType t) => t.ID == id);
		}

		public ControlValveType GetValveType(ControlValveMaker maker, int calcID)
		{
			return _types.SingleOrDefault((ControlValveType t) => t.Maker == maker && t.CalcID == calcID);
		}
	}
	public struct ControlValveType
	{
		public readonly ControlValveMaker Maker;

		public readonly string Name;

		public readonly int CalcID;

		internal readonly Guid ID;

		internal ControlValveType(ControlValveMaker maker, string name, int calcID, Guid id)
		{
			Maker = maker;
			Name = name;
			CalcID = calcID;
			ID = id;
		}
	}

			public object GetValue()
			{
				if (_baseRecord.CanCastTo(AcsSeProcessDouble.myGuid))
				{
					return _baseRecord.CastTo<AcsSeProcessDouble>().VarValue;
				}
				if (_baseRecord.CanCastTo(AcsSeProcessString.myGuid))
				{
					return _baseRecord.CastTo<AcsSeProcessString>().VarValue;
				}
				if (_baseRecord.CanCastTo(AcsSeProcessBool.myGuid))
				{
					return _baseRecord.CastTo<AcsSeProcessBool>().VarValue;
				}
				if (_baseRecord.CanCastTo(AcsSeProcessInt.myGuid))
				{
					return _baseRecord.CastTo<AcsSeProcessInt>().VarValue;
				}
				if (_baseRecord.CanCastTo(AcsSeProcessStringArray.myGuid))
				{
					return _baseRecord.CastTo<AcsSeProcessStringArray>().Values.Values<AcsNoId, string>().ToArray();
				}
				if (_baseRecord.CanCastTo(AcsSeProcessDoubleArray.myGuid))
				{
					return _baseRecord.CastTo<AcsSeProcessDoubleArray>().Values.Values<AcsNoId, double>().ToArray();
				}
				return null;
			}

		private DefaultValueDefiner(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSeDefaultValueDefiner dataModel)
		{
			ModelRegistry = modelRegistry;
			DataModel = dataModel;
		}

		public static DefaultValueDefiner CreateNew(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSeDefaultValueDefiner dataModel)
		{
			DefaultValueDefiner defaultValueDefiner = new DefaultValueDefiner(modelRegistry, dataModel);
			defaultValueDefiner.CreateConstituentDataModels();
			defaultValueDefiner.StoredRevision = ModelRevision;
			defaultValueDefiner.Initialize();
			defaultValueDefiner.ApplyDefaultDefaults();
			return defaultValueDefiner;
		}

		public static DefaultValueDefiner Recall(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSeDefaultValueDefiner dataModel)
		{
			DefaultValueDefiner defaultValueDefiner = new DefaultValueDefiner(modelRegistry, dataModel);
			defaultValueDefiner.DataModelFixUp();
			defaultValueDefiner.Initialize();
			defaultValueDefiner.RecallFixUp();
			return defaultValueDefiner;
		}

		private void CreateBoilerplateConstituentDataModels()
		{
			BoilerplateDataModelFixUp(-1);

		private void DataModelFixUp()
		{
			BoilerplateDataModelFixUp(StoredRevision);
		}

		public void RecallFixUp()
		{
			ApplyDefaultDefaults(StoredRevision);
			StoredRevision = ModelRevision;
			if (StoredRevision < 16)
			{
				double value = ((AcsSeProcessDouble)DataModel.FireFlashManager_UserHeatInput).VarValue ?? double.NaN;
				Power power = new Power(value, Units.W);
				double value2 = power.ValueIn(Units.Btu_per_h);
				Energy value3 = new Energy(value2, Units.Btu);
				FireFlashManager_UserHeatInput.Specify(value3, null);
			}
			if (StoredRevision < 20)
			{
				VesselExposedToFire_TopHeadType.Specify(HeadType.Same, null);
			}
			if (StoredRevision < 21 && PressureProtectionRequirement_DesignCode.IsEmpty)
			{
				PressureProtectionRequirement_DesignCode.Specify(SystemDesignCode.ASME_VIII, null);
			}
		}

		[NotifyPropertyChangedInvocator]
		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		public virtual void CopyFromRecord(AcsSeDefaultValueDefiner sourceRecord)
		{
			if (!((AcsBase)sourceRecord).CanCastTo(((AcsBase)DataModel).ClassGuid))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Trying to copy from a record that is a different type than myself!");
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = GetType().GetProperties();
			string text = default(string);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				if (propertyInfo.GetValue(this) is AbstractProcessVariable abstractProcessVariable)
				{
					IAdbRecord val = ((AcsBaseRecord)sourceRecord).Record.ScalarReference(abstractProcessVariable.FieldIdent.ToString("D"));
					if (val == null)
					{
						abstractProcessVariable.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
					}
					else if (propertyInfo.GetValue(this) is ProcessPressure processPressure)
					{
						_ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper readOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper = new _ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper(val);
						object value = readOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper.GetValue();
						object obj = val.ScalarValue("251CECB9-9154-46DD-A3B5-F2CD5213A861", ref text);
						processPressure.Specify(((double?)value) ?? double.NaN, UnitTypes.Pressure.InnateUnit, (PressureReference)obj, readOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper);
					}
					else
					{
						abstractProcessVariable.TrySpecifyFrom(new _ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper(val));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopyFromOtherDatabase(DefaultValueDefiner sourceModel)
		{
			CopyFromRecord(sourceModel.DataModel);
		}

		protected IProcessVariable _CreateProcVarWrapperFor(IAdbRecord record)
		{
			return new _ReadOnlyProcessQuantityWrapper(record);
		}
