	internal class ExitVelocityUpdater : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		private static Lazy<ExitVelocityUpdater> _exitVelocityUpdater = new Lazy<ExitVelocityUpdater>(() => new ExitVelocityUpdater());

		private ExitVelocityUpdater()
		{
		}

		internal static ExitVelocityUpdater GetSingleton()
		{
			return _exitVelocityUpdater.Value;
		}

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			if (variable.Model is DefaultValueDefiner { SinglePhaseLineRating_ExitVelocityLimit: var singlePhaseLineRating_ExitVelocityLimit })
			{
				singlePhaseLineRating_ExitVelocityLimit.TrySpecifyFrom(variable);
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}
	public class Fire : ReliefLoadCalculation
	{
		private FireFlashManagerChild _fireFlashManager;

		private FluidChild _disengagementFluid;

		private VesselExposedToFireChildren _vessels;

		private static int ModelRevision => 3;

		private AcsSeFire FDataModel => (AcsSeFire)base.DataModel;

		private int StoredFireRevision
		{
			get

				FDataModel.StoredFireRevision = value;
			}
		}

			{
				return _fireFlashManager.Value;
			}

				_fireFlashManager.Value = value;
			}
		}

		public Fluid DisengagementFluid
		{
			get
			{
				return _disengagementFluid.Value;
			}
			private set
			{
				_disengagementFluid.Value = value;
			}
		}

		public IReadOnlyList<VesselExposedToFire> Vessels => _vessels.AsReadOnly();

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			CalculationMethod.AddAffectedProcessAction(FireCalculationTypeUpdater.GetSingleton());
			CalculationMethod.AddAffectedProcessAction(VesselAreaCalcUpdater.Instance);
		}

		protected override void CustomDelete()
		{
			base.CustomDelete();
			CalculationMethod.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(FireCalculationTypeUpdater.GetSingleton());
			CalculationMethod.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(VesselAreaCalcUpdater.Instance);
		}

		internal void UpdateFireCalculationMethod()
		{
			if (CalculationMethod.Value.HasValue && FireFlashManager == null && (CalculationMethod.Value.Value == FireCalcMethod.SinglePhaseRigorous || CalculationMethod.Value.Value == FireCalcMethod.TwoPhaseRigorous))
			{
				FireFlashManager = FireFlashManager.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			}
			if (!CalculationMethod.Value.HasValue || CalculationMethod.Value != FireCalcMethod.NFPA30)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (VesselExposedToFire vessel in _vessels)
			{
				if (vessel.FDataSource.Value == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
				{
					vessel.FDataSource.Specify(ProcessDataSource.Specified, new CalculationSpecifier());
					vessel.F.Specify(1.0, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		public VesselExposedToFire CreateVessel()
		{
			VesselExposedToFire vesselExposedToFire = VesselExposedToFire.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_vessels.Add(vesselExposedToFire);
			return vesselExposedToFire;
		}

		public void CreateFlashManagerIfNull()
		{
			if (FireFlashManager == null)
			{
				FireFlashManager = FireFlashManager.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
			Fire fire = (Fire)model;
			if (fire.FireFlashManager != null)
			{
				CreateFlashManagerIfNull();
				FireFlashManager.CopyFrom(fire.FireFlashManager, onlyUserSpecified);
			}
			if (fire.DisengagementFluid != null)
			{
				VerifyDisengagementFluid();
				DisengagementFluid.CopyFrom(fire.DisengagementFluid, onlyUserSpecified);
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeFire val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeFire>();
			if (val.FireFlashManager != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.FireFlashManager).Record != null)
			{
				CreateFlashManagerIfNull();
				FireFlashManager.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.FireFlashManager);
			}
			if (val.DisengagementFluid != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.DisengagementFluid).Record != null)
			{
				VerifyDisengagementFluid();
				DisengagementFluid.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.DisengagementFluid);
			}
			foreach (AcsSeVesselExposedToFire item in val.Vessels.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeVesselExposedToFire>())
			{
				VesselExposedToFire vesselExposedToFire = CreateVessel();
				vesselExposedToFire.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item);
			}
		}

		public void VerifyDisengagementFluid()
		{
			if (DisengagementFluid == null)
			{
				DisengagementFluid = Fluid.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			}
		}

		protected Fire(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSeFire dataModel)
			: base(modelRegistry, (AcsSeReliefLoadCalculation)(object)dataModel)
		{
		}

		public static Fire CreateNew(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSeFire val = new AcsSeFire(adbTop);
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = ModelRegistry.GetModelRegistry(adbTop);
			Fire fire = new Fire(modelRegistry, val);
			fire.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			((AcsSeBaseModel)val).ModelTypeGuid = ModelBuilder.FireGuid.ToString("D");
			fire.Initialize();
			fire.UpdateVersionNumber();
			fire.ResetProcessVars();
			fire.CustomCreateNew();
			modelRegistry.RegisterNewModel(fire);
			return fire;
		}

		public static Fire ReInstantiate(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, IAdbRecord dataRecord)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSeFire dataModel = new AcsSeFire(dataRecord);
			return new Fire(modelRegistry, dataModel);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVersionNumber()
		{
			base.UpdateVersionNumber();
			StoredFireRevision = ModelRevision;
		}

		protected override void DataModelBoilerplateFixUp()
		{
			base.DataModelBoilerplateFixUp();
			CreateFireProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredFireRevision);
		}

		private void ResetFireProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				FireDescription.Reset(null);
				CalculationMethod.Reset(null);
				IsAdequateDrainage.Reset(null);
				InitialLatentHeatFraction.Reset(null);
				FinalLatentHeatFraction.Reset(null);
				MaxAllowedWallTemperature.Reset(null);
				ExposedArea.Reset(null);
				CalculatedHeatInput.Reset(null);
				FluidLatentHeat.Reset(null);
				FluidTemperature.Reset(null);
				CalculateLatentHeat.Reset(null);
				IncludeSensibleHeat.Reset(null);
				GasCorrectionFactor.Reset(null);
				UseIdealGasAssumption.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 1)
			{
				WettedAreaExponent.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 2)
			{
				CalculateDisengagement.Reset(null);
				VesselModel.Reset(null);
				DisengagementRegime.Reset(null);
				C0ChurnTurbulent.Reset(null);
				C0Bubbly.Reset(null);
				FullVesselArea.Reset(null);
				FullVesselHeatInput.Reset(null);
				HeatOfVaporizationAtSet.Reset(null);
				VaporGenerationRate.Reset(null);
				SuperficialVaporVelocity.Reset(null);
				CharacteristicBubbleRiseVelocity.Reset(null);
				DisengagementLiquidLevelForSwell.Reset(null);
				DisengagementLiquidLevelForEntrainment.Reset(null);
				DisengagementLiquidLevel.Reset(null);
				IsTwoPhaseRelief.Reset(null);
				InitialTwoPhaseVaporMassFraction.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 3)
			{
				VaporReliefRate.Reset(null);
				VaporRequiredArea.Reset(null);
				TwoPhaseReliefRate.Reset(null);
				TwoPhaseRequiredArea.Reset(null);
				SelectedReliefSource.Reset(null);
				SelectedRelief.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetFireProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			if (FireFlashManager != null)
			{
				FireFlashManager.Delete();
			}
			if (DisengagementFluid != null)
			{
				DisengagementFluid.Delete();
			}
			_vessels.Clear();
			FireDescription.Delete();
			CalculationMethod.Delete();
			IsAdequateDrainage.Delete();
			InitialLatentHeatFraction.Delete();
			FinalLatentHeatFraction.Delete();
			MaxAllowedWallTemperature.Delete();
			ExposedArea.Delete();
			CalculatedHeatInput.Delete();
			FluidLatentHeat.Delete();
			FluidTemperature.Delete();
			CalculateLatentHeat.Delete();
			IncludeSensibleHeat.Delete();
			GasCorrectionFactor.Delete();
			UseIdealGasAssumption.Delete();
			WettedAreaExponent.Delete();
			CalculateDisengagement.Delete();
			VesselModel.Delete();
			DisengagementRegime.Delete();
			C0ChurnTurbulent.Delete();
			C0Bubbly.Delete();
			FullVesselArea.Delete();
			FullVesselHeatInput.Delete();
			HeatOfVaporizationAtSet.Delete();
			VaporGenerationRate.Delete();
			SuperficialVaporVelocity.Delete();
			CharacteristicBubbleRiseVelocity.Delete();
			DisengagementLiquidLevelForSwell.Delete();
			DisengagementLiquidLevelForEntrainment.Delete();
			DisengagementLiquidLevel.Delete();
			IsTwoPhaseRelief.Delete();
			InitialTwoPhaseVaporMassFraction.Delete();
			VaporReliefRate.Delete();
			VaporRequiredArea.Delete();
			TwoPhaseReliefRate.Delete();
			TwoPhaseRequiredArea.Delete();
			SelectedReliefSource.Delete();
			SelectedRelief.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

	internal class VesselAreaCalcUpdater : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		private static Lazy<VesselAreaCalcUpdater> _instance = new Lazy<VesselAreaCalcUpdater>(() => new VesselAreaCalcUpdater());

		internal static VesselAreaCalcUpdater Instance => _instance.Value;

		private VesselAreaCalcUpdater()
		{
		}

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			Fire fire = (Fire)variable.Model;
			FireAreaStandard value = ((fire.CalculationMethod.Value == FireCalcMethod.NFPA30) ? FireAreaStandard.NFPA30 : FireAreaStandard.Api521);
			foreach (VesselExposedToFire vessel in fire.Vessels)
			{
				vessel.AreaCalculationMethod.Specify(value, new UserSpecifier());
			}
		}
	}
	public class FireFlashManager : BaseModel
	{
		private FireCalculationIterationChildren _iterations;

		public Fire Fire => (Fire)base.Parent;

		private static int ModelRevision => 2;

		private AcsSeFireFlashManager FfmDataModel => (AcsSeFireFlashManager)base.DataModel;

		private int StoredFireFlashManagerRevision
		{
			get
			{
				return FfmDataModel.StoredFireFlashManagerRevision;
			}
			set
			{
				FfmDataModel.StoredFireFlashManagerRevision = value;
			}
		}

		public ProcessInt NumberOfFlashes { get; private set; }

		public ProcessBool VaryWettedSurfaceArea { get; private set; }

		public ProcessFraction UserPercentVapor { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnergy UserHeatInput { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<SemiDynFlashType> FlashType { get; private set; }

		public ProcessTemperature MaxTemperature { get; private set; }

		public ProcessTemperatureDifference TemperatureChange { get; private set; }

		public ProcessStringArray ComponentNames { get; private set; }

		public IReadOnlyList<FireCalculationIteration> Iterations => _iterations.AsReadOnly();

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredFireFlashManagerRevision < 2)
			{
				double value = ((AcsSeProcessDouble)((AcsSeFireFlashManager)base.DataModel).UserHeatInput).VarValue ?? double.NaN;
				Power power = new Power(value, Units.W);
				double value2 = power.ValueIn(Units.Btu_per_h);
				Energy value3 = new Energy(value2, Units.Btu);
				UserHeatInput.Specify(value3, new UserSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public FireCalculationIteration CreateIteration()
		{
			FireCalculationIteration fireCalculationIteration = FireCalculationIteration.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_iterations.Add(fireCalculationIteration);
			return fireCalculationIteration;
		}

		public void ClearIterations()
		{
			_iterations.Clear();
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeFireFlashManager val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeFireFlashManager>();
			ClearIterations();
			foreach (AcsSeFireCalculationIteration item in val.Iterations.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeFireCalculationIteration>())
			{
				FireCalculationIteration fireCalculationIteration = CreateIteration();
				fireCalculationIteration.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item);
			}
		}

		protected FireFlashManager(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSeFireFlashManager dataModel)
			: base(modelRegistry, (AcsSeBaseModel)(object)dataModel)
		{
		}

		public static FireFlashManager CreateNew(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSeFireFlashManager val = new AcsSeFireFlashManager(adbTop);
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = ModelRegistry.GetModelRegistry(adbTop);
			FireFlashManager fireFlashManager = new FireFlashManager(modelRegistry, val);
			fireFlashManager.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			((AcsSeBaseModel)val).ModelTypeGuid = ModelBuilder.FireFlashManagerGuid.ToString("D");
			fireFlashManager.Initialize();
			fireFlashManager.UpdateVersionNumber();
			fireFlashManager.ResetProcessVars();
			fireFlashManager.CustomCreateNew();
			modelRegistry.RegisterNewModel(fireFlashManager);
			return fireFlashManager;
		}

		public static FireFlashManager ReInstantiate(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, IAdbRecord dataRecord)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSeFireFlashManager dataModel = new AcsSeFireFlashManager(dataRecord);
			return new FireFlashManager(modelRegistry, dataModel);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVersionNumber()
		{
			base.UpdateVersionNumber();
			StoredFireFlashManagerRevision = ModelRevision;
		}

		protected override void DataModelBoilerplateFixUp()
		{
			base.DataModelBoilerplateFixUp();
			CreateFireFlashManagerProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredFireFlashManagerRevision);
		}

			//IL_0098: Expected O, but got Unknown

		{

				VaryWettedSurfaceArea.Reset(null);
				UserPercentVapor.Reset(null);
				UserHeatInput.Reset(null);

				TemperatureChange.Reset(null);

			if (storedVersion < 1)

				ComponentNames.Reset(null);

			MaxTemperature.Delete();
			TemperatureChange.Delete();
			ComponentNames.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

	internal abstract class MockedKeyDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> : RefDict<TKey, TValue> where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		protected ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TUValue> DataArray { get; private set; }

		protected Func<TValue, TKey> KeyAccessor { get; private set; }

		protected MockedKeyDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TValue, TKey> keyAccessor)
			: base(modelRegistry, source)
		{
			KeyAccessor = keyAccessor;
			DataArray = refArray;
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)DataArray).Length; i++)
			{
				TValue model = base.ModelRegistry.GetModel<TValue>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)((ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)DataArray).ValueAtLocation(i));
				TKey key = KeyAccessor(model);
				if (!ModelDict.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					ModelDict.Add(key, model);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
			}
			int num = list.Count;
			while (--num >= 0)
			{
				int num2 = list[num];
				TValue model2 = base.ModelRegistry.GetModel<TValue>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)((ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)DataArray).ValueAtLocation(num2));
				model2.Delete();
				((ValueArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)DataArray).RemoveAtLocation(num2);
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveFromDataArray(TUValue dataModel)
		{
			int num = ((ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)DataArray).FindValue(dataModel);
			((ValueArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)DataArray).RemoveAtLocation(num);
		}

		public virtual void Add(TValue value)
		{
			Add(KeyAccessor(value), value);
		}

		internal bool KeyUpdated(TValue value)
		{
			if (value == null || !ModelDict.ContainsValue(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			TKey key = ModelDict.Single((KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> pair) => pair.Value == value).Key;
			if (key.Equals(KeyAccessor(value)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			_keyUpdated(key, value);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void _keyUpdated(TKey oldKey, TValue value)
		{
			TKey key = KeyAccessor(value);
			if (ModelDict.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				throw new MockedKeyUpdateException(oldKey, value);
			}
			ModelDict.Remove(oldKey);
			ModelDict.Add(key, value);
		}
	}
	internal class MockedKeyRefDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> : MockedKeyDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		public override TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				return ModelDict[key];
			}
			set
			{
				if (!key.Equals(base.KeyAccessor(value)))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Bad assignment of value in MockedKeyRefDict");
				}
				TValue val = ModelDict[key];
				HandleRemovedReference(val);
				HandleAddedReference(value);
				ModelDict[key] = value;
				RemoveFromDataArray((TUValue)(object)val.DataModel);
				((ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)base.DataArray).Append((AcsNoId)null, (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Assign, val, value);
			}
		}

		internal MockedKeyRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TValue, TKey> keyAccessor)
			: base(modelRegistry, refArray, source, keyAccessor)
		{
		}

		public override void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			ModelDict.Add(key, value);
			((ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)base.DataArray).Append((AcsNoId)null, (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
			HandleAddedReference(value);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Append, null, value);
		}

		public override bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			TValue val = null;
			try
			{
				val = ModelDict[key];
			}
			catch (KeyNotFoundException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ModelDict.Remove(key))
			{
				return false;
			}
			HandleRemovedReference(val);
			RemoveFromDataArray((TUValue)(object)val.DataModel);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, val);
			return true;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleRemovedReference(item.Value);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, item.Value);
			}
			ModelDict.Clear();
			((ValueArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)base.DataArray).Clear(false);
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			if (!ContainsValue((TValue)modelBeingDeleted))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<TKey> list = (from p in ModelDict
				where p.Value == modelBeingDeleted
				select p.Key).ToList();
			foreach (TKey item in list)
			{
				RemoveFromDataArray((TUValue)(object)((BaseModel)modelBeingDeleted).DataModel);
				ModelDict.Remove(item);
			}
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, modelBeingDeleted);
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			base.Recall();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleAddedReference(item.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MockedKeyChildRefDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> : MockedKeyRefDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		internal MockedKeyChildRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TValue, TKey> keyAccessor)
			: base(modelRegistry, refArray, source, keyAccessor)
		{
		}

		protected override void HandleAddedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			base.HandleAddedReference(model);
			if (model != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.ClaimChild(this, model);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleRemovedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			if (model != null)
			{
				base.HandleRemovedReference(model);
				if (!model.IsBeingDeleted)
				{
					model.Delete();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MockedRefKeyRefDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> : MockedKeyDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> where TKey : BaseModel where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		public override TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				return ModelDict[key];
			}
			set
			{
				if (key != base.KeyAccessor(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Bad assignment of value in MockedRefKeyRefDict");
				}
				TValue old = ModelDict[key];
				HandleRemovedValue(ModelDict[key]);
				HandleAddedValue(value);
				ModelDict[key] = value;
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Assign, old, key);
			}
		}

		internal MockedRefKeyRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TValue, TKey> keyAccessor)
			: base(modelRegistry, refArray, source, keyAccessor)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void HandleAddedKey(TKey model)
		{
			HandleAddedReference(model);
		}

		protected virtual void HandleAddedValue(TValue model)
		{
			HandleAddedReference(model);
		}

		protected virtual void HandleRemovedKey(TKey model)
		{
			HandleRemovedReference(model);
		}

		protected virtual void HandleRemovedValue(TValue model)
		{
			HandleRemovedReference(model);
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			if (modelBeingDeleted is TKey val && ContainsKey(val))
			{
				TValue val2 = ModelDict[val];
				ModelDict.Remove(val);
				RemoveFromDataArray((TUValue)(object)val2.DataModel);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, val);
			}
			TValue value = modelBeingDeleted as TValue;
			if (value == null || !ModelDict.ContainsValue(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			HandleRemovedReference(value);
			List<TKey> list = ModelDict.Where(delegate(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> pair)
			{
				KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> keyValuePair = pair;
				return keyValuePair.Value == value;
			}).Select(delegate(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> pair)
			{
				KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> keyValuePair = pair;
				return keyValuePair.Key;
			}).ToList();
			foreach (TKey item in list)
			{
				TValue val3 = ModelDict[item];
				ModelDict.Remove(item);
				RemoveFromDataArray((TUValue)(object)val3.DataModel);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, val3);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, item);
			}
		}

		public override void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value", "Value cannot be null because it is used to create key on recall");
			}
			ModelDict.Add(key, value);
			((ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)base.DataArray).Append((AcsNoId)null, (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
			HandleAddedKey(key);
			HandleAddedValue(value);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Append, null, key);
		}

		public override bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			TValue value = null;
			if (!ModelDict.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			HandleRemovedKey(key);
			HandleRemovedValue(value);
			if (!ModelDict.Remove(key))
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveFromDataArray((TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, key);
			return true;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleRemovedKey(item.Key);
				HandleRemovedValue(item.Value);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, item.Key);
			}
			ModelDict.Clear();
			((ValueArray<AcsNoId, ?>)(object)base.DataArray).Clear(false);
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			base.Recall();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleAddedKey(item.Key);
				HandleAddedValue(item.Value);
			}
		}

		protected override void _keyUpdated(TKey oldKey, TValue value)
		{
			base._keyUpdated(oldKey, value);
			HandleRemovedKey(oldKey);
			HandleAddedKey(base.KeyAccessor(value));
		}
	}
	internal class MockedRefKeyChildRefDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> : MockedRefKeyRefDict<TKey, TValue, TUValue> where TKey : BaseModel where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		internal MockedRefKeyChildRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TValue, TKey> keyAccessor)

	public class ProcessBool : ProcessStoredBool<bool?>
	{
		public ProcessBool(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessBool dataModel, Guid fieldIdent, ProcessBool defaultValueVar = null)
			: base(model, dataModel, fieldIdent, (IProcessVar<bool?>)defaultValueVar)
		{
		}

		public override bool WouldBeValid(bool? value)
		{
			return value.HasValue;
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			bool? value = processVariable.GetValue() as bool?;
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				if (processVariable.IsEmpty)
				{
					Clear(processVariable);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			Specify(value, processVariable);
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool? ConvertFromUnderlying(bool? value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool? ConvertToUnderlying(bool? value)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class ProcessString : ProcessStoredString<string>
	{
		protected override string EmptyValue => string.Empty;

		public ProcessString(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessString dataModel, Guid fieldIdent, ProcessString defaultValueVar = null)
			: base(model, dataModel, fieldIdent, (IProcessVar<string>)defaultValueVar)
		{
		}

		public override bool WouldBeValid(string value)
		{
			return value != null;
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			if (!(processVariable.GetValue() is string value))
			{
				if (processVariable.IsEmpty)
				{
					Clear(processVariable);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			Specify(value, processVariable);
			return true;
		}

		protected override string ConvertFromUnderlying(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = string.Empty;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override string ConvertToUnderlying(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value.Any((char c) => _IsDisallowedChar(c)))
			{
				return new string(value.Where((char c) => !_IsDisallowedChar(c)).ToArray());
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static bool _IsDisallowedChar(char c)
		{
			if (!char.IsControl(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class ProcessDouble : ProcessStoredDouble<double>

		public ProcessDouble(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessDouble dataModel, Guid fieldIdent, ProcessDouble defaultValueVar = null)
			: base(model, dataModel, fieldIdent, (IProcessVar<double>)defaultValueVar)
		{
		}

		public override bool WouldBeValid(double value)
		{
			return !double.IsNaN(value) && !double.IsInfinity(value);
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			double? num = processVariable.GetValue() as double?;
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				if (processVariable.IsEmpty)
				{
					Clear(processVariable);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			Specify(num.Value, processVariable);
			return true;
		}

		protected override double ConvertFromUnderlying(double? value)
		{
			return value ?? double.NaN;
		}

		protected override double? ConvertToUnderlying(double value)
		{
			return double.IsNaN(value) ? ((double?)null) : new double?(value);
		}
	}

			get

	public class ProcessFraction : AbstractProcessQuantity<Fraction, ScalarUnit>
	{

	public abstract class ProcessVariable : AbstractProcessVariable
	{
		private readonly List<IProcessAction> _affectedProcessActions = new List<IProcessAction>();

		protected IVariableSpecifier _source;

		public override IEnumerable<IProcessAction> AffectedProcessActions => _affectedProcessActions;

		public override IVariableSpecifier Source => _source;

		protected ProcessVariable(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessVar dataModel, Guid fieldIdent)
			: base(model, dataModel, fieldIdent)
		{
		}

		public override void AddAffectedProcessAction(IProcessAction action)
		{
			_affectedProcessActions.Add(action);
			OnPropertyChanged("AffectedProcessActions");
		}

		public override bool RemoveAffectedProcessAction(IProcessAction action)
		{
			bool result = _affectedProcessActions.Remove(action);
			OnPropertyChanged("AffectedProcessActions");
			return result;
		}

		protected void BroadcastChange()
		{
			foreach (IProcessAction affectedProcessAction in AffectedProcessActions)
			{
				affectedProcessAction.InputChanged(this);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PsvOrificeSizing : OrificeSizing
	{
		private DirectIntegrationStepChildren _integrationSteps;

		public ProcessDouble Kv => CanCalculateKv() ? CalculatedKv : UserKv;

		private static int ModelRevision => 5;

		private AcsSePsvOrificeSizing PosDataModel => (AcsSePsvOrificeSizing)base.DataModel;

		private int StoredPsvOrificeSizingRevision
		{
			get
			{
				return PosDataModel.StoredPsvOrificeSizingRevision;
			}
			set
			{
				PosDataModel.StoredPsvOrificeSizingRevision = value;
			}
		}

		public ProcessDouble C { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble UserKv { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble CalculatedKv { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Kd { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource> KdSource { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Kb { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource> KbSource { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Kw { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource> KwSource { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Kn { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Ksh { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource> KshSource { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Kp { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource> KpSource { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Omega { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble EtaC { get; private set; }

		public ProcessFraction VaporMassFractionAtInlet { get; private set; }

		public ProcessSpecificVolume SpecificVolumeAtInlet { get; private set; }

		public ProcessMassDensity DensityAt90P { get; private set; }

		public ProcessSpecificVolume SpecificVolumeAt90P { get; private set; }

		public ProcessMassFlux MassFlux { get; private set; }

		public ProcessPressure CriticalPressure { get; private set; }

		public ProcessPressure UpstreamPressure { get; private set; }

		public ProcessFraction BackpressureLimitFractionOfSetPressure { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource> BackpressureLimitFractionSource { get; private set; }

		public ProcessPressure BackpressureLimit { get; private set; }

		public IReadOnlyList<DirectIntegrationStep> IntegrationSteps => _integrationSteps.AsReadOnly();

		protected bool CanCalculateKv()
		{
			OrificeSizingMethod? value = base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value;
			return value == OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid || value == OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid;
		}

		public DirectIntegrationStep CreateIntegrationStep()
		{
			DirectIntegrationStep directIntegrationStep = DirectIntegrationStep.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_integrationSteps.Add(directIntegrationStep);
			return directIntegrationStep;
		}

		public void ClearSteps()
		{
			_integrationSteps.Clear();
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredPsvOrificeSizingRevision < 3)
			{
				OrificeSizingMethod orificeSizingMethod = base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value.GetValueOrDefault();
				if (orificeSizingMethod == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_Direct)
				{
					orificeSizingMethod = base.ReliefLoad.Phase.Value.GetValueOrDefault() switch
					{
						FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor => OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor, 
						FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid => OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid, 
						_ => OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1, 
					};
				}
				bool flag = false;
				switch (orificeSizingMethod)
				{
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Vapor:
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Steam:
					if (Kd.Value == base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefDevice.VaporKd.Value)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid:
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_3:
					if (Kd.Value == base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefDevice.LiquidKd.Value)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid:
					if (Kd.Value == 0.62)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1:
				case OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_2:
					if (Kd.Value == base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefDevice.MixedKd.Value)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					KdSource.Specify(ProcessDataSource.Reference, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
			if (StoredPsvOrificeSizingRevision < 5)
			{
				Fluid fluid = base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad.Fluid;
				if (base.PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value == OrificeSizingMethod.Mixed_1)
				{
					VaporMassFractionAtInlet.TrySpecifyFrom(fluid.VaporMassFraction);
					SpecificVolumeAtInlet.TrySpecifyFrom(fluid.SpecificVolume);
					fluid.LiquidMassEnthalpyOfVaporization.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				fluid.SpecificVolume.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				fluid.LiquidSpecificVolume.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				fluid.VaporSpecificVolume.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePsvOrificeSizing val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePsvOrificeSizing>();
			ClearSteps();
			foreach (AcsSeDirectIntegrationStep item in val.IntegrationSteps.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeDirectIntegrationStep>())
			{
				DirectIntegrationStep directIntegrationStep = CreateIntegrationStep();
				directIntegrationStep.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item);
			}
		}

			: base(modelRegistry, (AcsSeOrificeSizing)(object)dataModel)
		{
		}

		public static PsvOrificeSizing CreateNew(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSePsvOrificeSizing val = new AcsSePsvOrificeSizing(adbTop);
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = ModelRegistry.GetModelRegistry(adbTop);
			PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing = new PsvOrificeSizing(modelRegistry, val);
			psvOrificeSizing.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			((AcsSeBaseModel)val).ModelTypeGuid = ModelBuilder.PsvOrificeSizingGuid.ToString("D");
			psvOrificeSizing.Initialize();
			psvOrificeSizing.UpdateVersionNumber();
			psvOrificeSizing.ResetProcessVars();
			psvOrificeSizing.CustomCreateNew();
			modelRegistry.RegisterNewModel(psvOrificeSizing);
			return psvOrificeSizing;
		}

			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown

	internal abstract class RefDict<TKey, TValue> : ManagedReferenceBase, IDictionary<TKey, TValue>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected readonly Dictionary<TKey, TValue> ModelDict = new Dictionary<TKey, TValue>();

		protected ModelRegistry ModelRegistry { get; private set; }

		public abstract TValue this[TKey key] { get; set; }

		public int Count => ModelDict.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly { get; private set; }

		public ICollection<TKey> Keys => ModelDict.Keys;

		public ICollection<TValue> Values => ModelDict.Values;

		protected RefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, BaseModel source)
			: base(source)
		{
			ModelRegistry = modelRegistry;
		}

		public abstract void Add(TKey key, TValue value);

		public abstract bool Remove(TKey key);

		public abstract void Clear();

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ModelDict.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item)
		{
			Add(item.Key, item.Value);
		}

		public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item)
		{
			return ModelDict.ContainsKey(item.Key) && ModelDict[item.Key].Equals(item.Value);
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
		}

		public bool Remove(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item)
		{
			return Remove(item.Key);
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(TKey key)
		{
			return ModelDict.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public bool ContainsValue(TValue value)
		{
			return ModelDict.ContainsValue(value);
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(TKey key, out TValue value)
		{
			return ModelDict.TryGetValue(key, out value);
		}

		public IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey, TValue> AsReadOnlyDictionary()
		{
			return ModelDict;
		}
	}
	public class PipeLineConstraintsDefinition : BaseModel, IMessageContainer<Message>
	{
		private MockedKeyChildRefDict<LineSizingMethod, LineRating, AcsSeLineRating> _allLineRatings;

		private PipeLineReference _pipeLine;

		private LineRatingReference _lineRating;

		private ReliefDeviceReference _reliefDevice;

		private MessageChildren _messages;

		public ReliefScenario ReliefScenario => (ReliefScenario)base.Parent;

		public IDictionary<LineSizingMethod, LineRating> AllLineRatings => _allLineRatings;

		private static int ModelRevision => 4;

		private AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition PlcdDataModel => (AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition)base.DataModel;

		private int StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision
		{
			get
			{
				return PlcdDataModel.StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision;
			}
			set
			{
				PlcdDataModel.StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision = value;
			}
		}

		public ProcessEnum<LineRatingFlowSpec> LineRatingFlowSpec { get; private set; }

		public ProcessMassFlow UpratedFlow { get; private set; }

		public ProcessBool IsRatingCalculated { get; private set; }

		public PipeLine PipeLine
		{
			get
			{
				return _pipeLine.Value;
			}
			private set
			{
				_pipeLine.Value = value;
			}
		}

		public LineRating LineRating
		{
			get
			{
				return _lineRating.Value;
			}
			private set
			{
				_lineRating.Value = value;
			}
		}

		public ReliefDevice ReliefDevice
		{
			get
			{
				return _reliefDevice.Value;
			}
			private set
			{
				_reliefDevice.Value = value;
			}
		}

		public IReadOnlyList<Message> Messages => _messages.AsReadOnly();

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			_allLineRatings = new MockedKeyChildRefDict<LineSizingMethod, LineRating, AcsSeLineRating>(base.ModelRegistry, PlcdDataModel.AllLineRatings, this, (LineRating lr) => lr.LineSizingMethod);
		}

		protected override void CustomRecall()
		{
			base.CustomRecall();
			_allLineRatings.Recall();
			if (StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision < 1 && ReliefScenario != null && ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.HasValue)
			{
				LineRating = AllLineRatings[ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.Value];
			}
		}

		protected override void CustomDelete()
		{
			base.CustomDelete();
			_allLineRatings.Clear();
		}

		public LineRating GetOrCreateLineRating()
		{
			LineRating value = null;
			if (ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.HasValue && !AllLineRatings.TryGetValue(ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.Value, out value))
			{
				value = CreateLineRating();
			}
			if (LineRating != value)
			{
				LineRating = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected LineRating CreateLineRating()
		{
			if (!ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LineRating lineRating = ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value switch
			{
				LineSizingMethod.SinglePhase => SinglePhaseLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				LineSizingMethod.Homogeneous => HomogeneousLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				LineSizingMethod.Omega => OmegaMethodLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				LineSizingMethod.Rigorous => RigorousLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException($"I don't know how to make a LineRating object for a LineSizingCalculationMethod value of {ReliefScenario.LineSizingCalculationMethod.Value}"), 
			};
			_allLineRatings.Add(lineRating);
			return lineRating;
		}

		internal void InitializePipeLine(PipeLine pipeLine)
		{
			_pipeLine.Value = pipeLine;
			ReliefDevice = PipeLine.ReliefDevice;
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				Delete();
				return;
			}
			if (StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision < 2)
			{
				ReliefDevice = _pipeLine?.Value?.ReliefDevice;
			}
			if (StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision < 3)
			{
				if (ReliefScenario == ReliefScenario.PressureProtectionRequirement.BindingOrificeScenario)
				{
					IsRatingCalculated.Specify(true, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				else if (LineRating == null)
				{
					IsRatingCalculated.Specify(false, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				else if (LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating)
				{
					IsRatingCalculated.Specify(rigorousLineRating.OutletPressureDrop.HasBeenSpecified && !rigorousLineRating.OutletPressureDrop.IsEmpty, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				else if (LineRating is HomogeneousLineRating homogeneousLineRating)
				{
					IsRatingCalculated.Specify(homogeneousLineRating.OutletPressureDrop.HasBeenSpecified && !homogeneousLineRating.OutletPressureDrop.IsEmpty, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				else if (LineRating is SinglePhaseLineRating singlePhaseLineRating)
				{
					IsRatingCalculated.Specify(singlePhaseLineRating.OutletPressureDrop.HasBeenSpecified && !singlePhaseLineRating.OutletPressureDrop.IsEmpty, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				else if (LineRating is OmegaMethodLineRating omegaMethodLineRating)
				{
					IsRatingCalculated.Specify(omegaMethodLineRating.OutletMaxEquivalentLength.HasBeenSpecified && !omegaMethodLineRating.OutletMaxEquivalentLength.IsEmpty, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePipeLineRatingModeSetting()
		{
			if (LineRating != null && PipeLine != null)
			{
				if (LineRating is RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating && rigorousLineRating.InRatingMode.Value == true)
				{
					PipeLine.InletPipe.DefineFromElements.Specify(true, new CalculationSpecifier());
					PipeLine.OutletPipe.DefineFromElements.Specify(true, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				else
				{
					PipeLine.InletPipe.DefineFromElements.Specify(false, new CalculationSpecifier());
					PipeLine.OutletPipe.DefineFromElements.Specify(false, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition>();
			Dictionary<string, LineRating> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, LineRating>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)val.AllLineRatings).Length; i++)
			{
				AcsSeLineRating val2 = val.AllLineRatings.ValueAtLocation(i);
				LineRating lineRating;
				LineSizingMethod key;
				if (((AcsBase)val2).CanCastTo(AcsSeRigorousLineRating.myGuid))
				{
					lineRating = RigorousLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
					key = LineSizingMethod.Rigorous;
				}
				else if (((AcsBase)val2).CanCastTo(AcsSeSinglePhaseLineRating.myGuid))
				{
					lineRating = SinglePhaseLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
					key = LineSizingMethod.SinglePhase;
				}
				else if (((AcsBase)val2).CanCastTo(AcsSeHomogeneousLineRating.myGuid))
				{
					lineRating = HomogeneousLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
					key = LineSizingMethod.Homogeneous;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!((AcsBase)val2).CanCastTo(AcsSeOmegaMethodLineRating.myGuid))
					{
						throw new NotImplementedException("Trying to copy a line rating but the source type isn't recognized.");
					}
					lineRating = OmegaMethodLineRating.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
					key = LineSizingMethod.Omega;
				}
				AllLineRatings.Add(key, lineRating);
				lineRating.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val2);
				dictionary.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val2).Record.RecordGuid(), lineRating);
			}
			if (val.LineRating != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.LineRating).Record != null)
			{
				LineRating = dictionary[((AcsBaseRecord)val.LineRating).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
			foreach (AcsSeMessage item in val.Messages.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeMessage>())
			{
				AddNewMessage((MessageLevel)item.Level.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), (MessageLocation)item.Location.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), item.MessageText.VarValue, this);
			}
		}

		public Message AddNewMessage(MessageLevel level, MessageLocation location, string message, IBaseModel refObject)
		{
			if (_messages.Any((Message x) => IsSameMessage(x, level, location, message, refObject)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Message message2 = Message.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			message2.Level.Specify(level, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.Location.Specify(location, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.MessageText.Specify(message, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.RefObject = (BaseModel)refObject;
			_messages.Add(message2);
			return message2;
		}

		public void RemoveMessage(Message message)
		{
			_messages.Remove(message);
		}

		public void ClearMessages()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
		}

		public void RemoveMatchingMessages(MessageLevel? level = null, string message = null, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.Anywhere, IEnumerable<MessageLocation> exceptLocation = null, IBaseModel refObject = null)
		{
			List<Message> list = _messages.Where((Message x) => IsMatchingMessage(x, level, message, location, exceptLocation, refObject)).ToList();
			foreach (Message item in list)
			{
				_messages.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		protected PipeLineConstraintsDefinition(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition dataModel)
			: base(modelRegistry, (AcsSeBaseModel)(object)dataModel)
		{
		}

		public static PipeLineConstraintsDefinition CreateNew(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition val = new AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(adbTop);
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = ModelRegistry.GetModelRegistry(adbTop);
			PipeLineConstraintsDefinition pipeLineConstraintsDefinition = new PipeLineConstraintsDefinition(modelRegistry, val);
			pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			((AcsSeBaseModel)val).ModelTypeGuid = ModelBuilder.PipeLineConstraintsDefinitionGuid.ToString("D");
			pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.Initialize();
			pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.UpdateVersionNumber();
			pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.ResetProcessVars();
			pipeLineConstraintsDefinition.CustomCreateNew();
			modelRegistry.RegisterNewModel(pipeLineConstraintsDefinition);
			return pipeLineConstraintsDefinition;
		}

		public static PipeLineConstraintsDefinition ReInstantiate(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, IAdbRecord dataRecord)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition dataModel = new AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(dataRecord);
			return new PipeLineConstraintsDefinition(modelRegistry, dataModel);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVersionNumber()

			base.UpdateVersionNumber();
			StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision = ModelRevision;
		}

		protected override void DataModelBoilerplateFixUp()
		{
			base.DataModelBoilerplateFixUp();
			CreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision);
		}

		private void CreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				PlcdDataModel.LineRatingFlowSpec = new AcsSeProcessInt(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				PlcdDataModel.UpratedFlow = new AcsSeProcessQuantity(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 3)
			{
				PlcdDataModel.IsRatingCalculated = new AcsSeProcessBool(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateConstiuentDataModels()
		{
			base.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			CreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateInitialize()
		{
			base.BoilerplateInitialize();
			LineRatingFlowSpec = new ProcessEnum<LineRatingFlowSpec>(this, PlcdDataModel.LineRatingFlowSpec, Guid.ParseExact("89660385-28F9-4D21-BE9D-B341E2CDB7AD", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PipeLineConstraintsDefinition_LineRatingFlowSpec);
			UpratedFlow = new ProcessMassFlow(this, PlcdDataModel.UpratedFlow, Guid.ParseExact("5E1E36C2-61EF-4789-89E3-7313A5689EBB", "D"));
			IsRatingCalculated = new ProcessBool(this, PlcdDataModel.IsRatingCalculated, Guid.ParseExact("1150EC6B-EAA4-4C8C-9EE8-99ABD058A30A", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PipeLineConstraintsDefinition_IsRatingCalculated);
			_pipeLine = new PipeLineReference(this, () => PlcdDataModel.PipeLine, delegate(AcsSePipeLine dm)
			{
				PlcdDataModel.PipeLine = dm;
			});
			_lineRating = new LineRatingReference(this, () => PlcdDataModel.LineRating, delegate(AcsSeLineRating dm)
			{
				PlcdDataModel.LineRating = dm;
			});
			_reliefDevice = new ReliefDeviceReference(this, () => PlcdDataModel.ReliefDevice, delegate(AcsSeReliefDevice dm)
			{
				PlcdDataModel.ReliefDevice = dm;
			});
			_messages = new MessageChildren(this, PlcdDataModel.Messages);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecall()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecall();
			_pipeLine.Recall();
			_lineRating.Recall();
			_reliefDevice.Recall();
			_messages.Recall();
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecallFixUp();
			ResetPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionRevision);
		}

		private void ResetPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				LineRatingFlowSpec.Reset(null);
				UpratedFlow.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 3)
			{
				IsRatingCalculated.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetPipeLineConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
			LineRatingFlowSpec.Delete();
			UpratedFlow.Delete();
			IsRatingCalculated.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

	public static class ModelBuilder
	{
		private delegate BaseModel Recaller(ModelRegistry registry, IAdbRecord dataRecord);

		internal static readonly Guid CaseConfigurationGuid = Guid.ParseExact("0A7B27B2-FFEA-4929-9734-C1D2D0D5B857", "D");

		internal static readonly Guid DetailedReliefDeviceGuid = Guid.ParseExact("E357B357-05D2-4A92-B9FB-579C7B703768", "D");

		public static BaseModel ReInstantiate(ModelRegistry registry, AcsSeBaseModel baseModel)
		{
			Guid key = Guid.ParseExact(baseModel.ModelTypeGuid, "D");
			Recaller recaller;
			try
			{
				recaller = _recallers[key];
			}
			catch (KeyNotFoundException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return recaller(registry, ((AcsBaseRecord)baseModel).Record);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ModelModelReference<T> : ManagedReferenceBase where T : BaseModel
	{
		protected T Target;

		internal virtual T Value
		{
			get
			{
				return Target;
			}
			set
			{
				T value2 = Value;
				HandleRemovedReference(Target);
				Target = value;
				HandleAddedReference(Target);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Assign, value2, value);
			}
		}

		protected ModelModelReference(BaseModel source)
			: base(source)
		{
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			T value = Value;
			Target = null;
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, value);
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			HandleAddedReference(Target);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class StoredModelReference<T, TU> : ModelModelReference<T> where T : BaseModel where TU : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		protected ModelRegistry ModelRegistry;

		protected Func<TU> Getter;

		protected Action<TU> Setter;

		internal override T Value
		{
			set
			{
				Setter((value != null) ? ((TU)(object)value.DataModel) : new TU());
				base.Value = value;
			}
		}

		internal StoredModelReference(BaseModel source, Func<TU> getter, Action<TU> setter)
			: base(source)
		{
			ModelRegistry = source.ModelRegistry;
			Getter = getter;
			Setter = setter;
			if (Getter() != null)
			{
				Target = source.ModelRegistry.GetModel<T>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)Getter());
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			Setter(new TU());
			base.RemoveDeletedTarget(modelBeingDeleted);
		}
	}
	internal class StoredBaseReference : StoredModelReference<BaseModel, AcsSeBaseModel>
	{
		public StoredBaseReference(BaseModel source, Func<AcsSeBaseModel> getter, Action<AcsSeBaseModel> setter)
			: base(source, getter, setter)
		{
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ChildReference<T, TU> : StoredModelReference<T, TU> where T : BaseModel where TU : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		internal ChildReference(BaseModel source, Func<TU> getter, Action<TU> setter)
			: base(source, getter, setter)
		{
		}

		protected override void HandleAddedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			base.HandleAddedReference(model);
			if (model != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.ClaimChild(this, model);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleRemovedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			base.HandleRemovedReference(model);
			model?.Delete();
		}
	}

		private void CreateDetailedReliefDeviceProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				DrdDataModel.InletFlangeNominalDiameter = new AcsSeProcessQuantity(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				DrdDataModel.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter = new AcsSeProcessQuantity(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				DrdDataModel.InletRating = new AcsSeProcessDouble(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
				DrdDataModel.OutletRating = new AcsSeProcessDouble(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateConstiuentDataModels()
		{
			base.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			CreateDetailedReliefDeviceProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateInitialize()
		{
			base.BoilerplateInitialize();
			InletFlangeNominalDiameter = new ProcessDistance(this, DrdDataModel.InletFlangeNominalDiameter, Guid.ParseExact("E22E053A-B042-4287-BF46-0BD96B4DE39B", "D"));
			OutletFlangeNominalDiameter = new ProcessDistance(this, DrdDataModel.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter, Guid.ParseExact("F2A506AB-1353-4270-9D96-ABE1110806E1", "D"));
			InletRating = new ProcessDouble(this, DrdDataModel.InletRating, Guid.ParseExact("983DE064-2779-45AC-84B4-FCB4C7BF17D0", "D"));
			OutletRating = new ProcessDouble(this, DrdDataModel.OutletRating, Guid.ParseExact("40D8F68C-5BEE-448D-AC31-94647A133DAE", "D"));
			_reliefOrifice = new ReliefOrificeReference(this, () => DrdDataModel.ReliefOrifice, delegate(AcsSeReliefOrifice dm)
			{
				DrdDataModel.ReliefOrifice = dm;
			});
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecall()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecall();
			_reliefOrifice.Recall();
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecallFixUp();
			ResetDetailedReliefDeviceProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredDetailedReliefDeviceRevision);
		}

		private void ResetDetailedReliefDeviceProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Reset(null);
				OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Reset(null);
				InletRating.Reset(null);
				OutletRating.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetDetailedReliefDeviceProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Delete();
			OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Delete();
			InletRating.Delete();
			OutletRating.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}
	}

			Source = new ProcessEnum<ReliefOrificeSource>(this, RoDataModel.Source, Guid.ParseExact("924C2283-320E-4DF9-8E03-9FAF95109FB1", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.ReliefOrifice_Source);
			IsBuiltInOrifice = new ProcessBool(this, RoDataModel.IsBuiltInOrifice, Guid.ParseExact("33BFA56B-4F46-4CA7-8A25-704D7B5DDD99", "D"));
			VaporKd = new ProcessDouble(this, RoDataModel.VaporKd, Guid.ParseExact("08D8A5DB-ABD5-4A4C-8307-5837713AAE64", "D"));
			LiquidKd = new ProcessDouble(this, RoDataModel.LiquidKd, Guid.ParseExact("FE07D5C3-553A-4AB5-869C-398BC12F2640", "D"));
			MixedKd = new ProcessDouble(this, RoDataModel.MixedKd, Guid.ParseExact("D3EA8190-3405-4E88-9B41-22704BE41493", "D"));
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecall()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecall();
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecallFixUp();
			ResetReliefOrificeProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredReliefOrificeRevision);
		}

		private void ResetReliefOrificeProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				Name.Reset(null);
				Designation.Reset(null);
				OrificeArea.Reset(null);
				Manufacturer.Reset(null);
				Source.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 1)
			{
				IsBuiltInOrifice.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 2)
			{
				VaporKd.Reset(null);
				LiquidKd.Reset(null);
				MixedKd.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetReliefOrificeProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			Name.Delete();
			Designation.Delete();
			OrificeArea.Delete();
			Manufacturer.Delete();
			Source.Delete();
			IsBuiltInOrifice.Delete();
			VaporKd.Delete();
			LiquidKd.Delete();
			MixedKd.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		internal static ReliefOrifice CreateNew(ReliefDeviceType reliefDeviceType, IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			return reliefDeviceType switch
			{
				ReliefDeviceType.Psv => PsvOrifice.CreateNew(adbTop), 
				ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk => RuptureDiskOrifice.CreateNew(adbTop), 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException($"Do not know how to make ReliefOrifice for ReliefDeviceType, {reliefDeviceType}"), 
			};
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			Name.AddAffectedProcessAction(ReliefOrificeRenamer.GetSingleton());
		}

		internal bool IsEquivalentTo(AcsSeReliefOrifice sourceOrifice)
		{
			if (Name.Value != sourceOrifice.Name.VarValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((IsBuiltInOrifice.Value == true) ^ (sourceOrifice.IsBuiltInOrifice.VarValue == true))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (IsBuiltInOrifice.Value == true)
			{
				return true;
			}
			AcsSeReliefOrifice val = ((AcsBase)base.DataModel).CastTo<AcsSeReliefOrifice>();
			if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(((AcsSeProcessDouble)sourceOrifice.OrificeArea).VarValue ?? double.NaN, ((AcsSeProcessDouble)val.OrificeArea).VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sourceOrifice.Designation.VarValue != val.Designation.VarValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(sourceOrifice.VaporKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.VaporKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(sourceOrifice.LiquidKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.LiquidKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MyMath.ValuesDiffer(sourceOrifice.MixedKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, val.MixedKd.VarValue ?? double.NaN, 1E-10, 1E-10))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		{

			}
		}

				LiquidViscosity.Reset(null);

		private void ResetRigorousLineRatingProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				InletPressureDrop.Reset(null);
				InletRhoV2.Reset(null);
				OutletPressureDrop.Reset(null);
				OutletRhoV2.Reset(null);
				ExitVelocityLimit.Reset(null);
				CriticalVelocity.Reset(null);
				PressureDropCorrelationLevel.Reset(null);
				PressureDropCorrelationInclined.Reset(null);
				PressureDropCorrelationVertical.Reset(null);
				AccelerationPressureDropMethod.Reset(null);
				StaticHeadMethod.Reset(null);
				FrictionFactorMethod.Reset(null);
				SwageMethod.Reset(null);
				TeeMethod.Reset(null);
				TeeExtrapolationMethod.Reset(null);
				NumberOfCells.Reset(null);
				RequiredAccuracy.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 1)
			{
				SwageTransitionFactor.Reset(null);
				TeeMillerAreaLimited.Reset(null);
				TeePartialBodyAreaOnFlow.Reset(null);
				TeeSwageMethod.Reset(null);
				TeeSwageTransitionFactor.Reset(null);
				CriticalPressure.Reset(null);
				InRatingMode.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 2)
			{
				IsDirty.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 4)
			{
				InletMaxRhoV2.Reset(null);
				OutletMaxRhoV2.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetRigorousLineRatingProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			InletPressureDrop.Delete();
			InletRhoV2.Delete();
			InletMaxRhoV2.Delete();
			OutletPressureDrop.Delete();
			OutletRhoV2.Delete();
			OutletMaxRhoV2.Delete();
			ExitVelocityLimit.Delete();
			CriticalVelocity.Delete();
			PressureDropCorrelationLevel.Delete();
			PressureDropCorrelationInclined.Delete();
			PressureDropCorrelationVertical.Delete();
			AccelerationPressureDropMethod.Delete();
			StaticHeadMethod.Delete();
			FrictionFactorMethod.Delete();
			SwageMethod.Delete();
			SwageTransitionFactor.Delete();
			TeeMethod.Delete();
			TeeExtrapolationMethod.Delete();
			TeeMillerAreaLimited.Delete();
			TeePartialBodyAreaOnFlow.Delete();
			TeeSwageMethod.Delete();
			TeeSwageTransitionFactor.Delete();
			NumberOfCells.Delete();
			RequiredAccuracy.Delete();
			CriticalPressure.Delete();
			InRatingMode.Delete();
			IsDirty.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (!base.IsBeingDeleted && StoredRigorousLineRatingRevision < 3)
			{
				TeeMethod.Specify((MethodTypeForTee)(-1), new UserSpecifier());
			}
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			SwageMethod.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			SwageTransitionFactor.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeMethod.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeExtrapolationMethod.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeMillerAreaLimited.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeePartialBodyAreaOnFlow.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeSwageMethod.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeSwageTransitionFactor.AddAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
		}

		protected override void CustomDelete()
		{
			base.CustomDelete();
			SwageMethod.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			SwageTransitionFactor.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeMethod.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeExtrapolationMethod.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeMillerAreaLimited.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeePartialBodyAreaOnFlow.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeSwageMethod.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
			TeeSwageTransitionFactor.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(RigorousTeeSettingsUpdate.Instance);
		}

			if (storedVersion < 6)
			{
				PcdDataModel.AppliedInletPressureDrop = new AcsSeProcessQuantity(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
		}

		protected override void CreateConstiuentDataModels()
		{
			base.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			CreatePrdConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateInitialize()
		{
			base.BoilerplateInitialize();
			FlowFraction = new ProcessFraction(this, PcdDataModel.FlowFraction, Guid.ParseExact("b1770ce2-3435-49fb-8e9c-45b4692c186a", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PrdConstraintsDefinition_FlowFraction);
			ReliefMassFlow = new ProcessMassFlow(this, PcdDataModel.ReliefMassFlow, Guid.ParseExact("bc1b1e1c-1b54-427a-a997-6a8b56a12e8e", "D"));
			AllowableOverpressure = new ProcessFraction(this, PcdDataModel.AllowableOverpressure, Guid.ParseExact("2097342F-35B0-47E9-9E38-C972CF8F6D58", "D"));
			UseCustomOverpressure = new ProcessBool(this, PcdDataModel.UseCustomOverpressure, Guid.ParseExact("11D20312-AE57-456A-BC27-6EA20422F1F4", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PrdConstraintsDefinition_UseCustomOverpressure);
			SuperimposedVariableBackpressure = new ProcessPressureDifference(this, PcdDataModel.SuperimposedVariableBackpressure, Guid.ParseExact("375d9d39-f75f-48d9-ae0c-9e5b2e7a874b", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PrdConstraintsDefinition_SuperimposedVariableBackpressure);
			BuiltUpBackpressure = new ProcessPressureDifference(this, PcdDataModel.BuiltUpBackpressure, Guid.ParseExact("5318846c-61e9-4884-a3ae-9b5370bfef4e", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PrdConstraintsDefinition_BuiltUpBackpressure);
			UseCaseConfigBuiltUpBackpressure = new ProcessBool(this, PcdDataModel.UseCaseConfigBuiltUpBackpressure, Guid.ParseExact("6D4D9FEB-84B6-46FD-8B0B-A687F7E00C77", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PrdConstraintsDefinition_UseCaseConfigBuiltUpBackpressure);
			TotalBackpressure = new ProcessPressure(this, PcdDataModel.TotalBackpressure, Guid.ParseExact("b78e88a1-1db8-4838-b376-5913655d4c59", "D"));
			AppliedInletPressureDrop = new ProcessPressureDifference(this, PcdDataModel.AppliedInletPressureDrop, Guid.ParseExact("D5729ED9-AFBE-4707-ACCB-48C4F2AF4B84", "D"));
			_reliefDevice = new ReliefDeviceReference(this, () => PcdDataModel.ReliefDevice, delegate(AcsSeReliefDevice dm)
			{
				PcdDataModel.ReliefDevice = dm;
			});
			_orificeSizing = new OrificeSizingReference(this, () => PcdDataModel.OrificeSizing, delegate(AcsSeOrificeSizing dm)
			{
				PcdDataModel.OrificeSizing = dm;
			});
			_detailedReliefDevice = new DetailedReliefDeviceReference(this, () => PcdDataModel.DetailedReliefDevice, delegate(AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice dm)
			{
				PcdDataModel.DetailedReliefDevice = dm;
			});
			_ownDetailedReliefDevice = new DetailedReliefDeviceChild(this, () => PcdDataModel.OwnDetailedReliefDevice, delegate(AcsSeDetailedReliefDevice dm)
			{
				PcdDataModel.OwnDetailedReliefDevice = dm;
			});
			_allOrificeSizings = new OrificeSizingChildren(this, PcdDataModel.AllOrificeSizings);
			_messages = new MessageChildren(this, PcdDataModel.Messages);
		}

			_messages.Recall();

		private void ResetPrdConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				FlowFraction.Reset(null);
				ReliefMassFlow.Reset(null);
				AllowableOverpressure.Reset(null);
				UseCustomOverpressure.Reset(null);
				SuperimposedVariableBackpressure.Reset(null);
				BuiltUpBackpressure.Reset(null);
				UseCaseConfigBuiltUpBackpressure.Reset(null);
				TotalBackpressure.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 6)
			{
				AppliedInletPressureDrop.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetPrdConstraintsDefinitionProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

				OwnDetailedReliefDevice.Delete();
			}
			_allOrificeSizings.Clear();
			_messages.Clear();
			FlowFraction.Delete();
			ReliefMassFlow.Delete();
			AllowableOverpressure.Delete();
			UseCustomOverpressure.Delete();
			SuperimposedVariableBackpressure.Delete();
			BuiltUpBackpressure.Delete();
			UseCaseConfigBuiltUpBackpressure.Delete();
			TotalBackpressure.Delete();
			AppliedInletPressureDrop.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

			if (StoredPrdConstraintsDefinitionRevision < 1)

				_allOrificeSizings.Add(OrificeSizing);

		}
