		}

		public DetailedReliefDevice GetOrCreateDetailedReliefDevice()
		{
			return DetailedReliefDevice ?? (DetailedReliefDevice = GetOrCreateOwnDetailedReliefDevice());
		}

		public override void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference managedReference, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
			if (managedReference == _reliefDevice)
			{
				OrificeSizing = GetOrCreateOrificeSizing();
			}
			base.ReferenceChanged(managedReference, update);
		}

		public void SetReliefOrifice(ReliefOrifice reliefOrifice, bool setLinkedReliefDevice = true)
		{
			DetailedReliefDevice = GetOrCreateOwnDetailedReliefDevice();
			if (reliefOrifice == null || (reliefOrifice.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value ?? false))
			{
				DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice = reliefOrifice;
				if (DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				if (DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				if (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				if (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.CustomDetailedReliefDevices.SingleOrDefault((DetailedReliefDevice drd) => drd.ReliefOrifice == reliefOrifice);
				if (detailedReliefDevice == null)
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice = null;
				}
				else
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice = detailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice;
					bool flag = !reliefOrifice.Designation.IsEmpty;
					if (!flag || !detailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty || DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || (DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType != detailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType && (DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)))
					{
						DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.TrySpecifyFrom(detailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter);
					}
					if (!flag || !detailedReliefDevice.InletRating.IsEmpty || DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || (DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType != detailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType && (DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)))
					{
						DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.TrySpecifyFrom(detailedReliefDevice.InletRating);
					}
					if (!flag || !detailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty || DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType != detailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType && (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)))
					{
						DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.TrySpecifyFrom(detailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter);
					}
					if (!flag || !detailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.IsEmpty || DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType != detailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType && (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User || detailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)))
					{
						DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.TrySpecifyFrom(detailedReliefDevice.OutletRating);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty && DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
						{
							DetailedReliefDevice.InletFlangeNominalDiameter.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						if (DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.IsEmpty && DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
						{
							DetailedReliefDevice.InletRating.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						if (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.IsEmpty && DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
						{
							DetailedReliefDevice.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
						if (DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.IsEmpty && DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User)
						{
							DetailedReliefDevice.OutletRating.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (ReliefDevice != null && setLinkedReliefDevice)
			{
				if (DetailedReliefDevice != null && DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice != null)
				{
					ReliefDevice.OrificeArea.TrySpecifyFrom(DetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice.OrificeArea);
				}
				else
				{
					ReliefDevice.OrificeArea.Clear(new UserSpecifier());
				}
				ReliefDevice.DetailedReliefDevice = DetailedReliefDevice;
			}
		}

		public void FixUpLegacyKey(int key)
		{
			if (key >= 0 && base.ModelRegistry.TryGetScenarioByKey(key, out var model, this))
			{
				model.PcdDataModel.LegacyKey = base.ModelRegistry.NewLegacyScenarioKey();
			}
			PcdDataModel.LegacyKey = key;
			_isLegacyFromUpgrade = true;
		}

		public void CalculateBuiltupBackpressureIfNecessary()
		{
			if (!IsBeingRecalled && !base.ModelRegistry.IsBeingRecalled && (UseCaseConfigBuiltUpBackpressure.Value ?? false))
			{
				CaseConfiguration caseConfiguration = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration;
				if (caseConfiguration.BuiltUpBackpressureSource.Value == BuiltUpBackpressureSource.PctOfSet)
				{
					PressureDifference asGauge = ReliefDevice.SetPressure.Value.AsGauge;
					asGauge *= (Scalar)caseConfiguration.DefaultBuiltUpBackpressureFractionOfSet.Value;
					BuiltUpBackpressure.Specify(asGauge, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ParentAssigned()
		{
			if (!IsBeingRecalled && !base.ModelRegistry.IsBeingRecalled)
			{
				OverpressureUpdater.GetSingleton().ReliefDeviceConfigurationChanged(ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration);
			}
		}

		public void ValidateOrificeSizingModelType()
		{
			if ((ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value != OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod && OrificeSizing is KrMethodOrificeSizing) || (ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value == OrificeSizingMethod.KrMethod && OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing))
			{
				OrificeSizing = GetOrCreateOrificeSizing();
			}
			if (OrificeSizing is PsvOrificeSizing psvOrificeSizing && ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value != OrificeSizingMethod.Liquid && ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value != OrificeSizingMethod.NonCertifiedLiquid)
			{
				psvOrificeSizing.CalculatedKv.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeReliefDevice(ReliefDevice reliefDevice)
		{
			_reliefDevice.Value = reliefDevice;
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				Delete();
				return;
			}
			if (StoredPrdConstraintsDefinitionRevision < 2)
			{
				ReliefOrifice oldRo = DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice;
				DetailedReliefDevice?.Delete();
				if (oldRo.IsBuiltInOrifice.Value != true)
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.CustomDetailedReliefDevices.SingleOrDefault((DetailedReliefDevice drd) => drd.ReliefOrifice == oldRo);
					if (detailedReliefDevice == null)
					{
						if (oldRo.OrificeArea.IsEmpty)
						{
							oldRo = null;
						}
						else
						{
							ReliefOrifice value = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.ReliefOrifices.SingleOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, ReliefOrifice> ro) => !MyMath.ValuesDiffer(ro.Value.OrificeArea.ValueIn(Units.cm2), oldRo.OrificeArea.ValueIn(Units.cm2), 1E-06, 1E-12)).Value;
							if (value != null)
							{
								oldRo = value;
							}
							else
							{
								string format = "New_{0}";
								string text = null;
								int num = -1;
								do
								{
									num++;
									text = string.Format(format, num);
								}
								while (!base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.IsUniqueReliefOrificeName(text));
								DetailedReliefDevice detailedReliefDevice2 = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.CreatePsvOrifice(text, oldRo.Designation.Value, oldRo.OrificeArea.Value);
								oldRo = detailedReliefDevice2.ReliefOrifice;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				SetReliefOrifice(oldRo);
			}
			if (StoredPrdConstraintsDefinitionRevision >= 5)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsForControllingDevice())
			{
				double defaultOverpressure = OverpressureDefaultCalculator.GetDefaultOverpressure(this, base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration);
				if (!AllowableOverpressure.IsEmpty && MyMath.ValuesDiffer(defaultOverpressure, AllowableOverpressure.ValueIn(Units.One), 1E-06, 1E-06))
				{
					UseCustomOverpressure.Specify(true, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UseCustomOverpressure.Specify(true, new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		internal bool IsForControllingDevice()
		{
			ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = ReliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration;
			if (reliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice == ReliefDevice || (reliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Count > 0 && reliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices[0] == ReliefDevice))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ReliefDevice == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Contains(ReliefDevice))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Contains(ReliefDevice))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration2 in ReliefDevice.OwnerSystem.ReliefDeviceConfigurations)
			{
				if (reliefDeviceConfiguration2.ReliefDevices.Contains(ReliefDevice))
				{
					return reliefDeviceConfiguration2.TotalOrifice == ReliefDevice || (reliefDeviceConfiguration2.ReliefDevices.Count > 0 && reliefDeviceConfiguration2.ReliefDevices[0] == ReliefDevice);
				}
				if (reliefDeviceConfiguration2.SpareReliefDevices.Contains(ReliefDevice))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
			DetailedReliefDevice ownDetailedReliefDevice = ((PrdConstraintsDefinition)model).OwnDetailedReliefDevice;
			if (ownDetailedReliefDevice != null)
			{
				OwnDetailedReliefDevice.CopyFrom(ownDetailedReliefDevice, onlyUserSpecified);
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePrdConstraintsDefinition val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePrdConstraintsDefinition>();
			if (val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice).Record != null)
			{
				OwnDetailedReliefDevice.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice);
				if (val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice).Record != null && SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.MergedOrificeMap.TryGetValue(((AcsBaseRecord)val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice).Record.RecordGuid(), out var value))
				{
					OwnDetailedReliefDevice.ReliefOrifice = value;
				}
			}
			if (val.DetailedReliefDevice != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.DetailedReliefDevice).Record != null)
			{
				if (val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice).Record != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.DetailedReliefDevice).Record.RecordGuid() == ((AcsBaseRecord)val.OwnDetailedReliefDevice).Record.RecordGuid())
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice = OwnDetailedReliefDevice;
				}
				else
				{
					DetailedReliefDevice = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.MergedDrdMap[((AcsBaseRecord)val.DetailedReliefDevice).Record.RecordGuid()];
				}
			}
			Dictionary<string, OrificeSizing> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, OrificeSizing>();
			OrificeSizing = null;
			_allOrificeSizings.Clear();
			foreach (AcsSeOrificeSizing item in val.AllOrificeSizings.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeOrificeSizing>())
			{
				OrificeSizing orificeSizing = null;
				if (((AcsBase)item).CanCastTo(AcsSePsvOrificeSizing.myGuid))
				{
					orificeSizing = PsvOrificeSizing.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!((AcsBase)item).CanCastTo(AcsSeKrMethodOrificeSizing.myGuid))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					orificeSizing = KrMethodOrificeSizing.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
				}
				_allOrificeSizings.Add(orificeSizing);
				dictionary.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item).Record.RecordGuid(), orificeSizing);
				orificeSizing.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item);
			}
			if (val.OrificeSizing != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.OrificeSizing).Record != null)
			{
				OrificeSizing = dictionary[((AcsBaseRecord)val.OrificeSizing).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
			foreach (AcsSeMessage item2 in val.Messages.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeMessage>())
			{
				AddNewMessage((MessageLevel)item2.Level.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), (MessageLocation)item2.Location.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), item2.MessageText.VarValue, this);
			}
		}

		protected DetailedReliefDevice GetOrCreateOwnDetailedReliefDevice()
		{
			return _ownDetailedReliefDevice.Value ?? (_ownDetailedReliefDevice.Value = DetailedReliefDevice.CreateNew(base.AdbTop));
		}

		protected OrificeSizing GetOrCreateOrificeSizing()
		{
			OrificeSizing orificeSizing = null;
			if (ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value.HasValue)
			{
				if (!TypesAndCreators.TryGetValue(ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value.Value, out var thing))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("No OrificeSizing class associated with OrificeSizingMethod of " + ReliefScenario.OrificeCalculationMethod.Value.Value);
				}
				orificeSizing = _allOrificeSizings.SingleOrDefault((OrificeSizing os) => thing.Item1.IsInstanceOfType(os));
				if (orificeSizing != null)
				{
					return orificeSizing;
				}
				orificeSizing = thing.Item2(base.AdbTop);
				_allOrificeSizings.Add(orificeSizing);
			}
			return orificeSizing;
		}

		public Message AddNewMessage(MessageLevel level, MessageLocation location, string message, IBaseModel refObject)
		{
			if (_messages.Any((Message x) => IsSameMessage(x, level, location, message, refObject)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Message message2 = Message.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			message2.Level.Specify(level, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.Location.Specify(location, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.MessageText.Specify(message, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.RefObject = (BaseModel)refObject;
			_messages.Add(message2);
			return message2;
		}

		public void RemoveMessage(Message message)
		{
			_messages.Remove(message);
		}

		public void ClearMessages()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
		}

		public void RemoveMatchingMessages(MessageLevel? level = null, string message = null, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.Anywhere, IEnumerable<MessageLocation> exceptLocation = null, IBaseModel refObject = null)
		{
			List<Message> list = _messages.Where((Message x) => IsMatchingMessage(x, level, message, location, exceptLocation, refObject)).ToList();
			foreach (Message item in list)
			{
				_messages.Remove(item);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class OrificeSizing : BaseModel
	{

		{

			{
				return OsDataModel.StoredOrificeSizingRevision;
			}
			set
			{
				OsDataModel.StoredOrificeSizingRevision = value;
			}
		}

		public ProcessFraction OrificeUtilization { get; private set; }

		public ProcessEnum<FlowType> FlowType { get; private set; }

		public ProcessString DataStatus { get; private set; }

		public ProcessFraction CapacityUncertaintyFactor { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDouble Noise { get; private set; }

		public ProcessDistance NoiseDistance { get; private set; }

		public ProcessForce ReactionForces { get; private set; }

		public ProcessString Notes { get; private set; }

		public ProcessPressure OverrideReliefPressure { get; private set; }

		public PrdConstraintsDefinition PrdConstraintsDefinition => (PrdConstraintsDefinition)base.Parent;

		public ReliefLoad ReliefLoad => PrdConstraintsDefinition.ReliefScenario.ReliefLoad;

		protected OrificeSizing(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, AcsSeOrificeSizing dataModel)
			: base(modelRegistry, (AcsSeBaseModel)(object)dataModel)

		}

			base.UpdateVersionNumber();
			StoredOrificeSizingRevision = ModelRevision;
		}

		protected override void DataModelBoilerplateFixUp()

			Schedule = new ProcessString(this, PdDataModel.Schedule, Guid.ParseExact("01318BCB-BB29-414B-B0AF-D6AA198B41D9", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.PipeDiameter_Schedule);
			InnerDiameter = new ProcessDistance(this, PdDataModel.InnerDiameter, Guid.ParseExact("4BF53D3F-F90F-4F4D-93A4-2D09FEEC8BEC", "D"));
			OuterDiameter = new ProcessDistance(this, PdDataModel.OuterDiameter, Guid.ParseExact("2EB810A9-812D-452F-A434-043B6ACB9860", "D"));

				Schedule.Reset(null);
				InnerDiameter.Reset(null);
				OuterDiameter.Reset(null);
			}

		{

		}

			Schedule.Delete();
			InnerDiameter.Delete();
			OuterDiameter.Delete();

		}

		{
			NominalDiameter.TrySpecifyFrom(other.NominalDiameter);
			Schedule.TrySpecifyFrom(other.Schedule);
			InnerDiameter.TrySpecifyFrom(other.InnerDiameter);
			OuterDiameter.TrySpecifyFrom(other.OuterDiameter);
		}

		public virtual void Clear(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			NominalDiameter.Clear(specifier);
			Schedule.Clear(specifier);
			InnerDiameter.Clear(specifier);
			OuterDiameter.Clear(specifier);
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredPipeDiameterRevision < 1 && NominalDiameter.ValueIn(Units.inch) == 1.0 && Schedule.Value == "80S")
			{
				InnerDiameter.Specify(24.3078, Units.mm, new CalculationSpecifier());
				OuterDiameter.Specify(33.40100068, Units.mm, new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public void SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(int index, Pipe pipe = null)
		{
			SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(Pipe.Elements, index, pipe);
		}

		public void SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(IReadOnlyList<PipeElement> container, int index, Pipe pipe = null)
		{
			if (PipeDiameter.NominalDiameter.IsValid)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (container.Count > 1)
			{
				PipeElement pipeElement = ((index > 0) ? container[index - 1] : null);
				PipeDiameter pipeDiameter = pipeElement?.OutletDiameter;
				if (pipeElement == null && index < container.Count - 1)
				{
					pipeElement = container[index + 1];
					pipeDiameter = pipeElement.PipeDiameter;
				}
				PipeDiameter.NominalDiameter.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(pipeDiameter?.NominalDiameter);
				PipeDiameter.Schedule.SpecifyDefaultValueVar((pipeElement == null) ? SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.PipeDiameter_Schedule : pipeDiameter?.Schedule);
				PipeDiameter.InnerDiameter.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(pipeDiameter?.InnerDiameter);
				PipeDiameter.OuterDiameter.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(pipeDiameter?.OuterDiameter);
				PipeDiameter.NominalDiameter.Specify(PipeDiameter.NominalDiameter.Value, new UserSpecifier());
				PipeDiameter.Schedule.Specify(PipeDiameter.Schedule.Value, new UserSpecifier());
				if ((pipeDiameter?.InnerDiameter?.SpecifierType ?? SpecifierType.Calculation) == SpecifierType.Calculation)
				{
					PipeDiameter.InnerDiameter.Specify(PipeDiameter.InnerDiameter.Value, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				else
				{
					PipeDiameter.InnerDiameter.Specify(PipeDiameter.InnerDiameter.Value, new UserSpecifier());
				}
				if ((pipeDiameter?.OuterDiameter?.SpecifierType ?? SpecifierType.Calculation) == SpecifierType.Calculation)
				{
					PipeDiameter.OuterDiameter.Specify(PipeDiameter.OuterDiameter.Value, new CalculationSpecifier());
				}
				else
				{
					PipeDiameter.OuterDiameter.Specify(PipeDiameter.OuterDiameter.Value, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
			else if (pipe != null)
			{
				ProcessDistance processDistance = pipe?.OwnerDevice?.GetConnectionDiameterForPipe(pipe);
				if (processDistance != null && processDistance.IsValid)
				{
					PipeDiameter.NominalDiameter.Specify(processDistance.Value, new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(PipeElement other)
		{
			CopyFromImpl(other);
		}

		protected virtual void CopyFromImpl(PipeElement other)
		{
			Name.TrySpecifyFrom(other.Name);
			ElementType.TrySpecifyFrom(other.ElementType);
			EquivalentLength.TrySpecifyFrom(other.EquivalentLength);
			FlowMultiplier.TrySpecifyFrom(other.FlowMultiplier);
			PipeDiameter.CopyFrom(other.PipeDiameter);
			OutletDiameter.CopyFrom(other.OutletDiameter);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePipeElement val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePipeElement>();
			PipeDiameter.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.PipeDiameter);
		}

		protected abstract void SetElementType();

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredPipeElementRevision < 1)
			{
				SetElementType();
			}
		}
	}

			HasTemplate = new ProcessBool(this, PfDataModel.HasTemplate, Guid.ParseExact("2CA400E6-A551-4A20-9C79-92BFE476488A", "D"));
			_pipeFittingTemplate = new PipeFittingTemplateReference(this, () => PfDataModel.PipeFittingTemplate, delegate(AcsSePipeFittingTemplate dm)
			{
				PfDataModel.PipeFittingTemplate = dm;
			});
			_material = new PipeMaterialReference(this, () => PfDataModel.Material, delegate(AcsSePipeMaterial dm)
			{
				PfDataModel.Material = dm;
			});
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecall()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecall();
			_pipeFittingTemplate.Recall();
			_material.Recall();
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecallFixUp();
			ResetPipeFittingProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredPipeFittingRevision);
		}

		private void ResetPipeFittingProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				PressureDropCalculationType.Reset(null);
				Quantity.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 1)
			{
				Roughness.Reset(null);
				RoughnessSource.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 2)
			{
				LOverD.Reset(null);
				K.Reset(null);
				Notes.Reset(null);
				HasTemplate.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetPipeFittingProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			PressureDropCalculationType.Delete();
			Quantity.Delete();
			Roughness.Delete();
			RoughnessSource.Delete();
			LOverD.Delete();
			K.Delete();
			Notes.Delete();
			HasTemplate.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		public void CopyFrom(PipeFitting other)
		{
			CopyFromImpl(other);
		}

		protected override void CopyFromImpl(PipeElement other)
		{
			base.CopyFromImpl(other);
			PipeFitting pipeFitting = other as PipeFitting;
			PressureDropCalculationType.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.PressureDropCalculationType);
			Quantity.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.Quantity);
			Material = pipeFitting.Material;
			Roughness.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.Roughness);
			RoughnessSource.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.RoughnessSource);
			K.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.K);
			LOverD.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.LOverD);
			Notes.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.Notes);
			HasTemplate.TrySpecifyFrom(pipeFitting.HasTemplate);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePipeFitting val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePipeFitting>();
			if (val.PipeFittingTemplate != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.PipeFittingTemplate).Record != null)
			{
				PipeFittingTemplate = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.MergedFittingMap[((AcsBaseRecord)val.PipeFittingTemplate).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
		}

		protected override void SetElementType()
		{
			base.ElementType.Specify(PipeElementType.Fitting, new CalculationSpecifier());
		}

		public void SetTemplate(PipeFittingTemplate template)
		{
			PipeFittingTemplate = template;
			HasTemplate.Specify(template != null, new CalculationSpecifier());
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredPipeFittingRevision < 2)
			{
				HasTemplate.Specify(PipeFittingTemplate != null, new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}
	}

			Roughness = new ProcessDistance(this, PDataModel.Roughness, Guid.ParseExact("a8a3b9cb-9117-40c1-a076-0899eb307c63", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.Pipe_Roughness);
			RoughnessSource = new ProcessEnum<ProcessDataSource>(this, PDataModel.RoughnessSource, Guid.ParseExact("6BA6093C-8F40-4F80-BF0C-D866D956F9A8", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.Pipe_RoughnessSource);
			_material = new PipeMaterialReference(this, () => PDataModel.Material, delegate(AcsSePipeMaterial dm)
			{
				PDataModel.Material = dm;
			});
			_referenceDiameter = new PipeDiameterChild(this, () => PDataModel.ReferenceDiameter, delegate(AcsSePipeDiameter dm)
			{
				PDataModel.ReferenceDiameter = dm;
			});
			_elements = new PipeElementChildren(this, PDataModel.Elements);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecall()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecall();
			_material.Recall();
			_referenceDiameter.Recall();
			_elements.Recall();
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecallFixUp();
			ResetPipeProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredPipeRevision);
		}

		private void ResetPipeProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				Name.Reset(null);
				DefineFromElements.Reset(null);
				ActualLength.Reset(null);
				ElevationChange.Reset(null);
				EquivalentLength.Reset(null);
				Roughness.Reset(null);
				RoughnessSource.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetPipeProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			if (ReferenceDiameter != null)
			{
				ReferenceDiameter.Delete();
			}
			_elements.Clear();
			Name.Delete();
			DefineFromElements.Delete();
			ActualLength.Delete();
			ElevationChange.Delete();
			EquivalentLength.Delete();
			Roughness.Delete();
			RoughnessSource.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomCreateNew()
		{
			base.CustomCreateNew();
			ReferenceDiameter = PipeDiameter.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			_workingCopy = new PipeElementWorkList(this);
			IsWorking = false;
		}

		public void AttachToOutletPipeDefaults(bool creatingNew)
		{
			Roughness.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.Custom_OutletPipe_Roughness, creatingNew);
			EquivalentLength.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.Custom_OutletPipe_EquivalentLength, creatingNew);
		}

		public override void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference managedReferenceBase, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
			if (managedReferenceBase == _elements)
			{
				ElementsChanged(update);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReferenceChanged(managedReferenceBase, update);
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
			Pipe pipe = (Pipe)model;
			ReferenceDiameter.CopyFrom(pipe.ReferenceDiameter);
			Material = pipe.Material;
			_elements.Clear();
			_CopyPipeElements(pipe._elements, _elements);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePipe val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePipe>();
			ReferenceDiameter.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.ReferenceDiameter);
			if (val.Material != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.Material).Record != null)
			{
				Material = SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveConfiguration.MergedMaterialMap[((AcsBaseRecord)val.Material).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
			_elements.Clear();
			_CopyPipeElementRecords(val.Elements.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSePipeElement>(), _elements);
		}

		public void CreateWorkingCopy()
		{
			_workingCopy.Clear();
			IsWorking = true;
			_CopyPipeElements(_elements, _workingCopy);
		}

		private void _CopyPipeElements(IEnumerable<PipeElement> source, IList<PipeElement> dest)
		{
			foreach (PipeElement item in source)
			{
				PipeFittingTemplate fittingTemplate = null;
				if (item is PipeFitting)
				{
					fittingTemplate = ((PipeFitting)item).PipeFittingTemplate;
				}
				PipeElement pipeElement = CreatePipeElement(item.ElementType.Value.Value, fittingTemplate);
				pipeElement.CopyFrom(item);
				dest.Add(pipeElement);
			}
		}

		private void _CopyPipeElementRecords(IEnumerable<AcsSePipeElement> source, IList<PipeElement> dest)
		{
			foreach (AcsSePipeElement item in source)
			{
				PipeElement pipeElement = CreatePipeElement((PipeElementType)item.ElementType.VarValue.Value);
				pipeElement.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item);
				dest.Add(pipeElement);
			}
		}

		public void ResolveWorkingCopy()
		{
			_elements.Clear();
			foreach (PipeElement item in _workingCopy)
			{
				_elements.Add(item);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _elements.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				PipeElement pipeElement = _elements[i];
				PipeElement pipeElement2 = _elements[i + 1];
				if (pipeElement is MultiDiameterElement)
				{
					pipeElement.OutletDiameter.CopyFrom(pipeElement2.PipeDiameter);
				}
			}
			PipeElement pipeElement3 = _elements.LastOrDefault();
			if (pipeElement3 != null && pipeElement3 is MultiDiameterElement)
			{
				pipeElement3.OutletDiameter.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
			ClearCalculatedKValues();
			IsWorking = false;
			_workingCopy.Clear();
		}

		public void ClearCalculatedKValues()
		{
			foreach (MultiDiameterElement item in Elements.OfType<MultiDiameterElement>())
			{
				item.K.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public void ClearCalculatedSwageKValues()
		{
			foreach (Swage item in Elements.OfType<Swage>())
			{
				item.K.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public void ClearCalculatedTeeKValues()
		{
			foreach (Tee item in Elements.OfType<Tee>())
			{
				item.K.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public void DiscardWorkingCopy()
		{
			foreach (PipeElement item in _workingCopy)
			{
				item.Delete();
			}
			IsWorking = false;
			_workingCopy.Clear();
		}

		public int IndexOf(PipeElement item)
		{
			if (!IsWorking)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _workingCopy.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void AppendElement(PipeElementType elementType, PipeFittingTemplate fitingTemplate = null)
		{
			_workingCopy.Add(CreatePipeElement(elementType, fitingTemplate));
		}

		public bool InsertElement(PipeElement item, int index)
		{
			if (!IsWorking)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > _workingCopy.Count || item.Pipe != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_workingCopy.Insert(index, item);
			return true;
		}

		public bool DeleteElement(PipeElement item)
		{
			if (!IsWorking)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _workingCopy.Remove(item);
		}

		public bool SwapElements(PipeElement item1, PipeElement item2)
		{
			if (!IsWorking)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = _workingCopy.IndexOf(item1);
			int num2 = _workingCopy.IndexOf(item2);
			if (num < 0 || num2 < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_workingCopy[num] = item2;
			_workingCopy[num2] = item1;
			return true;
		}

		public bool ChangeElementType(PipeElement item, PipeElementType elementType, PipeFittingTemplate fittingTemplate = null)
		{
			if (!IsWorking)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = _workingCopy.IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PipeElement pipeElement = CreatePipeElement(elementType, fittingTemplate);
			_workingCopy[num] = pipeElement;
			bool flag = pipeElement.Name.TrySpecifyFrom(item.Name);
			return true;
		}

		public PipeElement CreatePipeElement(PipeElementType elementType, PipeFittingTemplate fittingTemplate = null)
		{
			switch (elementType)
			{
			case PipeElementType.Segment:
				return PipeSegment.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			case PipeElementType.Fitting:
			{
				PipeFitting pipeFitting = PipeFitting.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
				pipeFitting.SetTemplate(fittingTemplate);
				return pipeFitting;
			}
			case PipeElementType.Swage:
				return Swage.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			case PipeElementType.Tee:
				return Tee.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected void ElementsChanged(IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
			if (update.New is PipeElement pipeElement)
			{
				if (update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.Append || update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.Assign || update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.Insert)
				{
					pipeElement.SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(update.Index ?? (-1), this);
				}
				if (update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.Assign || update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.Insert)
				{
					int num = update.Index.GetValueOrDefault(_elements.Count) + 1;
					if (num < _elements.Count)
					{
						Elements[num]?.SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(num, this);
					}
				}
			}
			if ((update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.Remove || update.UpdateType == ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted) && update.Index.HasValue && update.Index.Value < _elements.Count)
			{
				_elements[update.Index.Value].SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(update.Index.Value, this);
			}
		}
	}

		}

				PprDataModel.OperatingTemperatureSource = new AcsSeProcessInt(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);

				PprDataModel.OperatingPressureSource = new AcsSeProcessInt(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 2)
			{
				PprDataModel.ReliefDeviceType = new AcsSeProcessInt(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 5)
			{
				PprDataModel.DesignCode = new AcsSeProcessInt(base.ModelRegistry.AdbTop);
			}
		}

			}
			if (storedVersion < 5)

				DesignCode.Reset(null);
			}
		}

			ReliefDeviceType.AddAffectedProcessAction(ReliefDeviceTypeUpdater.GetSingleton());
		}

		public override void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference reference, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
			base.ReferenceChanged(reference, update);
			if (reference != _bindingOrificeScenario)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!(update.New is ReliefScenario reliefScenario))
			{
				foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice in SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices)
				{
					reliefDevice.DetailedReliefDevice = null;
				}
				return;
			}
			SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration = reliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ReliefDevice, PrdConstraintsDefinition> prdConstraint in reliefScenario.PrdConstraints)
			{
				prdConstraint.Key.DetailedReliefDevice = prdConstraint.Value.DetailedReliefDevice;
			}
		}

		public ReliefScenario CreateReliefScenario(ReliefDescription reliefDescription = null, ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = null)
		{
			if (reliefDeviceConfiguration == null)
			{
				reliefDeviceConfiguration = SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration;
			}
			ReliefScenario reliefScenario = ReliefScenario.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_reliefScenarios.Add(reliefScenario);
			if (reliefDescription == null)
			{
				reliefDescription = CreateReliefDescription();
			}
			reliefScenario.ReliefDescription = reliefDescription;
			reliefScenario.ReliefDeviceConfiguration = reliefDeviceConfiguration;
			return reliefScenario;
		}

		public ReliefDevice CreateReliefDevice(ReliefDeviceType type)
		{
			ReliefDevice reliefDevice = ReliefDevice.CreateNew(type, base.AdbTop);
			_reliefDevices.Add(reliefDevice);
			reliefDevice.CreatePipeLine();
			reliefDevice.OwnerSystem = this;
			return reliefDevice;
		}

		public Pipe CreatePipe()
		{
			Pipe pipe = Pipe.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_pipes.Add(pipe);
			return pipe;
		}

		public void FixUpLegacyKey(int key)
		{
			PprDataModel.LegacyKey = key;
		}

		public void SetSizingCase(ReliefScenario bindingScenario)
		{
			BindingOrificeScenario = bindingScenario;
			foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice in ReliefDevices)
			{
				reliefDevice.SetSizingCase(bindingScenario);
			}
		}

		internal void ReliefDeviceTypeChanged()
		{
			if (!ReliefDeviceType.Value.HasValue || IsBeingRecalled || base.ModelRegistry.IsBeingRecalled || (SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice == null && SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Count == 0 && SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Count == 0))
			{
				return;
			}
			ReliefDeviceConfiguration orCreateCacheReliefDeviceConfiguration = GetOrCreateCacheReliefDeviceConfiguration();
			MigrateReliefDevicesFromSelectedToCacheConfiguration(orCreateCacheReliefDeviceConfiguration, ReliefDeviceType.Value.Value);
			EnsurePrdConstraintsDefinitionsExistForNewPrd(SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice);
			if (BindingOrificeScenario == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice in SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices)
			{
				BindingOrificeScenario.GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(reliefDevice);
				BindingOrificeScenario.GetOrCreateLineRating(reliefDevice.PipeLine);
				reliefDevice.SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition = BindingOrificeScenario.PrdConstraints[reliefDevice];
				reliefDevice.SizingCasePsvOrificeSizing = reliefDevice.SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition.OrificeSizing as PsvOrificeSizing;
			}
		}

		protected ReliefDescription CreateReliefDescription()
		{
			ReliefDescription reliefDescription = ReliefDescription.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_reliefDescriptions.Add(reliefDescription);
			return reliefDescription;
		}

		protected ReliefDeviceConfiguration CreateReliefDeviceConfiguration()
		{
			ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = ReliefDeviceConfiguration.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_reliefDeviceConfigurations.Add(reliefDeviceConfiguration);
			return reliefDeviceConfiguration;
		}

		private ReliefDeviceConfiguration GetOrCreateCacheReliefDeviceConfiguration()
		{
			ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = ReliefDeviceConfigurations.SingleOrDefault((ReliefDeviceConfiguration rdc) => rdc.ConfigurationType.Value == ReliefDeviceConfigurationType.Cache);
			return (reliefDeviceConfiguration != null) ? reliefDeviceConfiguration : CreateReliefDeviceConfiguration();
		}

		private void MigrateReliefDevicesFromSelectedToCacheConfiguration(ReliefDeviceConfiguration cache, ReliefDeviceType newType)
		{
			cache.ConfigurationType.Specify(ReliefDeviceConfigurationType.Cache, new CalculationSpecifier());
			cache.LockOverpressure = true;
			SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.LockOverpressure = true;
			List<ReliefDevice> list = cache.ReliefDevices.ToList();
			List<ReliefDevice> list2 = cache.SpareReliefDevices.ToList();
			ReliefDevice totalOrifice = cache.TotalOrifice;
			cache.ReliefDevices.Clear();
			cache.SpareReliefDevices.Clear();
			foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice2 in SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices)
			{
				cache.ReliefDevices.Add(reliefDevice2);
			}
			foreach (ReliefDevice spareReliefDevice in SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices)
			{
				cache.SpareReliefDevices.Add(spareReliefDevice);
			}
			cache.TotalOrifice = SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice;
			SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Clear();
			SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Clear();
			foreach (ReliefDevice item in list)
			{
				SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (ReliefDevice item2 in list2)
			{
				SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Add(item2);
			}
			if (!list.Any())
			{
				ReliefDevice reliefDevice = CreateReliefDevice(newType);
				reliefDevice.CreatePipeLine();
				SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Add(reliefDevice);
			}
			SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice = ((totalOrifice == null) ? SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices[0] : totalOrifice);
			cache.LockOverpressure = false;
			SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.LockOverpressure = false;
		}

		private void EnsurePrdConstraintsDefinitionsExistForNewPrd(ReliefDevice reliefDevice)
		{
			foreach (ReliefScenario item in ReliefScenarios.Where((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.ReliefDeviceConfiguration == SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration))
			{
				item.ReliefDeviceTypeChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 1)
			{
				DischargeLocation = DischargeLocation.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			}
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 2 || ReliefDeviceType.IsEmpty)
			{
				ReliefDeviceType.Specify(SelectedReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices[0].ReliefDeviceType, new UserSpecifier());
			}
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 4)
			{
				foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice2 in ReliefDevices)
				{
					reliefDevice2.SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition = BindingOrificeScenario?.PrdConstraints[reliefDevice2];
					reliefDevice2.SizingCaseScenario = BindingOrificeScenario;
					reliefDevice2.SizingCasePsvOrificeSizing = reliefDevice2.SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition?.OrificeSizing as PsvOrificeSizing;
					reliefDevice2.OwnerSystem = this;
				}
			}
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 6 && BindingOrificeScenario != null)
			{
				foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice3 in ReliefDevices)
				{
					if (reliefDevice3.PipeLine != null)
					{
						BindingOrificeScenario.PipeLineConstraints.TryGetValue(reliefDevice3.PipeLine, out var value);
						value?.UpdatePipeLineRatingModeSetting();
					}
				}
			}
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 7)
			{
				if (BindingOrificeScenario != null)
				{
					SetSizingCase(BindingOrificeScenario);
				}
				if (ReliefDeviceConfigurations.Count > 1 && ReliefDeviceConfigurations[0].ReliefDevices.First().ReliefDeviceType == ReliefDeviceConfigurations[1].ReliefDevices.First().ReliefDeviceType)
				{
					ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = ReliefDeviceConfigurations[0];
					ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration2 = ReliefDeviceConfigurations[1];
					ReliefDevice totalOrifice = reliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice;
					ReliefDevice totalOrifice2 = reliefDeviceConfiguration2.TotalOrifice;
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = false;
					foreach (ReliefScenario reliefScenario in ReliefScenarios)
					{
						if (reliefScenario.TotalOrificeConstraints.ReliefDevice.ModelKey == totalOrifice.ModelKey)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else if (reliefScenario.TotalOrificeConstraints.ReliefDevice.ModelKey == totalOrifice2.ModelKey)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag != flag2)
					{
						ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration3 = ((!flag) ? reliefDeviceConfiguration2 : reliefDeviceConfiguration);
						MigrateReliefDevicesFromSelectedToCacheConfiguration(reliefDeviceConfiguration3, AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefDeviceType.Psv);
						reliefDeviceConfiguration3.LockOverpressure = true;
						IList<ReliefDevice>[] array = new IList<ReliefDevice>[2] { reliefDeviceConfiguration3.SpareReliefDevices, reliefDeviceConfiguration3.ReliefDevices };
						foreach (IList<ReliefDevice> list in array)
						{
							for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
							{
								ReliefDevice reliefDevice = list[num];
								foreach (ReliefScenario reliefScenario2 in ReliefScenarios)
								{
									if (reliefScenario2.PrdConstraints.TryGetValue(reliefDevice, out var value2))
									{
										value2.Delete();
									}
									if (reliefScenario2.PipeLineConstraints.TryGetValue(reliefDevice.PipeLine, out var value3))
									{
										value3.Delete();
									}
								}
								reliefDevice.Delete();
							}
						}
						reliefDeviceConfiguration3.Delete();
					}
				}
			}
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 8)
			{
				base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.ShouldForceCalculate.Specify(true, null);
			}
			if (StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision < 9 && StoredPressureProtectionRequirementRevision >= 7 && BindingOrificeScenario != null)
			{
				SetSizingCase(BindingOrificeScenario);
			}
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
			PressureProtectionRequirement pressureProtectionRequirement = (PressureProtectionRequirement)model;
			DischargeLocation.CopyFrom(pressureProtectionRequirement.DischargeLocation, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSePressureProtectionRequirement val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSePressureProtectionRequirement>();
			DischargeLocation.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.DischargeLocation);
			foreach (AcsSeReliefDevice item5 in val.ReliefDevices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefDevice>())
			{
				ReliefDevice reliefDevice = null;
				if (((AcsBase)item5).CanCastTo(AcsSePressureSafetyValve.myGuid))
				{
					reliefDevice = CreateReliefDevice(AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefDeviceType.Psv);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!((AcsBase)item5).CanCastTo(AcsSeRuptureDisk.myGuid))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					reliefDevice = CreateReliefDevice(AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk);
				}
				ReliefDeviceMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item5).Record.RecordGuid(), reliefDevice);
				reliefDevice.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item5);
			}
			ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = ReliefDeviceConfigurations.First();
			AcsSeReliefDeviceConfiguration val2 = val.ReliefDeviceConfigurations.ValueAtLocation(0);
			reliefDeviceConfiguration.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val2);
			ReliefDeviceConfigurationMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val2).Record.RecordGuid(), reliefDeviceConfiguration);
			foreach (AcsSeReliefDevice item6 in val2.ReliefDevices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefDevice>())
			{
				ReliefDevice item = ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item6).Record.RecordGuid()];
				reliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (AcsSeReliefDevice item7 in val2.SpareReliefDevices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefDevice>())
			{
				ReliefDevice item2 = ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item7).Record.RecordGuid()];
				reliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Add(item2);
			}
			reliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice = ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)val2.TotalOrifice).Record.RecordGuid()];
			foreach (AcsSeReliefDeviceConfiguration item8 in val.ReliefDeviceConfigurations.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefDeviceConfiguration>().Skip(1))
			{
				ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration2 = CreateReliefDeviceConfiguration();
				reliefDeviceConfiguration2.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item8);
				foreach (AcsSeReliefDevice item9 in item8.ReliefDevices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefDevice>())
				{
					ReliefDevice item3 = ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item9).Record.RecordGuid()];
					reliefDeviceConfiguration2.ReliefDevices.Add(item3);
				}
				foreach (AcsSeReliefDevice item10 in item8.SpareReliefDevices.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefDevice>())
				{
					ReliefDevice item4 = ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item10).Record.RecordGuid()];
					reliefDeviceConfiguration2.SpareReliefDevices.Add(item4);
				}
				reliefDeviceConfiguration2.TotalOrifice = ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item8.TotalOrifice).Record.RecordGuid()];
				ReliefDeviceConfigurationMap.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item8).Record.RecordGuid(), reliefDeviceConfiguration2);
			}
			Dictionary<string, ReliefScenario> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ReliefScenario>();
			foreach (AcsSeReliefScenario item11 in val.ReliefScenarios.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeReliefScenario>())
			{
				ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration3 = ReliefDeviceConfigurationMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item11.ReliefDeviceConfiguration).Record.RecordGuid()];
				ReliefScenario reliefScenario = CreateReliefScenario(null, reliefDeviceConfiguration3);
				reliefScenario.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item11);
				dictionary.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item11).Record.RecordGuid(), reliefScenario);
			}
			if (val.BindingOrificeScenario != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.BindingOrificeScenario).Record != null)
			{
				BindingOrificeScenario = dictionary[((AcsBaseRecord)val.BindingOrificeScenario).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
			foreach (ReliefDevice reliefDevice2 in ReliefDevices)
			{
				reliefDevice2.SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition = BindingOrificeScenario?.PrdConstraints[reliefDevice2];
				reliefDevice2.SizingCaseScenario = BindingOrificeScenario;
				reliefDevice2.SizingCasePsvOrificeSizing = reliefDevice2.SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition?.OrificeSizing as PsvOrificeSizing;
			}
			foreach (AcsSeMessage item12 in val.Messages.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeMessage>())
			{
				AddNewMessage((MessageLevel)item12.Level.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), (MessageLocation)item12.Location.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), item12.MessageText.VarValue, this);
			}
		}

		public void RemapScenarioKeysForRecord(PressureProtectionRequirement sourceModel, Dictionary<int, int> keyMap = null)
		{
			AcsSePressureProtectionRequirement val = ((AcsBase)sourceModel.DataModel).CastTo<AcsSePressureProtectionRequirement>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ReliefScenarios.Count; i++)
			{
				AcsSeReliefScenario val2 = val.ReliefScenarios.ValueAtLocation(i);
				ReliefScenario reliefScenario = ReliefScenarios[i];
				if (keyMap != null)
				{
					reliefScenario.TotalOrificeConstraints.FixUpLegacyKey(keyMap[val2.TotalOrificeConstraints.LegacyKey]);
				}
				else
				{
					reliefScenario.TotalOrificeConstraints.FixUpLegacyKey(val2.TotalOrificeConstraints.LegacyKey);
				}
			}
		}

		public Message AddNewMessage(MessageLevel level, MessageLocation location, string message, IBaseModel refObject)
		{
			if (_messages.Any((Message x) => IsSameMessage(x, level, location, message, refObject)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Message message2 = Message.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			message2.Level.Specify(level, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.Location.Specify(location, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.MessageText.Specify(message, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.RefObject = (BaseModel)refObject;
			_messages.Add(message2);
			return message2;
		}

		public void RemoveMessage(Message message)
		{
			_messages.Remove(message);
		}

		public void ClearMessages()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
		}

		public void RemoveMatchingMessages(MessageLevel? level = null, string message = null, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.Anywhere, IEnumerable<MessageLocation> exceptLocation = null, IBaseModel refObject = null)
		{
			List<Message> list = _messages.Where((Message x) => IsMatchingMessage(x, level, message, location, exceptLocation, refObject)).ToList();
			foreach (Message item in list)
			{
				_messages.Remove(item);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ReliefDescription : BaseModel
	{
		private ReliefLoadReference _selectedReliefLoad;

		private ReliefDeviceConfigurationReliefLoadChildDict _reliefLoads;

		public static ReliefDescription CreateNew(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AcsSeReliefDescription val = new AcsSeReliefDescription(adbTop);
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = ModelRegistry.GetModelRegistry(adbTop);
			ReliefDescription reliefDescription = new ReliefDescription(modelRegistry, val);
			reliefDescription.CreateConstiuentDataModels();
			((AcsSeBaseModel)val).ModelTypeGuid = ModelBuilder.ReliefDescriptionGuid.ToString("D");
			reliefDescription.Initialize();
			reliefDescription.UpdateVersionNumber();
			reliefDescription.ResetProcessVars();
			reliefDescription.CustomCreateNew();
			modelRegistry.RegisterNewModel(reliefDescription);
			return reliefDescription;
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			_reliefLoads = new ReliefDeviceConfigurationReliefLoadChildDict(base.ModelRegistry, RdDataModel.ReliefLoads, this);
			ReliefLoadCalculationType.AddAffectedProcessAction(ReliefLoadCalculationTypeUpdater.GetSingleton());
			EmergencyType.AddAffectedProcessAction(EmergencyTypeUpdater.GetSingleton());
			EmergencyType.AddAffectedProcessAction(OverpressureUpdater.GetSingleton());
		}

		protected override void CustomDelete()
		{
			_reliefLoads.Clear();
			base.CustomDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomRecall()
		{
			base.CustomRecall();
			_reliefLoads.Recall();
		}

		public ReliefScenario GetReliefScenario(ReliefDeviceConfiguration rdc)
		{
			if (PressureProtectionRequirement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefScenarios.SingleOrDefault((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.ReliefDescription == this && rs.ReliefDeviceConfiguration == rdc);
		}

		public IEnumerable<ReliefScenario> GetReliefScenarios()
		{
			if (PressureProtectionRequirement == null)
			{
				return new List<ReliefScenario>();
			}
			return PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefScenarios.Where((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.ReliefDescription == this);
		}

		public ReliefLoad CreateReliefLoad(ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration)
		{
			if (reliefDeviceConfiguration == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Cannot create ReliefLoad with null ReliefDeviceConfiguration");
			}
			ReliefLoad reliefLoad = ReliefLoad.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_reliefLoads.Add(reliefDeviceConfiguration, reliefLoad);
			reliefLoad.UpdateReliefLoadCalculation();
			return reliefLoad;
		}

		public Fluid CreateReliefFluid(ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefPressureDefiner)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void EmergencyTypeUpdated()
		{
			ReliefLoadCalculationType reliefLoadCalculationType = ApplicableReliefLoadCalculationType(EmergencyType.Value);
			if (!ReliefLoadCalculationType.Value.HasValue || ReliefLoadCalculationType.Value.Value != reliefLoadCalculationType)
			{
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.Specify(reliefLoadCalculationType, new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public static ReliefLoadCalculationType ApplicableReliefLoadCalculationType(EmergScenarioType? emergScenarioType)
		{
			return emergScenarioType switch
			{
				EmergScenarioType.Control_Valve_Failure => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.ControlValveFailure, 
				EmergScenarioType.Exch_Tube_Rupture => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.TubeRupture, 
				EmergScenarioType.Fire => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.Fire, 
				EmergScenarioType.Reflux_Failure => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.RefluxFailure, 
				EmergScenarioType.Thermal_Expansion => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.ThermalExpansion, 
				EmergScenarioType.Fan_Failure => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.FanFailure, 
				_ => AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefLoadCalculationType.Trivial, 
			};
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeReliefDescription val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeReliefDescription>();
			Dictionary<string, ReliefLoad> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ReliefLoad>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)val.ReliefLoads).Length; i++)
			{
				AcsSeReliefDeviceConfiguration val2 = val.ReliefLoads.IDAtLocation(i);
				AcsSeReliefLoad val3 = ((ReferenceArray<AcsSeReliefDeviceConfiguration, AcsSeReliefLoad>)(object)val.ReliefLoads).ValueAtLocation(i);
				ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration = PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefDeviceConfigurationMap[((AcsBaseRecord)val2).Record.RecordGuid()];
				ReliefLoad value = null;
				if (!ReliefLoads.TryGetValue(reliefDeviceConfiguration, out value))
				{
					value = CreateReliefLoad(reliefDeviceConfiguration);
				}
				value.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val3);
				dictionary.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val3).Record.RecordGuid(), value);
			}
			if (val.SelectedReliefLoad != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.SelectedReliefLoad).Record != null)
			{
				SelectedReliefLoad = dictionary[((AcsBaseRecord)val.SelectedReliefLoad).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
		}
	}

			SetPressure.Delete();
			SetPressureFromDesignPressure.Delete();
			OrificeArea.Delete();
			VaporKd.Delete();
			LiquidKd.Delete();
			MixedKd.Delete();
			BackpressureLimitFractionOfSetPressure.Delete();
			IsAbstract.Delete();
			Notes.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		internal static ReliefDevice CreateNew(ReliefDeviceType deviceType, IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			return deviceType switch
			{
				ReliefDeviceType.Psv => PressureSafetyValve.CreateNew(adbTop), 
				ReliefDeviceType.RuptureDisk => RuptureDisk.CreateNew(adbTop), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredReliefDeviceRevision < 3)
			{
				SizingCaseRigorousLineRating = SizingCaseScenario?.GetOrCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(PipeLine).LineRating as RigorousLineRating;
			}
		}

		public PipeLine CreatePipeLine()
		{
			_pipeLine.Value = PipeLine.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			PipeLine.CreatePipes();
			return PipeLine;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ReliefDeviceType.ToString() + ": " + PressureProtectionRequirement.Name.Value + " " + DeviceName.Value;
		}

		public ProcessDistance GetConnectionDiameterForPipe(Pipe pipe)
		{
			if (PipeLine == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (pipe == PipeLine.InletPipe)
			{
				return DetailedReliefDevice?.InletFlangeNominalDiameter;
			}
			if (pipe == PipeLine.OutletPipe)
			{
				return DetailedReliefDevice?.OutletFlangeNominalDiameter;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
			ReliefDevice reliefDevice = (ReliefDevice)model;
			PipeLine.CopyFrom(reliefDevice.PipeLine, onlyUserSpecified);
			DetailedReliefDevice = reliefDevice.DetailedReliefDevice;
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeReliefDevice val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeReliefDevice>();
			PipeLine.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.PipeLine);
			foreach (AcsSeMessage item in val.Messages.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeMessage>())
			{
				AddNewMessage((MessageLevel)item.Level.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), (MessageLocation)item.Location.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), item.MessageText.VarValue, this);
			}
		}

		public void SwitchPipingMode(bool isNewModeRatingMode)
		{
			PipeLine.InletPipe.DefineFromElements.Specify(isNewModeRatingMode, new CalculationSpecifier());
			PipeLine.OutletPipe.DefineFromElements.Specify(isNewModeRatingMode, new CalculationSpecifier());
		}

		public void SetSizingCase(ReliefScenario sizingCase)
		{
			SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition = sizingCase?.GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(this);
			SizingCaseRigorousLineRating = sizingCase?.GetOrCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(PipeLine)?.LineRating as RigorousLineRating;
			SizingCaseScenario = sizingCase;
			SizingCasePsvOrificeSizing = SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition?.OrificeSizing as PsvOrificeSizing;
			if (sizingCase != null)
			{
				ProcessArea processArea = SizingCaseConstraintsDefinition?.DetailedReliefDevice?.ReliefOrifice?.OrificeArea;
				if (processArea != null)
				{
					OrificeArea.TrySpecifyFrom(processArea);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				OrificeArea.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		public double GetReferenceKd(FluidPhaseRegime forPhase, DetailedReliefDevice forDRD = null)
		{
			forDRD = forDRD ?? DetailedReliefDevice;
			double defaultKd = GetDefaultKd(forPhase);
			ReliefOrifice reliefOrifice = forDRD?.ReliefOrifice;
			if (reliefOrifice == null)
			{
				return defaultKd;
			}
			double value;
			switch (forPhase)
			{
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical:
				value = reliefOrifice.VaporKd.Value;
				break;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
				value = reliefOrifice.LiquidKd.Value;
				break;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase:
				value = reliefOrifice.MixedKd.Value;
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			return double.IsNaN(value) ? defaultKd : value;
		}

		internal abstract double GetDefaultKd(FluidPhaseRegime forPhase);

		public Message AddNewMessage(MessageLevel level, MessageLocation location, string message, IBaseModel refObject)
		{
			if (_messages.Any((Message x) => IsSameMessage(x, level, location, message, refObject)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Message message2 = Message.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			message2.Level.Specify(level, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.Location.Specify(location, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.MessageText.Specify(message, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.RefObject = (BaseModel)refObject;
			_messages.Add(message2);
			return message2;
		}

		public void RemoveMessage(Message message)
		{
			_messages.Remove(message);
		}

		public void ClearMessages()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
		}

		public void RemoveMatchingMessages(MessageLevel? level = null, string message = null, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.Anywhere, IEnumerable<MessageLocation> exceptLocation = null, IBaseModel refObject = null)
		{
			List<Message> list = _messages.Where((Message x) => IsMatchingMessage(x, level, message, location, exceptLocation, refObject)).ToList();
			foreach (Message item in list)
			{
				_messages.Remove(item);
			}
		}
	}

		internal void PsvTypeChanged()
		{
			ProcessFraction defaultValueVar;
			switch (PsvType.Value)
			{
			case AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.PsvType.Conventional:
				defaultValueVar = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.ConventionalMaxAllowedBackpressureFraction;
				break;
			case AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.PsvType.BalancedBellows:
				defaultValueVar = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.BalancedBellowsMaxAllowedBackpressureFraction;
				break;
			case AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.PsvType.PilotOperated:
				defaultValueVar = base.ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration.PilotOperatedMaxAllowedBackpressureFraction;
				break;
			case null:
				base.BackpressureLimitFractionOfSetPressure.Clear(null);
				return;
			default:
				base.BackpressureLimitFractionOfSetPressure.Clear(null);
				return;
			}
			base.BackpressureLimitFractionOfSetPressure.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(defaultValueVar);
		}

		internal override double GetDefaultKd(FluidPhaseRegime forPhase)
		{
			switch (forPhase)
			{
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Vapor:
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Supercritical:
				return SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.ReliefDevice_VaporKd.Value;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.Liquid:
				return SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.ReliefDevice_LiquidKd.Value;
			case FluidPhaseRegime.TwoPhase:
				return SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveDefaultDefiner.ReliefDevice_MixedKd.Value;
			default:
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			if (Fluid != null)
			{
				Fluid.Delete();
			}
			MassFlow.Delete();
			MassFlowSource.Delete();
			VaporFraction.Delete();
			Phase.Delete();
			ReliefTemperature.Delete();
			ReliefTemperatureSource.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomCreateNew()
		{
			base.CustomCreateNew();
			CreateFluid();
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			_reliefLoadCalculations = new ReliefLoadCalculationContainer(base.ModelRegistry, RlDataModel.ReliefLoadCalculations, this);
		}

		protected override void CustomRecall()
		{
			base.CustomRecall();
			_reliefLoadCalculations.Recall();
			if (StoredReliefLoadRevision < 1)
			{
				UpdateReliefLoadCalculation();
			}
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredReliefLoadRevision < 3 && !ReliefTemperatureSource.IsEmpty && (ReliefTemperatureSource.Value.GetValueOrDefault() == AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefTemperatureSource.Reference || ReliefTemperatureSource.Value == AspenTech.EquipmentAnalysis.Infrastructure.ReliefTemperatureSource.Specified) && VaporFraction.Value.IsValid)
			{
				VaporFraction.Clear(new CalculationSpecifier());
			}
		}

		protected override void CustomDelete()
		{
			ReliefLoadCalculations.Clear();
			base.CustomDelete();
		}

		public ReliefDeviceConfiguration FindReliefDeviceConfiguration()
		{
			return ReliefDescription.ReliefLoads.SingleOrDefault((KeyValuePair<ReliefDeviceConfiguration, ReliefLoad> pair) => pair.Value == this).Key;
		}

		public ReliefScenario FindReliefScenario()
		{
			return PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefScenarios.SingleOrDefault((ReliefScenario rs) => rs.ReliefDescription == ReliefDescription && rs.ReliefDeviceConfiguration == FindReliefDeviceConfiguration());
		}

		public void MassFlowSourceUpdated()
		{
			UpdateReliefLoadCalculation();
		}

		public void UpdateReliefLoadCalculation()
		{
			ReliefLoadCalculation value = null;
			if (ReliefDescription.ReliefLoadCalculationType.Value.HasValue && !ReliefLoadCalculations.TryGetValue(ReliefDescription.ReliefLoadCalculationType.Value.Value, out value))
			{
				value = CreateReliefLoadCalculation();
				if (value != null)
				{
					ReliefLoadCalculations.Add(ReliefDescription.ReliefLoadCalculationType.Value.Value, value);
				}
			}
			ReliefLoadCalculation = value;
		}

		protected ReliefLoadCalculation CreateReliefLoadCalculation()
		{
			return _CreateReliefLoadCalculationOfType(ReliefDescription.ReliefLoadCalculationType.Value);
		}

		private ReliefLoadCalculation _CreateReliefLoadCalculationOfType(ReliefLoadCalculationType? type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				null => throw new InvalidOperationException("CreateReliefLoadCalculation called before type was set"), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.Trivial => TrivialCalculation.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.ControlValveFailure => ControlValveFailure.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.FanFailure => FanFailure.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.RefluxFailure => RefluxFailure.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.TubeRupture => TubeRupture.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.ThermalExpansion => ThermalExpansion.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				ReliefLoadCalculationType.Fire => Fire.CreateNew(base.AdbTop), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"Cound not create ReliefLoadCalculation for value of enum, {type}"), 
			};
		}

		internal Fluid CreateFluid()
		{
			return Fluid = Fluid.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeReliefLoad val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeReliefLoad>();
			Fluid.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.Fluid);
			Dictionary<string, ReliefLoadCalculation> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ReliefLoadCalculation>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)val.ReliefLoadCalculations).Length; i++)
			{
				int num = ((ValueArray<int, AcsSeReliefLoadCalculation>)(object)val.ReliefLoadCalculations).IDAtLocation(i);
				AcsSeReliefLoadCalculation val2 = val.ReliefLoadCalculations.ValueAtLocation(i);
				ReliefLoadCalculation value = null;
				if (!ReliefLoadCalculations.TryGetValue((ReliefLoadCalculationType)num, out value))
				{
					value = _CreateReliefLoadCalculationOfType((ReliefLoadCalculationType)num);
					ReliefLoadCalculations.Add((ReliefLoadCalculationType)num, value);
				}
				value.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val2);
				dictionary.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)val2).Record.RecordGuid(), value);
			}
			if (val.ReliefLoadCalculation != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.ReliefLoadCalculation).Record != null)
			{
				ReliefLoadCalculation = dictionary[((AcsBaseRecord)val.ReliefLoadCalculation).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
		}
	}

		public override void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference reference, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
			if (reference == _reliefDevices && !LockOverpressure && update.UpdateType != ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted && !IsBeingRecalled && !base.ModelRegistry.IsBeingRecalled)
			{
				OverpressureUpdater.GetSingleton().ReliefDeviceConfigurationChanged(this);
			}
			base.ReferenceChanged(reference, update);
		}
