			Name = new ProcessString(this, RsDataModel.Name, Guid.ParseExact("CD780F3E-3034-471E-8A94-C59066E6241B", "D"));
			OrificeCalculationMethod = new ProcessEnum<OrificeSizingMethod>(this, RsDataModel.OrificeCalculationMethod, Guid.ParseExact("04c4e099-84fb-4360-8ffc-af1c3e5fd601", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.ReliefScenario_OrificeCalculationMethod);
			LineSizingCalculationMethod = new ProcessEnum<LineSizingMethod>(this, RsDataModel.LineSizingCalculationMethod, Guid.ParseExact("f25da176-59dd-4b4a-b6bf-bce06e6c248c", "D"), base.ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner.ReliefScenario_LineSizingCalculationMethod);
			ReliefPressure = new ProcessPressure(this, RsDataModel.ReliefPressure, Guid.ParseExact("c3861943-8a53-4cde-836f-82cb26cf5cc3", "D"));
			ScenarioDescription = new ProcessString(this, RsDataModel.ScenarioDescription, Guid.ParseExact("246FBB6D-A8F1-431E-BA70-2547B1D42EA7", "D"));
			_reliefDescription = new ReliefDescriptionReference(this, () => RsDataModel.ReliefDescription, delegate(AcsSeReliefDescription dm)
			{
				RsDataModel.ReliefDescription = dm;
			});
			_reliefDeviceConfiguration = new ReliefDeviceConfigurationReference(this, () => RsDataModel.ReliefDeviceConfiguration, delegate(AcsSeReliefDeviceConfiguration dm)
			{
				RsDataModel.ReliefDeviceConfiguration = dm;
			});
			_totalOrificeConstraints = new PrdConstraintsDefinitionReference(this, () => RsDataModel.TotalOrificeConstraints, delegate(AcsSePrdConstraintsDefinition dm)
			{
				RsDataModel.TotalOrificeConstraints = dm;
			});
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecall()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecall();
			_reliefDescription.Recall();
			_reliefDeviceConfiguration.Recall();
			_totalOrificeConstraints.Recall();
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.BoilerplateRecallFixUp();
			ResetReliefScenarioProcessVarsByVersionAdded(StoredReliefScenarioRevision);
		}

		private void ResetReliefScenarioProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				Name.Reset(null);
				OrificeCalculationMethod.Reset(null);
				LineSizingCalculationMethod.Reset(null);
				ReliefPressure.Reset(null);
				ScenarioDescription.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetReliefScenarioProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			Name.Delete();
			OrificeCalculationMethod.Delete();
			LineSizingCalculationMethod.Delete();
			ReliefPressure.Delete();
			ScenarioDescription.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			_prdConstraints = new ReliefDeviceConstraintChildMockedRefKeyDict(base.ModelRegistry, RsDataModel.PrdConstraintsDefinitions, this);
			_pipeLineConstraints = new PipeLineConstraintChildMockedRefKeyDict(base.ModelRegistry, RsDataModel.PipeLineConstraintsDefinitions, this);
		}

		protected override void CustomRecall()
		{
			base.CustomRecall();
			_prdConstraints.Recall();
			_pipeLineConstraints.Recall();
		}

		protected override void CustomDelete()
		{
			_prdConstraints.Clear();
			_pipeLineConstraints.Clear();
			base.CustomDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredReliefScenarioRevision < 1)
			{
				if (ReliefDescription != null)
				{
					ReliefLoad orCreateReliefLoad = GetOrCreateReliefLoad(ReliefDeviceConfiguration);
					ReliefDescription.SelectedReliefLoad = orCreateReliefLoad;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name.Value) && char.IsWhiteSpace(Name.Value.Last()))
				{
					Name.Specify(Name.Value.Trim(), new UserSpecifier());
				}
			}
			if (StoredReliefScenarioRevision < 2 && ReliefDeviceConfiguration?.TotalOrifice != null && TotalOrificeConstraints.LegacyKey < 0 && PrdConstraints.TryGetValue(ReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice, out var value))
			{
				TotalOrificeConstraints = value;
			}
		}

		public override void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference managedReferenceBase, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
			if (managedReferenceBase == _reliefDeviceConfiguration)
			{
				ReliefDeviceConfigurationChanged();
			}
			else if (managedReferenceBase == _reliefDescription)
			{
				ReliefDescriptionChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReferenceChanged(managedReferenceBase, update);
			}
		}

		protected void ReliefDeviceConfigurationChanged()
		{
			TotalOrificeConstraints = null;
			_prdConstraints.Clear();
			if (ReliefDescription != null)
			{
				ReliefLoad orCreateReliefLoad = GetOrCreateReliefLoad(ReliefDeviceConfiguration);
				ReliefDescription.SelectedReliefLoad = orCreateReliefLoad;
			}
			if (ReliefDeviceConfiguration != null)
			{
				TotalOrificeConstraints = GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(ReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice);
			}
		}

		internal void ReliefDeviceTypeChanged()
		{
			PrdConstraintsDefinition totalOrificeConstraints = TotalOrificeConstraints;
			bool isCreated;
			PrdConstraintsDefinition orCreatePrdConstraints = GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(ReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice, out isCreated);
			if (isCreated)
			{
				orCreatePrdConstraints.UseCustomOverpressure.TrySpecifyFrom(totalOrificeConstraints.UseCustomOverpressure);
				if (totalOrificeConstraints.UseCustomOverpressure.Value == true)
				{
					orCreatePrdConstraints.AllowableOverpressure.TrySpecifyFrom(totalOrificeConstraints.AllowableOverpressure);
				}
				orCreatePrdConstraints.SuperimposedVariableBackpressure.TrySpecifyFrom(totalOrificeConstraints.SuperimposedVariableBackpressure);
			}
			TotalOrificeConstraints = orCreatePrdConstraints;
		}

		protected void ReliefDescriptionChanged()
		{
			if (ReliefDescription != null)
			{
				GetOrCreateReliefLoad(ReliefDeviceConfiguration);
			}
		}

		protected ReliefLoad GetOrCreateReliefLoad(ReliefDeviceConfiguration reliefDeviceConfiguration)
		{
			ReliefLoad value = null;
			if (reliefDeviceConfiguration != null && !ReliefDescription.ReliefLoads.TryGetValue(reliefDeviceConfiguration, out value))
			{
				value = ReliefDescription.CreateReliefLoad(reliefDeviceConfiguration);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected void ReliefLoadChanged()
		{
		}

		public PrdConstraintsDefinition GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(ReliefDevice reliefDevice)
		{
			bool isCreated;
			return GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(reliefDevice, out isCreated);
		}

		public PrdConstraintsDefinition GetOrCreatePrdConstraints(ReliefDevice reliefDevice, out bool isCreated)
		{
			isCreated = false;
			if (!PrdConstraints.TryGetValue(reliefDevice, out var value))
			{
				value = CreatePrdConstraints(reliefDevice);
				isCreated = true;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected PrdConstraintsDefinition CreatePrdConstraints(ReliefDevice reliefDevice)
		{
			PrdConstraintsDefinition prdConstraintsDefinition = PrdConstraintsDefinition.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			_prdConstraints.Add(reliefDevice, prdConstraintsDefinition);
			prdConstraintsDefinition.InitializeReliefDevice(reliefDevice);
			prdConstraintsDefinition.CalculateBuiltupBackpressureIfNecessary();
			return prdConstraintsDefinition;
		}

		public PipeLineConstraintsDefinition GetOrCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(PipeLine pipeLine)
		{
			if (!PipeLineConstraints.TryGetValue(pipeLine, out var value))
			{
				value = PipeLineConstraintsDefinition.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
				value.InitializePipeLine(pipeLine);
				_pipeLineConstraints.Add(pipeLine, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public LineRating GetOrCreateLineRating(PipeLine pipeLine)
		{
			return GetOrCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(pipeLine).GetOrCreateLineRating();
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(BaseModel model, bool onlyUserSpecified)
		{
			base.CopyFrom(model, onlyUserSpecified);
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeReliefScenario val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeReliefScenario>();
			Dictionary<string, PrdConstraintsDefinition> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, PrdConstraintsDefinition>();
			foreach (AcsSePrdConstraintsDefinition item in val.PrdConstraintsDefinitions.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSePrdConstraintsDefinition>())
			{
				ReliefDevice reliefDevice = PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item.ReliefDevice).Record.RecordGuid()];
				PrdConstraintsDefinition value = null;
				if (!PrdConstraints.TryGetValue(reliefDevice, out value))
				{
					value = CreatePrdConstraints(reliefDevice);
				}
				value.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item);
				dictionary.Add(((AcsBaseRecord)item).Record.RecordGuid(), value);
			}
			if (val.TotalOrificeConstraints != null && ((AcsBaseRecord)val.TotalOrificeConstraints).Record != null)
			{
				TotalOrificeConstraints = dictionary[((AcsBaseRecord)val.TotalOrificeConstraints).Record.RecordGuid()];
			}
			foreach (AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition item2 in val.PipeLineConstraintsDefinitions.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSePipeLineConstraintsDefinition>())
			{
				ReliefDevice reliefDevice2 = PressureProtectionRequirement.ReliefDeviceMap[((AcsBaseRecord)item2.ReliefDevice).Record.RecordGuid()];
				PipeLine pipeLine = reliefDevice2.PipeLine;
				PipeLineConstraintsDefinition orCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition = GetOrCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition(pipeLine);
				orCreatePipeLineConstraintsDefinition.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)item2);
			}
			ReliefDescription.CopyFromRecord((AcsBase)(object)val.ReliefDescription);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name.Value + ": " + Key.ToString("B");
		}

		private bool _IsActiveDevice(ReliefDevice device)
		{
			if (device == ReliefDeviceConfiguration.TotalOrifice)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ReliefDeviceConfiguration.ReliefDevices.Contains(device))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ReliefDeviceConfiguration.SpareReliefDevices.Contains(device))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IEnumerable<PrdConstraintsDefinition> ActivePrdConstraints()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ReliefDevice, PrdConstraintsDefinition> kvp in PrdConstraints)
			{
				if (_IsActiveDevice(kvp.Key))
				{
					yield return kvp.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<PipeLineConstraintsDefinition> ActivePipelineConstraints()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<PipeLine, PipeLineConstraintsDefinition> kvp in PipeLineConstraints)
			{
				if (_IsActiveDevice(kvp.Key.ReliefDevice))
				{
					yield return kvp.Value;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public bool NewItemIsUnique(string item)
		{
			StorageTank storageTank = base.ModelRegistry.GetModelsOfType((StorageTank t) => t.TankItem.Value == item).SingleOrDefault();
			return storageTank == null || this == storageTank;
		}

		public void FixUpLegacyKey(int key)
		{
			StDataModel.LegacyKey = key;
		}

		public override void CopyFromRecord(AcsBase sourceRecord)
		{
			base.CopyFromRecord(sourceRecord);
			AcsSeStorageTank val = sourceRecord.CastTo<AcsSeStorageTank>();
			foreach (AcsSeMessage item in val.Messages.AsEnumerable<AcsNoId, AcsSeMessage>())
			{
				AddNewMessage((MessageLevel)item.Level.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), (MessageLocation)item.Location.VarValue.GetValueOrDefault(), item.MessageText.VarValue, this);
			}
		}

		public Message AddNewMessage(MessageLevel level, MessageLocation location, string message, IBaseModel refObject)
		{
			if (_messages.Any((Message x) => IsSameMessage(x, level, location, message, refObject)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Message message2 = Message.CreateNew(base.AdbTop);
			message2.Level.Specify(level, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.Location.Specify(location, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.MessageText.Specify(message, new CalculationSpecifier());
			message2.RefObject = (BaseModel)refObject;
			_messages.Add(message2);
			return message2;
		}

		public void RemoveMessage(Message message)
		{
			_messages.Remove(message);
		}

		public void ClearMessages()
		{
			_messages.Clear();
		}

		public void RemoveMatchingMessages(MessageLevel? level = null, string message = null, MessageLocation location = MessageLocation.Anywhere, IEnumerable<MessageLocation> exceptLocation = null, IBaseModel refObject = null)
		{
			List<Message> list = _messages.Where((Message x) => IsMatchingMessage(x, level, message, location, exceptLocation, refObject)).ToList();
			foreach (Message item in list)
			{
				_messages.Remove(item);
			}
		}
	}

		private void ResetVesselExposedToFireProcessVarsByVersionAdded(int storedVersion)
		{
			if (storedVersion < 0)
			{
				IsActive.Reset(null);
				CalculatedReliefFlow.Reset(null);
				CalculatedHeatInput.Reset(null);
				CalculateArea.Reset(null);
				VesselType.Reset(null);
				Diameter.Reset(null);
				Height.Reset(null);
				LiquidLevel.Reset(null);
				Elevation.Reset(null);
				MaxFlameHeight.Reset(null);
				AdditionalAreaFraction.Reset(null);
				VesselArea.Reset(null);
				ExposedArea.Reset(null);
				F.Reset(null);
				FDataSource.Reset(null);
				InsulationThickness.Reset(null);
				InsulationThermalConductivity.Reset(null);
				TopHeadType.Reset(null);
				BottomHeadType.Reset(null);
				ExposedVolume.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 1)
			{
				AreaCalculationMethod.Reset(null);
				MaxFlameHeightNFPA.Reset(null);
			}
			if (storedVersion < 2)
			{
				AdditionalArea.Reset(null);
				HeadsExposed.Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateResetProcessVars()
		{
			base.BoilerplateResetProcessVars();
			ResetVesselExposedToFireProcessVarsByVersionAdded(-1);
		}

		protected override void BoilerplateDelete()
		{
			IsActive.Delete();
			CalculatedReliefFlow.Delete();
			CalculatedHeatInput.Delete();
			CalculateArea.Delete();
			AreaCalculationMethod.Delete();
			VesselType.Delete();
			Diameter.Delete();
			Height.Delete();
			LiquidLevel.Delete();
			Elevation.Delete();
			MaxFlameHeight.Delete();
			MaxFlameHeightNFPA.Delete();
			AdditionalAreaFraction.Delete();
			AdditionalArea.Delete();
			VesselArea.Delete();
			ExposedArea.Delete();
			F.Delete();
			FDataSource.Delete();
			InsulationThickness.Delete();
			InsulationThermalConductivity.Delete();
			TopHeadType.Delete();
			BottomHeadType.Delete();
			ExposedVolume.Delete();
			HeadsExposed.Delete();
			base.BoilerplateDelete();
		}

		protected override void CustomInitialize()
		{
			base.CustomInitialize();
			VesselType.AddAffectedProcessAction(VesselConfigurationChanged.Instance);
		}

		protected override void CustomCreateNew()
		{
			base.CustomCreateNew();
			HeadsExposed.Specify(HeadsInFireArea.Both, DefaultSpecifier.Instance);
		}

		protected override void CustomRecallFixUp()
		{
			base.CustomRecallFixUp();
			if (StoredVesselExposedToFireRevision < 2)
			{
				BottomHeadType.TrySpecifyFrom(TopHeadType);
				TopHeadType.Specify(HeadType.Same, DefaultSpecifier.Instance);
				HeadsExposed.Specify(HeadsInFireArea.None, DefaultSpecifier.Instance);
				switch (VesselType.Value.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal:
					HeadsExposed.Specify(HeadsInFireArea.Both, DefaultSpecifier.Instance);
					break;
				case VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_BotHead:
					HeadsExposed.Specify(HeadsInFireArea.BottomOnly, DefaultSpecifier.Instance);
					VesselType.Specify(VesselTypeEnum.Vertical, new UserSpecifier());
					break;
				case VesselTypeEnum.Vertical_NoBotHead:
					HeadsExposed.Specify(HeadsInFireArea.None, new UserSpecifier());
					VesselType.Specify(VesselTypeEnum.Vertical, new UserSpecifier());
					break;
				}
			}
			if (StoredVesselExposedToFireRevision < 3 && (Fire.CalculationMethod.Value ?? FireCalcMethod.FIREWetted) == FireCalcMethod.NFPA30 && FDataSource.Value == ProcessDataSource.Calculated)
			{
				FDataSource.Specify(ProcessDataSource.Specified, new CalculationSpecifier());
				F.Specify(1.0, new UserSpecifier());
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class Referenceable : IReferenceable, IKeyedObject
	{
		public abstract Guid Key { get; }

		public bool IsBeingDeleted { get; private set; }

		protected Referenceable()
		{
			IsBeingDeleted = false;
		}

		public void Delete()
		{
			IsBeingDeleted = true;
			_delete();
		}

		protected virtual void _delete()
		{
			SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.RemoveReferencesToDeadObject(this);
		}

		public IReferenceHolder GetParent()
		{
			return SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager?.GetParent(this);
		}

		public virtual void ParentAssigned()
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class ReferencedReferenceHolder : Referenceable, IReferenceHolder, IKeyedObject
	{
		public virtual void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference reference, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
		}
	}
	public class ReferenceManager
	{
		protected class ReferencesFrom : Dictionary<Guid, List<IManagedReference>>
		{
			internal IManagedReference ParentReference { get; private set; }

			internal ReferencesFrom()
			{
				ParentReference = null;
			}

			internal void AssignParentReference(IManagedReference parentReference)
			{
				if (ParentReference != null && ParentReference != parentReference)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign different parent relations");
				}
				ParentReference = parentReference;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<Guid, ReferencesFrom> _references = new Dictionary<Guid, ReferencesFrom>();

		public void RegisterReference(IManagedReference reference, IReferenceable target)
		{
			if (!_references.TryGetValue(target.Key, out var value))
			{
				value = new ReferencesFrom();
				_references.Add(target.Key, value);
			}
			if (!value.TryGetValue(reference.Source.Key, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = new List<IManagedReference>();
				value.Add(reference.Source.Key, value2);
			}
			value2.Add(reference);
		}

		public bool UnregisterReference(IManagedReference reference, IReferenceable target)
		{
			return _references[target.Key][reference.Source.Key].Remove(reference);
		}

		public void RemoveReferencesToDeadObject(IReferenceable obj)
		{
			foreach (ReferencesFrom value2 in _references.Values)
			{
				value2.Remove(obj.Key);
			}
			if (!_references.TryGetValue(obj.Key, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IManagedReference item in value.SelectMany((KeyValuePair<Guid, List<IManagedReference>> pair) => pair.Value).ToList())
			{
				item.RemoveDeletedTarget(obj);
			}
			_references.Remove(obj.Key);
		}

		public void ClaimChild(IManagedReference parentReference, IReferenceable child)
		{
			_references[child.Key].AssignParentReference(parentReference);
			child.ParentAssigned();
		}

		public IReferenceHolder GetParent(IReferenceable target)
		{
			ReferencesFrom value;
			return (!_references.TryGetValue(target.Key, out value)) ? null : value.ParentReference?.Source;
		}
	}
	internal class RefRefDict<TKey, TUKey, TValue, TUValue> : RefDict<TKey, TValue> where TKey : BaseModel where TUKey : AcsSeBaseModel, new() where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		protected readonly IDRfReferenceArray<TUKey, TUValue> DataDict;

		public override TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				return ModelDict[key];
			}
			set
			{
				TValue old = ModelDict[key];
				HandleRemovedValue(ModelDict[key]);
				HandleAddedValue(value);
				ModelDict[key] = value;
				((IDRfReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).SetValueAt((TUValue)(TUKey)(object)key.DataModel, (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Assign, old, key);
			}
		}

		internal RefRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, IDRfReferenceArray<TUKey, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source)
			: base(modelRegistry, source)
		{
			DataDict = refArray;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)refArray).Length; i++)
			{
				ModelDict.Add(base.ModelRegistry.GetModel<TKey>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)((IDRfReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)refArray).IDAtLocation(i)), base.ModelRegistry.GetModel<TValue>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)((ReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)refArray).ValueAtLocation(i)));
			}
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleAddedKey(item.Key);
				HandleAddedValue(item.Value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void HandleAddedKey(TKey model)
		{
			HandleAddedReference(model);
		}

		protected virtual void HandleAddedValue(TValue model)
		{
			HandleAddedReference(model);
		}

		protected virtual void HandleRemovedKey(TKey model)
		{
			HandleRemovedReference(model);
		}

		protected virtual void HandleRemovedValue(TValue model)
		{
			HandleRemovedReference(model);
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			if (modelBeingDeleted is TKey val && ContainsKey(val))
			{
				TValue old = ModelDict[val];
				ModelDict.Remove(val);
				((IDRfReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).RemoveAt((TUValue)(TUKey)(object)((BaseModel)modelBeingDeleted).DataModel);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, val);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, old);
			}
			TValue value = modelBeingDeleted as TValue;
			if (value == null || !ModelDict.ContainsValue(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			HandleRemovedReference(value);
			List<TKey> list = ModelDict.Where(delegate(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> pair)
			{
				KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> keyValuePair = pair;
				return keyValuePair.Value == value;
			}).Select(delegate(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> pair)
			{
				KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> keyValuePair = pair;
				return keyValuePair.Key;
			}).ToList();
			foreach (TKey item in list)
			{
				ModelDict[item] = null;
				((IDRfReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).SetValueAt((TUValue)(TUKey)(object)item.DataModel, new TUValue());
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, value);
			}
		}

		public override void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			ModelDict.Add(key, value);
			((IDRfReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).Append((TUValue)(TUKey)(object)key.DataModel, (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
			HandleAddedKey(key);
			HandleAddedValue(value);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Append, null, key);
		}

		public override bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			TValue value = null;
			if (!ModelDict.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			HandleRemovedKey(key);
			HandleRemovedValue(value);
			if (!ModelDict.Remove(key))
			{
				return false;
			}
			((IDRfReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).RemoveAt((TUValue)(TUKey)(object)key.DataModel);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, key);
			return true;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleRemovedKey(item.Key);
				HandleRemovedValue(item.Value);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, item.Key);
			}
			ModelDict.Clear();
			((ValueArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).Clear(false);
		}
	}
	internal class RefChildRefDict<TKey, TUKey, TValue, TUValue> : RefRefDict<TKey, TUKey, TValue, TUValue> where TKey : BaseModel where TUKey : AcsSeBaseModel, new() where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		internal RefChildRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, IDRfReferenceArray<TUKey, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source)
			: base(modelRegistry, refArray, source)
		{
		}

		protected override void HandleAddedValue(TValue model)
		{
			base.HandleAddedValue(model);
			if (model != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.ClaimChild(this, model);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleRemovedValue(TValue model)
		{
			if (model != null)
			{
				base.HandleRemovedValue(model);
				if (!model.IsBeingDeleted)
				{
					model.Delete();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ManagedReferenceBase : IManagedReference
	{
		protected struct ReferenceUpdate : IReferenceUpdate
		{
			public ReferenceUpdateType UpdateType { get; set; }

			public IReferenceable Old { get; set; }

			public IReferenceable New { get; set; }

			public int? Index { get; set; }
		}

		public readonly IReferenceHolder Source;

		IReferenceHolder IManagedReference.Source => Source;

		protected ManagedReferenceBase(IReferenceHolder source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			Source = source;
		}

		public abstract void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable target);

		internal abstract void Recall();

		protected virtual void HandleAddedReference(IReferenceable target)
		{
			if (target != null && Source != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.RegisterReference(this, target);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void HandleRemovedReference(IReferenceable target)
		{
			if (target != null && Source != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.UnregisterReference(this, target);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType updateType, IReferenceable old = null, IReferenceable New = null, int? index = null)
		{
			Source.ReferenceChanged(this, new ReferenceUpdate
			{
				UpdateType = updateType,
				Old = old,
				New = New,
				Index = index
			});
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ModelReferenceList<T, TU> : ManagedReferenceBase, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable where T : BaseModel where TU : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		protected ModelRegistry ModelRegistry;

		protected readonly List<T> Targets = new List<T>();

		protected ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TU> TargetsDataModel;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return Targets[index];
			}
			set
			{
				T old = this[index];
				HandleRemovedReference(Targets[index]);
				TargetsDataModel.SetValueAtLocation(index, (TU)(object)value.DataModel);
				Targets[index] = value;
				HandleAddedReference(value);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Assign, old, value, index);
			}
		}

		public int Count => Targets.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly { get; private set; }

		protected ModelReferenceList(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TU> refArray, IReferenceHolder source)
			: base(source)
		{
			if (modelRegistry == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("modelRegistry");
			}
			if (refArray == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("refArray");
			}
			IsReadOnly = false;
			ModelRegistry = modelRegistry;
			TargetsDataModel = refArray;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)refArray).Length; i++)
			{
				Targets.Add(ModelRegistry.GetModel<T>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)refArray.ValueAtLocation(i)));
			}
		}

		public virtual void Add(T item)
		{
			Targets.Add(item);
			TargetsDataModel.Append((AcsNoId)null, (TU)(object)item.DataModel);
			HandleAddedReference(item);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Append, null, item, Targets.Count - 1);
		}

		public virtual void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Targets.Insert(index, item);
			TargetsDataModel.InsertBeforeLocation(index, new AcsNoId(), (TU)(object)item.DataModel);
			HandleAddedReference(item);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Insert, null, item, index);
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			int? index = _removeReferenceToModel(item);
			HandleRemovedReference(item);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, item, null, index);
			return index.HasValue;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Remove(Targets[index]);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			((ValueArray<AcsNoId, TU>)(object)TargetsDataModel).Clear(false);
			for (int num = Targets.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				T val = Targets[num];
				Targets.RemoveAt(num);
				HandleRemovedReference(val);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, val, null, num);
			}
		}

		public bool Swap(T item1, T item2)
		{
			int num = Targets.IndexOf(item1);
			int num2 = Targets.IndexOf(item2);
			if (num < 0 || num2 < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Targets[num2] = item1;
			TargetsDataModel.SetValueAtLocation(num2, (TU)(object)item1.DataModel);
			Targets[num] = item2;
			TargetsDataModel.SetValueAtLocation(num, (TU)(object)item2.DataModel);
			return true;
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			int? num = _removeReferenceToModel((BaseModel)modelBeingDeleted);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, null, null, num.Value);
			}
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			foreach (T target in Targets)
			{
				HandleAddedReference(target);
			}
		}

		protected virtual int? _removeReferenceToModel(BaseModel model)
		{
			try
			{
				int num = TargetsDataModel.FindValue((TU)(object)model.DataModel);
				((ValueArray<AcsNoId, TU>)(object)TargetsDataModel).RemoveAtLocation(num);
				Targets.RemoveAt(num);
				return num;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return Targets.Contains(item);
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return Targets.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			Targets.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return Targets.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public IReadOnlyList<T> AsReadOnly()
		{
			return Targets;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ChildList<T, TU> : ModelReferenceList<T, TU> where T : BaseModel where TU : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		protected ChildList(BaseModel source, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, TU> refArray)
			: base(source.ModelRegistry, refArray, (IReferenceHolder)source)
		{
		}

		protected override void HandleAddedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			base.HandleAddedReference(model);
			if (model != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.ClaimChild(this, model);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleRemovedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			base.HandleRemovedReference(model);
			if (!model.IsBeingDeleted)
			{
				model.Delete();
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ModelCollection
	{
		internal readonly ModelRegistry ModelRegistry;

		protected readonly ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, AcsSeBaseModel> TargetsDataModel;

		protected readonly Dictionary<Guid, BaseModel> Targets = new Dictionary<Guid, BaseModel>();

		internal BaseModel this[Guid key] => Targets[key];

		internal IEnumerable<BaseModel> Models => Targets.Values.ToList();

		internal int Count => Targets.Count;

		internal ModelCollection(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<AcsNoId, AcsSeBaseModel> refArray)
		{
			ModelRegistry = modelRegistry;
			TargetsDataModel = refArray;
		}

		internal void Add(BaseModel item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			Targets.Add(item.ModelKey, item);
			TargetsDataModel.Append((AcsNoId)null, item.DataModel);
		}

		internal bool TryGetValue(Guid key, out BaseModel model)
		{
			return Targets.TryGetValue(key, out model);
		}

		public bool Remove(BaseModel model)
		{
			if (model == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("model");
			}
			try
			{
				int num = TargetsDataModel.FindValue(model.DataModel);
				((ValueArray<AcsNoId, AcsSeBaseModel>)(object)TargetsDataModel).RemoveAtLocation(num);
				return Targets.Remove(model.ModelKey);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal void CacheRecalledModel(BaseModel model)
		{
			Targets.Add(model.ModelKey, model);
		}

		protected bool DebugContainsRecord(IAdbRecord record)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)TargetsDataModel).Length; i++)
			{
				if (((AcsBaseRecord)TargetsDataModel.ValueAtLocation(i)).Record == record)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ModelRegistry : IModelRegistry, IReferenceHolder, IKeyedObject, ISerializableObject
	{
		private readonly ModelCollection _modelCollection;

		private readonly AcsSeModelRegistry _dataModel;

		private static readonly Dictionary<IAdbTop, ModelRegistry> ModelRegistries = new Dictionary<IAdbTop, ModelRegistry>();

		private bool _isBeingRecalled = false;

		private CaseConfiguration _caseConfiguration;

		private DefaultValueDefiner _defaultValueDefiner;

		private int? _legacyTankKeyCounter = null;

		private int? _legacyPprKeyCounter = null;

		private int? _legacyScenarioKeyCounter = null;

		public virtual bool IsBeingRecalled => _isBeingRecalled;

		public int Count => _modelCollection.Count;

		public IAdbTop AdbTop { get; private set; }

		internal StorageTankList StorageTanks { get; private set; }

		internal PressureProtectionRequirementList PressureProtectionRequirements { get; private set; }

		internal CaseConfiguration CaseConfiguration
		{
			get
			{
				return _caseConfiguration;
			}
			set
			{
				_caseConfiguration = value;
			}
		}

		internal DefaultValueDefiner DefaultValueDefiner
		{
			get
			{
				return _defaultValueDefiner;
			}
			set
			{
				_defaultValueDefiner = value;
			}
		}

		public Guid Key => Guid.Parse(((AcsBaseRecord)_dataModel).Record.RecordGuid());

		public bool IsDirty { get; set; }

		private ModelRegistry(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AdbTop = adbTop;
			_dataModel = (AcsSeModelRegistry)(((object)AdbTopEnums.AcsSeModelRegistrys(AdbTop).SingleOrDefault()) ?? ((object)new AcsSeModelRegistry(adbTop)));
			_modelCollection = new ModelCollection(this, _dataModel.AllModels);
		}

		public static ModelRegistry CreateModelRegistry(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			ModelRegistry modelRegistry = new ModelRegistry(adbTop);
			ModelRegistries.Add(adbTop, modelRegistry);
			return modelRegistry;
		}

		public static ModelRegistry GetModelRegistry(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			return ModelRegistries[adbTop];
		}

		public static bool RemoveModelRegistry(IAdbTop adbTop)
		{
			return ModelRegistries.Remove(adbTop);
		}

		public void Initialize()
		{
			AcsSafetyAnalysisCase val = AdbTopEnums.AcsSafetyAnalysisCases(AdbTop).SingleOrDefault();
			for (int num = ((AcsArrayBase)_dataModel.AllModels).Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (_dataModel.AllModels.ValueAtLocation(num) == null || ((AcsBaseRecord)_dataModel.AllModels.ValueAtLocation(num)).Record == null)
				{
					((ValueArray<AcsNoId, AcsSeBaseModel>)(object)_dataModel.AllModels).RemoveAtLocation(num);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)_dataModel.AllModels).Length; i++)
			{
				BaseModel baseModel = ModelBuilder.ReInstantiate(this, _dataModel.AllModels.ValueAtLocation(i));
				if (baseModel != null)
				{
					_modelCollection.CacheRecalledModel(baseModel);
				}
			}
			foreach (BaseModel model in _modelCollection.Models)
			{
				model.DataModelFixUp();
			}
			foreach (BaseModel model2 in _modelCollection.Models)
			{
				model2.Initialize();
			}
			StorageTanks = new StorageTankList(this, val.StorageTanks);
			PressureProtectionRequirements = new PressureProtectionRequirementList(this, val.PressureProtectionRequirements);
			StorageTanks.Recall();
			PressureProtectionRequirements.Recall();
			IsDirty = false;
		}

		public void Recall()
		{
			Pressure ambient = Session.Instance.Ambient;
			try
			{
				_isBeingRecalled = true;
				foreach (BaseModel model in _modelCollection.Models)
				{
					model.Recall();
				}
				IsDirty = false;
				CaseConfiguration caseConfiguration = _modelCollection.Models.OfType<CaseConfiguration>().Single();
				caseConfiguration.ModelFixUp();
				Pressure.UpdateAmbientPressure(caseConfiguration.AmbientPressure.Value);
				foreach (BaseModel model2 in _modelCollection.Models)
				{
					if (!(model2.GetType() == typeof(CaseConfiguration)))
					{
						model2.ModelFixUp();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (ambient != null)
				{
					Pressure.UpdateAmbientPressure(ambient);
				}
				_isBeingRecalled = false;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveReferencesToDeletedObject(IReferenceable deletedObject)
		{
		}

		public void ReferenceChanged(IManagedReference reference, IReferenceUpdate update)
		{
		}

		public void RegisterNewModel(BaseModel model)
		{
			_modelCollection.Add(model);
		}

		public void RegisterNewModel(StorageTank model)
		{
			_modelCollection.Add(model);
			StorageTanks.Add(model);
		}

		public void RegisterNewModel(PressureProtectionRequirement model)
		{
			_modelCollection.Add(model);
			PressureProtectionRequirements.Add(model);
		}

		public bool UnregisterModel(BaseModel model)
		{
			IsDirty = true;
			if (model is StorageTank item)
			{
				StorageTanks.Remove(item);
			}
			if (model is PressureProtectionRequirement item2)
			{
				PressureProtectionRequirements.Remove(item2);
			}
			return _modelCollection.Remove(model);
		}

		public T GetModel<T>(Guid modelKey) where T : BaseModel
		{
			return _modelCollection[modelKey] as T;
		}

		public bool TryGetModel<T>(Guid modelKey, out T model) where T : BaseModel
		{
			BaseModel model2;
			bool result = _modelCollection.TryGetValue(modelKey, out model2);
			model = model2 as T;
			return result;
		}

		internal T GetModel<T>(AcsSeBaseModel dataModel) where T : BaseModel
		{
			return ((((AcsBaseRecord)dataModel).Record != null) ? _modelCollection[Guid.ParseExact(((AcsBaseRecord)dataModel).Record.RecordGuid(), "D")] : null) as T;
		}

		public IEnumerable<T> GetModelsOfType<T>(Func<T, bool> predicate = null) where T : BaseModel
		{
			IEnumerable<T> source = _modelCollection.Models.OfType<T>();
			return (predicate == null) ? source.ToList() : source.Where(predicate).ToList();
		}

		public void ResetLegacyKeys()
		{
			_legacyTankKeyCounter = null;
			_legacyPprKeyCounter = null;
			_legacyScenarioKeyCounter = null;
		}

		internal int NewLegacyTankKey()
		{
			if (!_legacyTankKeyCounter.HasValue)
			{
				try
				{
					_legacyTankKeyCounter = (StorageTanks.Any() ? StorageTanks.Select((StorageTank st) => st.LegacyKey).Max() : 0);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					_legacyTankKeyCounter = 0;
				}
			}
			_legacyTankKeyCounter++;
			return _legacyTankKeyCounter.Value;
		}

		internal int NewLegacyPprKey()
		{
			if (!_legacyPprKeyCounter.HasValue)
			{
				try
				{
					_legacyPprKeyCounter = (PressureProtectionRequirements.Any() ? PressureProtectionRequirements.Select((PressureProtectionRequirement ppr) => ppr.LegacyKey).Max() : 0);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					_legacyPprKeyCounter = 0;
				}
			}
			_legacyPprKeyCounter++;
			return _legacyPprKeyCounter.Value;
		}

		internal int NewLegacyScenarioKey()
		{
			if (!_legacyScenarioKeyCounter.HasValue)
			{
				try
				{
					IEnumerable<PrdConstraintsDefinition> modelsOfType = GetModelsOfType<PrdConstraintsDefinition>();
					_legacyScenarioKeyCounter = (modelsOfType.Any() ? modelsOfType.Select((PrdConstraintsDefinition pcd) => pcd.LegacyKey).Max() : 0);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					_legacyScenarioKeyCounter = 0;
				}
			}
			_legacyScenarioKeyCounter++;
			return _legacyScenarioKeyCounter.Value;
		}

		internal bool ContainsTankKey(int key, StorageTank refmodel = null)
		{
			return GetModelsOfType<StorageTank>().Any((StorageTank st) => st.LegacyKey == key && st != refmodel);
		}

		internal bool ContainsPprKey(int key, PressureProtectionRequirement refmodel = null)
		{
			return GetModelsOfType<PressureProtectionRequirement>().Any((PressureProtectionRequirement ppr) => ppr.LegacyKey == key && ppr != refmodel);
		}

		internal bool TryGetScenarioByKey(int key, out PrdConstraintsDefinition model, PrdConstraintsDefinition refmodel = null)
		{
			IEnumerable<PrdConstraintsDefinition> source = from pcd in GetModelsOfType<PrdConstraintsDefinition>()
				where pcd.LegacyKey == key && pcd != refmodel
				select pcd;
			if (!source.Any())
			{
				model = null;
				return false;
			}
			model = source.Single();
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class PipeElementWorkList : IList<PipeElement>, ICollection<PipeElement>, IEnumerable<PipeElement>, IEnumerable, IReadOnlyList<PipeElement>, IReadOnlyCollection<PipeElement>
	{
		private List<PipeElement> _list = new List<PipeElement>();

		public Pipe Pipe { get; }

		public PipeElement this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _list[index];
			}
			set
			{
				_list[index] = value;
				_ElementChanged(index);
				_ElementChanged(index + 1);
			}
		}

		public int Count => _list.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public PipeElementWorkList(Pipe pipe)
		{
			Pipe = pipe;
		}

		private void _ElementChanged(int index)
		{
			if (index < _list.Count)
			{
				_list[index].SetDefaultsForDiameterFromPrevious(_list, index, Pipe);
			}
		}

		public void Add(PipeElement item)
		{
			_list.Add(item);
			_ElementChanged(_list.Count - 1);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_list.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(PipeElement item)
		{
			return _list.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(PipeElement[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_list.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<PipeElement> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(PipeElement item)
		{
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, PipeElement item)
		{
			_list.Insert(index, item);
			_ElementChanged(index);
			_ElementChanged(index + 1);
		}

		public bool Remove(PipeElement item)
		{
			int num = _list.IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			_list.RemoveAt(index);
			_ElementChanged(index);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	public class ProcessPressure : AbstractProcessVariable, IProcessVar<Pressure>, IProcessVariable, INotifyPropertyChanged, IVariableSpecifier
	{
		private readonly ProcessPressureDifference _processPressureDifference;

		private ProcessPressure _defaultValueVar;

		public override IEnumerable<IProcessAction> AffectedProcessActions => _processPressureDifference.AffectedProcessActions;

		public override bool IsValid => _processPressureDifference.IsValid && Value.AsAbsolute.ValueIn(UnitTypes.Pressure.InnateUnit) > 0.0;

		public override bool IsEmpty => _processPressureDifference.IsEmpty;

		public Pressure Value => new Pressure(_processPressureDifference.Value, PressureReference);

		protected AcsSeProcessPressure SpDataModel => (AcsSeProcessPressure)DataModel;

		public override IVariableSpecifier Source => _processPressureDifference.Source;

		public PressureReference PressureReference
		{
			get
			{
				return (PressureReference)SpDataModel.PressureReference;
			}
			private set
			{
				SpDataModel.PressureReference = (int)value;
				((AcsSeProcessQuantity)SpDataModel).PhysicalType = ((value == PressureReference.Absolute) ? 20 : 93);
				OnPropertyChanged("PressureReference");
			}
		}

		public ProcessPressure(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessPressure dataModel, Guid fieldIdent, ProcessPressure defaultValueVar = null)
			: base(model, (AcsSeProcessVar)(object)dataModel, fieldIdent)
		{
			_defaultValueVar = defaultValueVar;
			int num = ((AcsSeProcessQuantity)dataModel).PhysicalType;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = 20;
			}
			_processPressureDifference = new ProcessPressureDifference(model, (AcsSeProcessQuantity)(object)dataModel, fieldIdent, defaultValueVar?._processPressureDifference);
			_processPressureDifference.PropertyChanged += HandlePropertyChanged;
			((AcsSeProcessQuantity)SpDataModel).PhysicalType = num;
		}

		public override void Reset(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			_processPressureDifference.Reset(specifier);
			if (_defaultValueVar != null)
			{
				PressureReference = _defaultValueVar.PressureReference;
			}
			if (specifier != null && specifier.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User)
			{
			}
		}

		public override void Clear(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			_processPressureDifference.Clear(specifier);
		}

		public override void AddAffectedProcessAction(IProcessAction action)
		{
			_processPressureDifference.AddAffectedProcessAction(action);
		}

		public override bool RemoveAffectedProcessAction(IProcessAction action)
		{
			return _processPressureDifference.RemoveAffectedProcessAction(action);
		}

		public double ValueIn(PressureUnit uom, PressureReference pressureReference)
		{
			return Value.ValueIn(uom, pressureReference);
		}

		public bool Specify(Pressure value, IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			bool flag = PressureReference != value.Reference;
			PressureReference = value.Reference;
			return _processPressureDifference.Specify(value.PressureDifference(PressureReference), specifier) || flag;
		}

		public bool Specify(double value, PressureUnit uom, PressureReference pressureReference, IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			return Specify(new Pressure(new PressureDifference(value, uom), pressureReference), specifier);
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			Pressure pressure = processVariable.GetValue() as Pressure;
			if (pressure == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Specify(pressure, processVariable);
			return true;
		}

		public bool WouldBeValid(Pressure value)
		{
			return value.ValueIn(UnitTypes.Pressure.InnateUnit, PressureReference.Absolute) > 0.0;
		}

		public bool WouldBeEmpty(Pressure value)
		{
			return value == new Pressure();
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return Value;
		}

		protected virtual void HandlePropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
		}

		protected override void _delete()
		{
			_processPressureDifference.PropertyChanged -= HandlePropertyChanged;
			base._delete();
		}

		internal void SpecifyDefaultValueVar(ProcessPressure defaultValueVar, bool resetIfDefault = true)
		{
			_defaultValueVar = defaultValueVar;
			_processPressureDifference.SpecifyDefaultValueVar(defaultValueVar._processPressureDifference);
			if (resetIfDefault && base.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.Default)
			{
				Reset(null);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ProcessVar<T, TU> : ProcessVariable, IProcessVar<T>, IProcessVariable, INotifyPropertyChanged, IVariableSpecifier
	{
		private IProcessVar<T> _defaultValueVar;

		public override bool IsValid => WouldBeValid(Value);

		protected virtual T DefaultValue => (_defaultValueVar != null) ? _defaultValueVar.Value : EmptyValue;

		protected virtual T EmptyValue => default(T);

		public override bool IsEmpty => WouldBeEmpty(Value);

		public T Value
		{
			get
			{
				return ConvertFromUnderlying(StoredValue);
			}
			private set
			{
				StoredValue = ConvertToUnderlying(value);
				OnPropertyChanged("Value");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsValid");
				OnPropertyChanged("IsEmpty");
			}
		}

		protected abstract TU StoredValue { get; set; }

		protected ProcessVar(IBaseModel model, AcsSeProcessVar dataModel, Guid fieldIdent, IProcessVar<T> defaultValueVar)
			: base(model, dataModel, fieldIdent)
		{
			_defaultValueVar = defaultValueVar;
			if (!DataModel.SpecifierType.HasValue)
			{
				base.SpecifierType = SpecifierType.Unspecified;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Value: {Value}, Specifier: {base.SpecifierType}";
		}

		public bool WouldBeEmpty(T value)
		{
			return value?.Equals(EmptyValue) ?? (EmptyValue == null);
		}

		public virtual bool WouldBeValid(T value)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public bool Specify(T value, IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			_source = specifier;
			base.SpecifierType = ((Source != null) ? Source.SpecifierType : SpecifierType.Unspecified);
			bool flag = ValueWillChange(value);
			if (base.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.User && flag)
			{
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Value = value;
			BroadcastChange();
			return true;
		}

		public override void Reset(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			Specify(DefaultValue, _defaultValueVar);
			base.SpecifierType = SpecifierType.Default;
			if (specifier != null && specifier.SpecifierType != SpecifierType.User)
			{
			}
		}

		public override void Clear(IVariableSpecifier specifier)
		{
			Specify(EmptyValue, specifier);
		}

		public override bool TrySpecifyFrom(IProcessVariable processVariable)
		{
			try
			{
				Specify((T)processVariable.GetValue(), processVariable);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object GetValue()
		{
			return Value;
		}

		internal void SpecifyDefaultValueVar(IProcessVar<T> defaultValueVar, bool resetIfDefault = true)
		{
			_defaultValueVar = defaultValueVar;
			if (resetIfDefault && base.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.Default)
			{
				Reset(null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ValueWillChange(T newValue)
		{
			return (newValue != null && !newValue.Equals(Value)) || (newValue == null && Value != null);
		}

		protected abstract T ConvertFromUnderlying(TU value);

		protected abstract TU ConvertToUnderlying(T value);
	}

	internal class RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		private static readonly Lazy<RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate> _instance = new Lazy<RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate>(() => new RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate());

		public static RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate Instance => _instance.Value;

		private RigorousSwageSettingsUpdate()
		{
		}

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			RigorousLineRating rigorousLineRating = (RigorousLineRating)variable.Model;
			if (rigorousLineRating.PipeLine != null)
			{
				rigorousLineRating.PipeLine.InletPipe.ClearCalculatedSwageKValues();
				rigorousLineRating.PipeLine.OutletPipe.ClearCalculatedSwageKValues();
			}
		}
	}

	public class SafetyAnalysisCase
	{
		private readonly AcsSafetyAnalysisCase _dataModel;

		private readonly IAdbTop _adbTop;

		public readonly ReferenceManager ReferenceManager;

		public ModelRegistry ModelRegistry { get; private set; }

		public CaseConfiguration Configuration
		{
			get
			{
				return ModelRegistry.GetModel<CaseConfiguration>(Guid.ParseExact(((AcsBaseRecord)_dataModel.CaseConfiguration).Record.RecordGuid(), "D"));
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
				_dataModel.CaseConfiguration = (AcsSeCaseConfiguration)value.DataModel;
			}
		}

		public DefaultValueDefiner DefaultValueDefiner { get; private set; }

		public static CaseConfiguration ActiveConfiguration { get; private set; }

		public static DefaultValueDefiner ActiveDefaultDefiner { get; private set; }

		public static ReferenceManager ActiveReferenceManager { get; private set; }

		public static ApiTables ActiveApiTables { get; private set; }

		public IReadOnlyList<StorageTank> StorageTanks => ModelRegistry.StorageTanks.AsReadOnly();

		public IReadOnlyList<PressureProtectionRequirement> PressureProtectionRequirements => ModelRegistry.PressureProtectionRequirements.AsReadOnly();

		public SafetyAnalysisCase(IAdbTop adbTop, bool isActiveCase = true)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			_adbTop = adbTop;
			ReferenceManager = new ReferenceManager();
			AcsTopRecord val = AdbTopEnums.AcsTopRecords(adbTop).SingleOrDefault();
			bool flag = ((AcsBaseRecord)val.SafetyAnalysisCase).Record == null;
			if (flag)
			{
				val.SafetyAnalysisCase = new AcsSafetyAnalysisCase(_adbTop)
				{
					ModelRegistry = new AcsSeModelRegistry(_adbTop)
				};
			}
			_dataModel = val.SafetyAnalysisCase;
			ModelRegistry = ModelRegistry.CreateModelRegistry(_adbTop);
			CreateDefaultValueDefiner(flag);
			ModelRegistry.DefaultValueDefiner = DefaultValueDefiner;
			if (isActiveCase)
			{
				ActiveReferenceManager = ReferenceManager;
			}
			ModelRegistry.Initialize();
			Configuration = (flag ? CaseConfiguration.CreateNew(_adbTop) : ModelRegistry.GetModel<CaseConfiguration>(Guid.ParseExact(((AcsBaseRecord)_dataModel.CaseConfiguration).Record.RecordGuid(), "D")));
			ModelRegistry.CaseConfiguration = Configuration;
			if (!flag)
			{
				ModelRegistry.Recall();
			}
			if (isActiveCase)
			{
				Activate();
			}
		}

		private void CreateDefaultValueDefiner(bool createNew)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (createNew)
			{
				_dataModel.DefaultValueDefiner = new AcsSeDefaultValueDefiner(_adbTop);
				DefaultValueDefiner = DefaultValueDefiner.CreateNew(ModelRegistry, _dataModel.DefaultValueDefiner);
			}
			else
			{
				DefaultValueDefiner = DefaultValueDefiner.Recall(ModelRegistry, _dataModel.DefaultValueDefiner);
			}
		}

		public bool Activate()
		{
			ActiveConfiguration = Configuration;
			Pressure.UpdateAmbientPressure(ActiveConfiguration.AmbientPressure.Value);
			ActiveDefaultDefiner = DefaultValueDefiner;
			ActiveReferenceManager = ReferenceManager;
			UpdateApiTables(Configuration.Api526Edition.Value.Value);
			return true;
		}

		internal static void UpdateApiTables(Api526Ed edition)
		{
			switch (edition)
			{
			case Api526Ed.e5:
				ActiveApiTables = new ApiTables5thEd();
				break;
			case Api526Ed.e7:
				ActiveApiTables = new ApiTables7thEd();
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			ModelRegistry.RemoveModelRegistry(_adbTop);
			if (Configuration == ActiveConfiguration)
			{
				ActiveConfiguration = null;
			}
			if (DefaultValueDefiner == ActiveDefaultDefiner)
			{
				ActiveDefaultDefiner = null;
			}
			if (ActiveReferenceManager == ReferenceManager)
			{
				ActiveReferenceManager = null;
			}
		}

		public void ExportDefaultsToFile(string path)
		{
			DefaultValuesImportExport.ExportDefaultsToFile(path, this);
		}

		public void ImportDefaultsFromFile(string path, ref string loadVersion, out IEnumerable<string> warningSections, out IEnumerable<string> warningMessages)
		{
			DefaultValuesImportExport.ImportDefaultsFromFile(path, this, ref loadVersion, out warningSections, out warningMessages);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ValueRefDict<TKey, TUKey, TValue, TUValue> : RefDict<TKey, TValue> where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		protected ReferenceArray<TUKey, TUValue> DataDict { get; private set; }

		public override TValue this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				return ModelDict[key];
			}
			set
			{
				TValue val = ModelDict[key];
				HandleRemovedReference(val);
				HandleAddedReference(value);
				ModelDict[key] = value;
				((ReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).SetValueAt((TUValue)Convert(key), (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Assign, val, value);
			}
		}

		internal ValueRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<TUKey, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TUKey, TKey> converter)
			: base(modelRegistry, source)
		{
			DataDict = refArray;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((AcsArrayBase)DataDict).Length; i++)
			{
				ModelDict.Add(converter(((ValueArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).IDAtLocation(i)), base.ModelRegistry.GetModel<TValue>((AcsSeBaseModel)(object)((ReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).ValueAtLocation(i)));
			}
		}

		protected abstract TUKey Convert(TKey key);

		public override void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			ModelDict.Add(key, value);
			((ReferenceArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).Append((TUValue)Convert(key), (TUValue)(object)value.DataModel);
			HandleAddedReference(value);
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Append, null, value);
		}

		public override bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			TValue val = null;
			try
			{
				val = ModelDict[key];
				HandleRemovedReference(val);
			}
			catch (KeyNotFoundException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ModelDict.Remove(key))
			{
				return false;
			}
			((ValueArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).RemoveAt((TUValue)Convert(key));
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, val);
			return true;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleRemovedReference(item.Value);
				UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.Remove, item.Value);
			}
			ModelDict.Clear();
			((ValueArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).Clear(false);
		}

		public override void RemoveDeletedTarget(IReferenceable modelBeingDeleted)
		{
			if (!ContainsValue((TValue)modelBeingDeleted))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<TKey> list = (from p in ModelDict
				where p.Value == modelBeingDeleted
				select p.Key).ToList();
			foreach (TKey item in list)
			{
				ModelDict.Remove(item);
				((ValueArray<TUValue, ?>)(object)DataDict).RemoveAt((TUValue)Convert(item));
			}
			UpdateSource(ReferenceUpdateType.RemoveDeleted, modelBeingDeleted);
		}

		internal override void Recall()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in ModelDict)
			{
				HandleAddedReference(item.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ValueChildRefDict<TKey, TUKey, TValue, TUValue> : ValueRefDict<TKey, TUKey, TValue, TUValue> where TValue : BaseModel where TUValue : AcsSeBaseModel, new()
	{
		internal ValueChildRefDict(ModelRegistry modelRegistry, ReferenceArray<TUKey, TUValue> refArray, BaseModel source, Func<TUKey, TKey> converter)
			: base(modelRegistry, refArray, source, converter)
		{
		}

		protected override void HandleAddedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			base.HandleAddedReference(model);
			if (model != null)
			{
				SafetyAnalysisCase.ActiveReferenceManager.ClaimChild(this, model);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleRemovedReference(IReferenceable model)
		{
			if (model != null)
			{
				base.HandleRemovedReference(model);
				if (!model.IsBeingDeleted)
				{
					model.Delete();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class VesselConfigurationChanged : ProcessConfigUpdater
	{
		public static readonly VesselConfigurationChanged Instance = new VesselConfigurationChanged();

		private VesselConfigurationChanged()
		{
		}

		public override void InputChanged(IProcessVariable variable)
		{
			VesselExposedToFire vesselExposedToFire = (VesselExposedToFire)variable.Model;
			HeadsInFireArea value = HeadsInFireArea.None;
			if (vesselExposedToFire.VesselType.Value.GetValueOrDefault() == VesselTypeEnum.Horizontal)
			{
				value = HeadsInFireArea.Both;
			}
			else if (vesselExposedToFire.VesselType.Value == VesselTypeEnum.Vertical)
			{
				value = HeadsInFireArea.BottomOnly;
			}
			if (vesselExposedToFire.HeadsExposed.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.Default || vesselExposedToFire.HeadsExposed.SpecifierType == SpecifierType.Unspecified)
			{
				vesselExposedToFire.HeadsExposed.Specify(value, DefaultSpecifier.Instance);
			}
		}
	}
